When the exam averages were not even a passing score (below 40%), he hesitated about curving and ultimately set the scale 1-2% lower ie A- about 89% instead of 90% and B+ about 85% instead of 87%.

READ FOR 20F HW: many kids received low marks for not putting the theorem # or for writing 1 extra line during a proof MT 1: ave 64%   MT: ave 38%  Final: NA Overall: instructed his TA's to grade mercilessly. Partial credit was rare to come by and many students felt disappointed that their grade did not reflect what they were learning.
Tests are clear cut and straight to the point. If you do your homework and spend a couple hours studying for the test, you will do fine. Great professor!

Standard 20F tests. Test tricks are all basic that you can find if you have access to test banks. Very "proofy" tests. Copy all of the proof homework questions+ proof test bank questions, understand how to do mechanical question and you automatically get an A or B. Lectures are proof heavy so interesting if you love math. A drag if you don't care

I had him for 20B and he was about the same for 20B. He is very nice and willing to help. He is a bit boring, but he tries to lighten up the atmosphere of the class with some awkward jokes. All in all, I suggest taking him. He has very fair policies.
john eggers booty is one of the reasons i went to class. the other reason i went were for his awesome lectures. i love eggers

Eggers is a great professor and goes really in depth. If your major is not even related to math, and you are pretty solid with math, and you are looking for an easy A, show up and pass math class, BINGO! But if you are not good at math, don't know basics ( like many of my classmates), either sign out or read ahead and practice before signing up.

First of all, I did bad in this class so let's just say I hated it. He is a cool teacher though. Enthusiastic about math and knows his stuff. Before taking this class, I was a straight A student at CC, but this class was way over my head. People who get math and can learn quick will do well. Those who can't follow along fast enough might struggle
Great teacher, and A+ fashion sense. Pretty easy teacher.

I had him for 20B also. He's really nice and friendly. He explains things pretty well. He has a knack for teaching. He has this thing about him, though, where he doesn't like to post up answers to homework problems because he wants the students to find the answers on their own. I had Chegg for that, so it didn't matter to me.

The midterms were pretty straight forward, but the final was hard. There were a few questions that came out of no where. I had an A in the class for the whole quarter, but because I failed the final, I failed the class. That is his policy. His lectures were sometimes irrelevant and spent the whole time answering 1-2 questions.
He is a really nice professor and very helpful during his office hour.

Great lecturer, very clear, easy to follow if you are taking notes. (easy-to-read handwriting and loud voice) Always does little jokes during class to keep you listening. He will always answer any questions and he is very helpful. Homework is good practice for exams.
He's funny and knows what he's talking about. Eggers makes a subject like calculus worth learning, and I feel confident going into the next quarter.

Good teacher. If you are not the engineering type and skipped the 20 series looking for something a little more forgiving but still educational (ie you are a pre-med) then this will suit you fine. Be warned: this class is the middle approach. If you suck at math, be careful, you might want look elsewhere. Overall though, awesome guy, knows his stuf

Professor Eggers is a great math teacher. Little jokes during class keep it interesting, and it is clear he loves math. His tests are fair and don't have things you have not seen before on the tests. I feel lucky to of been able to take him for two quarters (20C and 20E).
Wonderfully Fun professor who takes a great interest in his student's understanding. He wants you to know the material well enough to continue not just to pass. That being said he's tough but fair.

Eggers is a very personable human being. He cares a lot about his students to the point where he will answer even the most basic questions during class. For this reason, I stopped attending his class as it became hard to follow at times, especially when we got to series convergence and the like. On the whole however, I do recommend taking Eggers.
He explains things well and is quite helpful. The tests reflect the textbook and the practice midterms. He's not super entertaining, but can be funny every so often.
Literally the best. I ditched the linear professor I had that quarter to be with Eggers because he is so much better of a professor. Loved him in both Linear Algebra and Calculus 3.

I love him! He talks loud and writes big, so his lectures are very clear. He does audio podcast, but I would say going to lectures is very helpful. He is humorous. "This is a tough crowd." lol. ANYWAYS, some of the concepts are hard to understand, but his test are pretty simple. He doesn't trick you at all! sometimes I feel like he's too nice.

Professor Eggers was a great professor.  He always has a positive attitude and honestly cares about his students.  I took him for summer session and loved going to class.  Plus, he juggles on the last lecture, which makes him even cooler.

Professor Eggers is a fabulous professor. He's my favorite professor in the math department. After taking Math 20E with him, I understand it incredibly well. He explains things well and his tests are fair. He's also very. very friendly! Every lecture he had a big smile. He actually cares about his students and their learning. Take him if you can!

Eggers is a rock solid professor. Knows his stuff, very visual person when it comes to doing problems. Midterms were relatively straightforward, final even more so. Only complaint is that his class did get lethargic at times and kids were falling asleep.

Eggers has a good sense of humor, which makes an otherwise boring class enjoyable to go to. His practice exams are at least 75% similar to the actual exam, so definitely know the problems on the practice exam. If you have questions he will answer them even if they are basic questions.

Eggers is very patient when answering questions and does not get annoyed when people ask him basic questions. His exams are very fair and are pretty similar to the practice exams. Attending lecture is not mandatory but the example problems he does in class are useful and prepare you for the exams.

His exams don't test if you can compute, but if you understand the concept. They're fairly easy, looks just like the hw and you get cheat sheets where you can write those on there. Attendance is optional but his sense of humor will probably get you to show up!

He was a really good teacher, his examples and class notes help with the homework and the quizzes are straight from the hw. Does his best to help students out with questions and is a fun teacher. Mt are a bit challenging but he does curve class at the end and hes the only math teacher that does that. Would recommend !
He doesn't know how to teach. I failed this class, retook it with another professor and got an A. dont take him. his exams are easy to fail and the final exam average was a 42% or something!
Nice guy, writes clearly and organized, homework is great practice (especially for quizzes), midterms are fair. I'd recommend him. If I had the chance to take one of his classes again I would.

He is a pretty funny guy and patient when students ask him questions. He might look intimidating at first but has a good sense of humor. Exams were fair. If you were a genius, then you could pretty much get an A in class. Good TA made a different since they told you what to expect on each test. HW should help me but it was graded way too harsh.

All he explains is theories. Doesn't show students how to approach questions. Doesn't curve midterms to the very end. Quizzes are str8 from the textbook homework. Past to present, exam qs are hard(he is in charge of them btw)--search for them. Skip a quarter and take a diff set of profs.on a C- but got an A+ in final and pulled it up to a B.

If you don't do well in math, you probably shouldn't take Prof Eggers. Super nice prof, but lectures can be confusing and he often omits important info, so read the textbook. Extremely helpful in OHs. Exams (25pts) are pretty easy but -1 for an arithmetic error is a sizable chunk of your grade. Holds review days before exams/final.

Dr. Eggers is a very kind man and tries very hard to motivate his class. His tests aren't difficult and actually tests for knowledge rather than challenge the test-taker, but it's difficult to receive a good grade due to the sheer amount of points the test is out of (midterms are out of 25 points!). He's very conceptual in his lectures. Study!

just overall a bad professor. has high ratings for the harder series of math but does not teach math 10B well at all. either makes things more complicated than they need to be or would omit veyr important information all together. Got an A in my last math class, can't follow this guy and now on the verge of a D. take someone else if you can.

Mostly presented material in easy to understand ways, sometimes though he does present the material as being harder than it actually is. Midterms are easier than the HW but the final was harder. The difficulty of the class has more to do with how hard the material itself is, overall this teacher is recommended.

I know everyone says he's a good lecturer, but remember that doesn't necessarily mean that one will do well. Grades rely heavily on midterms&finals, so don't relax one bit if you ace all the quizzes. The storm is yet to come. You need to pass the final in order to pass the class. I learned the hard way.

He sometimes explains material in a more difficult way than it actually is. Just do homework and make sure you know the material extremely well. You're allowed a cheat sheet for exams, even the final.

Eggers is a really cool professor who just wants this 20A students to have a good holistic grasp of calculus. He knows a lot of us took AP Calc, but at the same time he wants to make sure our foundation is actually solid enough to survive college.Know your concepts inside & out. Google eggers 20a to know his grading style I'd definitely recommend!

Excellent math teacher. Truly knows his stuff and wants to help you as best he can. Makes lecture fun with his eccentricities. Quizzes and midterms come directly from the homework he assigns. Final was a little difficult.
great
He's a terrible professor. He only teaches really easy examples and then he would give super hard homework questions that was impossible to do with what he taught in class.

awesome! the best math teacher in UCSD! He is really nice when you go to his office hour and extremely patient to you. he is fair to everyone. i love the way he talks in the class. I love his big big smile which definitely encourages student in some ways!don't think too much before your exam, and to make sure if your really understand knowledge

John Eggers is the BEST MATH PROFESSOR at UCSD!I wish he taught all of my other 20 series math classes.  I really love the way how he teaches! His examples and explanations are crystal clear. And I remember my TA gave us similar final questions at the review session. He is very helpful and approachable during his office hours.Take him if you can :)

Eggers gives very fair tests and does I good job with following a strict outline and homework schedule.  However, if I hadn't taken calculus in high school, I probably would've struggled a lot more to understand what he was explaining in lecture.  Overall, probably one of the best professors I've seen so far at UCSD

Eggers is great! He's so awkward and I'm pretty sure I'm the only who loves his awkward jokes (the ones no one really laughs at) but it keeps the class at a good pace. Anyways, I struggled with math till I took this course so I highly recommend it! Very fair exam giver :)

He was a great professor for Math 10A! He was superb! He is also very helpful during office hours, so definitely go! He makes his lectures sound interesting and he is a hilarious teacher, and juggles at the end of the quarter. Cheers!
Expect to be in the calc lab for this class. He was not a great teacher, just expect to learn the material on your own because the exams can be tricky.

The problem with Eggers is that he teaches things very formally. He loves giving formal definitions and technical explanations. Until he explains things practically, midterms scores and finals will still be low. Hard class for non-math people. He thinks everyone is as smart as him. I got a c-.
great professor! makes lecture funny, teaches with clarity, and is extremely helpful. def recommend him!!

VERY thorough lecturer. He makes sure that he's clear and that he answers all the questions. Funny guy, cracks jokes to lighten up the mood. Do the suggested homework because his quizzes are "shamefully plagiarized" from the homework. VERY helpful in office hours, and he juggles at the end of the quarter!

I detest the idea of taking math classes, but Prof. Eggers definitely takes the sting out of it. He's a self-described nerd and cracks jokes often. Quizzes are straight out of the homework problems. One of the top math professors in the school, hands down.

Definitely my favorite professor so far. He makes it easy to pay attention and class and makes sure that we understand the material. It's hard to not respect him, and you will work harder for a person you respect.

The averages for this class were the worst I've ever seen (10.6/24 midterm 1, 7.7/24 midterm 2, 28.9/50 final). All he did was go over the easiest examples from the book on the board and any time a student asked him to go over a harder one he would stumble through it for 20 minutes then tell us, "You get the idea." Hands down, worst professor ever.
My favorite professor of all time :)

cool dude. podcasts his lectures and have hw and everything on his website from beginning of quarter so you can get ahead if you want. tests are very reasonable and final was easier than i thought it would be. practice problems are rarely similar to actual. try to get prac prob from someone else who previously took it if u can. overall decent prof

I took this fall 2009. Interesting prof.  Doing practice problems help.  I wasn't interested in the theories but it does help later on in the 20 series.  Study for the quizes!  I had Andy as a TA and we was awesome. I recommend his class.

This class is an easy A or B. Eggers really makes an extra effort to make sure his students are critically thinking about the material. He talks slowly, so it's easy to take notes during lecture. His office hours are of great help, so attend them! He's also really funny and juggles for you. :)

Overall straightforward.  I'm not so great with calc so I didn't enjoy his quizzes being out of only eight points...overall, he's probably the best prof for the course, but definitely study and I recommend office hours unless you're a calc whiz.
If you take CALC 20A with any other professor you are unlucky... bottom line.

He's a really good professor. Quizzes are straight from the HW, which he doesnt collect. Midterm and finals are straightfoward. AND HE IS REALLY HELPFUL! Don't be shy to ask him a question! It's not that hard to earn an A, but I eff'd up by not studying/showing up to his lectures and ended up with a C+, which is generous from what my actions.

I took calc ab beforehand and got a 3. this class was basically useless so i never attended class,but from the few times i went to class, i can tell he's a great teacher. his tests were pretty okay, his curve is huge too. I got an A. he gives hw but doesn't collect it so just memorize the answers for the quiz.

I failed both of my midterms both were below 50% and missed lots of homework assignments. But i studied the day before final and went over his old exams and found out they are really simple. I took the final and thought it was a joke and only expected a C- in the class because of midterms/hw. The curve must was generous..i ended up with a B -_-.

He's an awesome teacher! Teaches you everything you need to know for the exams. I never had to read the book. With a little effort AND actually doing homework, it's an easy class! Nothing tricky on the exams.
Explains concepts very well and is usually clear. Tests are somewhat difficult, but the curve helps out a lot. I recommend him.

He's a really good professor. This class was taught very student centered. He didn't really lecture but went over the problems all together since the class wasn't too big. His tests are pretty doable but little mistakes could kill you. He talks really slow so heads up smart people, you might get a lil bored.
One of the best math profs i've ever had, he clearly cares very much about student comprehension , loves teaching
the prof is nice, but the class is annoying. It is time consuming because there is hw and matlab. I recommend going to class because the book does not help.

An interesting teacher with an interesting outfit. Nonetheless one of the best math teachers I have ever had. He doesn't just read off the book but actually teaches the subject for each section with great clarity. Reading the book and teaching yourself is actually a lot harder than just attending his lecture for 50 minutes. Highly recommended!
The tests were pretty fair and straightforward. Some exam questions were from his lectures, which aren't just from the book. Best math teacher who cares about his students!
great professor, he will help you to no end to make sure you understand the material. :)
He is a great math teacher! Very helpful and tries to make the lectures interesting. grading is fair. He is very funny, too, if you actually pay attention

Prof. Eggers is a very clear and very helpful teacher.  I would strongly recommend going to his office hours if you are confused about anything (something I wish I had taken better advantage of).  KEEP UP ON THE HW and the Midterms are easy.  Oh yea, he likes carmine red chalk.

His examples aren't in the book, so lecture is helpful if you don't understand what's going on.  Exams are "common exams" in which all students in the same course no matter what prof take the same one.  Curve tends to be a bit less for Eggers since he's a good prof, and a lot of smart people take him.  Easy A.

Overall a good professor. Homework quite a bit harder than lecture, but the exams are not that bad. You do have to do some studying to get the concept to stick. Look at practice exams - on some of ours he just changed the numbers and forgot to change the date.

Overall Eggers was a pretty down to earth professor. His teaching style required many hours outside of the classroom, but he was able to make the topics very clear in class. His exams were all pretty easy and based on homework/class problems. No tricks! If you do poorly in his class, it is certainly due to your lack of effort in the class.

Eggers is a pretty chill guy. Like many brought up, he explores proofs a bit too much and does not sufficiently cover the homework with useful examples. His exams were very fair and if you showed up for class and completed the assigned homework, you likely walked away with a B- or better. His final is worth 45% of your grade and it was pretty hard.

He is a great professor. Straightforward, exams aren't too bad. His lectures are pretty entertaining with all the jokes yet he always manages to stay on task. Take this guy if you have the chance, you won't regret him!

Cool guy.  Probably a little over-rated, but still a very good math professor.  He may delve a little too deeply into the proofs, and not show enough examples some times.  On the positive side, his notes are always very clear.  Not the best math teacher, but far from the worst.

I had Prof. Eggers for Math 10B and I liked him so much I took him again for 10C. He is the BEST math professor at UCSD. He makes some mistakes because of UCSD's cheap chalk and hey after using it myself I don't blame him. The chalk sucks. Seriously though take these classes with him and anyone who complains about him probably never studies.
I loved his class! He is very easy to understand.
He is a good professor but he doesnt really provide hints  for the midterms or final like other professors do for the 10 series
Eggers is a very helpful professor and great at explaning math.  Very understandable and easy to keep attention and interest in the subject.

His lectures were really insightful. Pretty entertaining at times and emphasizes understanding over just plain memorization. Honestly the final and midterms seemed pretty difficult and seem to be getting more tricky  every year.

I've taken him for 3/4 of my math classes here, and I'm still amazed at how many new jokes he can come up with. But seriously, it will make your life much easier to take this class with him over other professors. He gives very reasonable tests - just do your homework!
His lecture's bearable.  His lectures maily focucsed on example questions from textbook.
Really awesome guy the kind of lad you could have a cup of tea with. When it comes to Math the level of understanding is done 90% on your own.

Extremely helpful, funny, humble, and, to top it all off, juggles splendidly. If you really want an enjoyable math course which piques your interest and open up your world to the profound concepts of Calculus, take Eggers. He is the best. He has a prestigious teaching award and definitely isn't over-hyped. Over all, Eggers makes UCSD worth while.

Really nice prof. Gave really easy exams, because he tests your understanding of the subject and doesn't try to trick you. As long as you do your homework (which is due anyway), you can get an A in this class.
Fantastic professor who knows his stuff and is concerned about students learning. Keep up with your homework and you'll be great
very helpful, loved all the in class examples!

Not bad, but not the best of the best.Funny,laidback,and likes to answer questions.Do the homework,go to section,go to office hours and math lab and work hard and you'll be fine.Do all the practice tests.Stresses conceptual and doing few problems in lecture before doing homework problems.Textbook not that good though.TA's reliable.
He is really good pro as long as you keep up with HW do HW and you will get an A that's all you need to do for this class
VERY USEFUL.  I would recommend him, he is possibly the best math teacher at UCSD.  The midterm and quizzes were straight forward, do your homework and you would get an A
He is really good and his office hours are extremely helpful. I recommend him.

Had him for 20A and 20B. Good professor but definitely hyped. His quizzes are straight from the homework. Midterms are usually hard.. I thought his finals were much easier then his midterms. Anyway, after 20B I wanted to try out a new prof for 20C.. BIG BIG mistake. He may be hyped but he's definitely better then most of the math profs around.

Had him for 20A, 20B, and 20C. A solid professor. Throws around the occasional awkward joke for fun. Won't try to throw out trick problems at you. Takes class step by step. Encourages questions. Very approachable. Concerned with student learning. Very detailed explanations (which sometimes get confusing). Overall, he's "hyped" but not "over-hyped".
great professor, jokes around in class! makes math a lot easier. (math10A)

DEFINITELY OVERHYPED. He is a good professor, but NOT the best. You will be dissatisfied if you do schedule around his class. Before you go to his OH, check the online forum, because that's all he's going to tell you to do. Many topics were skipped during lecture and there's problem with the grading system because he doesn't grade it himself.
Great professors:)

I had him since the Math 20A class. His lectures are very structural, and the quizes are straight from the text materials. HOWEVER, he covers only the simple exmaples because he "doesn't get much sleep" the nights b4 the lectures. In any case, if you do the reading and all the hw, you will end up loving the guy anyway.   PS. He sucks at juggling...

An over-hyped teacher, he goes over the easiest examples in class and skips over the hard ones, makes mistakes everywhere, and essentially copies the book on the board, without adding any personal touches. You're better off just reading the book and skipping the lecture if you have him.

awesome guy that is approachable and there to help his students; however, material is confusing and goes through proofs that are not necessary to know. only assigns even number problems but quizzes are taken directly from homework.

Lectures can get boring fast.  Only assigns even homework probs, so solutions aren't available.  Quizes are directly from hw, which is great.  Assigns higher problems, so not much building up with hw.
Cool guy, class is hard. Lecture consists of proofs and confusing explanations. Litte or no example problems. beware

Dr. Eggers is really interesting, and he is a very good lecturer. Pay attention to his lectures and take good notes. Make sure you get the correct answers for your homework problems. The quizzes are exactly like the homework problems. Don't make careless mistakes on midterms and tests since there really is no curve. Pay attention to definitions.
No Comments
you really don't need to attend his classes, easy A. take this class

Eggers is 100% baller status.  His lectures are easy to follow, and relate directly to homework and tests.  He doesn't really curve, but his tests are so ridiculously easy that it isn't necessary.  You know a prof is good when his 9 am lectures are filled.  He is super approachable.  TA's are really good too.  only assigns odd hw problems.
Not a very good teacher when it comes to explaining things. He gets off topic most of the time and makes things confusing. Dont take his class if u dont have a strong calculus background.
He's great, times hard to entertain, but does..a 9 am class is a tough crowd, very nice and cares for his sutdents to do well and understand
great teacher, so bad i couldnt keep attending his class

He's the only reason I passed calculus 10A and 10B, with B+. Take that AP Calculus, guys his class is like a simplified version of AP calculus in high school and I did really bad in high school...but somehow now I hit college and happened to run into this amazing professor for two quarters and save my GPA. Do it!
he is very approachable and he tries his best to keep the class interested. The tests and quizzes were fair and pretty easy.

He is extremely helpful and clear in his lectures. Good enough to keep me interested. Has quizzes which are excatly hmk problems, hmk not  mandatory, exams are fairly easy f you do the hmk. Will not try to trick you or make extremely long and hard problmes, he likes to keep problmes and calculations simple
he is a good teacher but has the tendency to over explain things and confuse people
He is the epitomy of awesomeness. He comes in with his Pink shirt and amazes you with his mathiness. He is clear, concise, and on occasion has a cool story to throw in with his integrals.

Eggers is a good professor, but tends to mess up at times. However, he corrects his mistakes and knows he makes them. His teaching style is kinda whack and there's a lot of independent study needed. He goes on proving things, which make things confusing, but if you like Math already it shouldn't be too hard. He was a great prof anyway.

Dr. Eggers is one of the best professors I have ever had!  He is quite funny, writes clearly, and really explains the material well.  The class was difficult even after having taken AP Calculus, but Prof. Eggers' explanations made it the best it could have been.  With out a doubt, Dr. Eggers is the ideal math instructor! Take the class with him!

Very enthusiastic professor. He makes lecture a little less sleepy than other math classes. Do not take this class if you do not have a calculus background. Hard midterms, helpful and approachable teacher.

Eggers is the best math teacher on campus. This guy is funny and pretty decent at teaching. Tests are pretty easy. Just do the homework, and you're guaranteed an A. The final wasn't bad at all. He also curves pretty well.
The best math professor I've ever had.  Math is usually boring as hell, but he teaches the material in an engaging way.  Highly recommended, IF you can get in!

I only wish every professor were as good as Eggers is - fantastic at teaching. As the student before me noted, his midterms are difficult, but as I understand it, that's only for 20A, because all the 20A professors get together to make one test that they all use - that shouldn't be a problem in his other classes (20B, et al).

He may have a smile that'll make you laugh soo hard, but his teaching style's a little whack. He basically enforces independent study. His quizzes are extremely easy, but his midterms can throw you off. Sometimes the things he writes on the board doesn't match up with the stuff he says, so he'll have to go back and correct himself...CONFUSING!

The absolute best teacher I have ever had, I hope to get him next quarter, He's so cool, the quizzes are straight off of the homework, midterms aren't too bad, he gives hints to what will be on the tests. Overall, great great great teacher. I recommend him 150%
he'll do actual examples from homework or tests.. so pay attention... and he'll give hints to what is important to know... very good teacher
He's so helpful, fun, and easygoing. I love his pink shirts.
He's so helpful, fun, and easygoing. I love his pink shirts.
He is very clear, to the point, and helpful.
very clear, concise.  easy to take notes. tests are just like old practice midterms.

this class is pretty tough, so be prepared to study alot! eggers is a good professor, although he ain't used to teaching upper div, his lectures are pretty good. his homework is really hard and exams are pretty tough also. you really need to grasp the concept and study to get a good grade.

This is my third quarter with Dr. Eggers, and I am yet again amazed by his excellent teaching abilities.  Lectures are clear, exams are fair, and office hours are helpfull.  This is the way all classes should be.  Be forewarned that the professor's class fill up quick but I have had friends sit in on them anyways just b/c they are that good.
Really good professor. Good lectures and the tests are not the hardest if you know the material. Just do your homework problems and you'll be fine.
He's really good and kept me awake for most of class. Midterms were fair and he explains things really well. He really tried to make himself available to the students.
He is awesome Professor! Very clear when teaching....goes over each problem carefully like back in high school. Cares a lot about his students!
he's greeeaaattttt!! best prof i had so far here at ucsd

He rocks, such a good prof. If you go to his office hours he may teach you how to juggle, that's how I learned. Very cool guy, really funny, and a family man so he is not one of those crazy weirdo professors. Take him as a prof. You won't regret it!
No Comments
very good lecturer. very clear and his examples are helpful. go to his office hours because they really help. one time he even extended his hours for 30 minutes because I had questions
he explained well, but mostly i attended because he's so cute and friendly.
Very clear during lectures. Makes sure you know the material. Exams were harder than the practice ones given, but nonetheless a great professor.

He's funny, but gives you the wrong impression. He acts like he's going to be easy and then wham the exams are 4 times harder than the practice problems. He also avoids answering your questions directly and basicly rephrases your question. But he's helpful and a more colorful prof than most at UCSD.If you like to be challenged, take his class.

dr. eggers is hella funny. he laughs at his own jokes with this huge grin that'll make you laugh, whether or not his joke is funny. he goes through the material, his quizzes and tests are straight forward, and overall he's a nice guy willing to help. i give him an A+!
he tells jokes and is really fun and his smile is so hilarious! his quizzes are extremely easy cuz they're straight frm the homework.  he makes class enjoyable
watch him do the face (when he tells a joke), its hella funny.

This guys smile will throw you into a laughing fit. Class is enjoyable. He moves fast but if there are questions he will slow down. Quizes are homework problems so hamework good idea to do. By far one of the best math classes I have taken.
Practice makes perfect.  That's what you need to know to get a good grade.  jus tdo the examples over and over until you get them right.  He's a corny guy.  Not THAT great of a teacher.
makes calculus so easy!

Excellent teacher. By far the best professor that I have had at UCSD. He is incredibly bright as well as interesting and funny. He can captivate his students and teaches from his podium like a preacher-man.
Great teacher, really clear and concise. tries to write notes that are condusive to note taking.  Ask him to juggle at the end of the year, he probably will!

Excellent...excellent professor.  His class is clear, pithy, and organized down to the minute.  He provides reasonable homework assignments and the provided practice tests very accurately potray the real ones.  I personally hate math, but Dr. Eggers made learning it almost fun.  Beaware, though, his classes fill up fast.

I mean, maybe hes a good basic calc professor, but definently not a good 20F professor. All he does in class is talking about definitions. His gradings are hard. I got above average on everything, including midterm, final, quiz, and an A+ on HW, still, solid B. Maybe good for 20A-C, not good for 20F Period.

Definitely one of the best lower division math teachers at UCSD. He is very clear and concise and explains things so well, that one could probably get by without the book if they just went to lectures and took notes. Quizes and midterms are straight forward and he doesn't try mess students up. I highly recommend this professor.
Excellent teacher and by far the best professor I have had at UCSD.  He is organized and lectures are clear. I highly recommend him.

Best Calc professor here (although that's not hard to be).  Usually early but it's worth it.  People signed up for other lectures usually skip theirs and go to his because he's pretty clear.  Quizzed straight from the HW, but midterms and finals a little tricky, make sure you know the material well.

I've had 5 math profs before this guy, and he is by far the best.  You may find yourself doing something you never thought possible in a UCSD math class - learning from the lecture!  He's super friendly, excellent in office hours, and his tests are not difficult... at all.  Take him now!

One of the easiest classes I've taken at UCSD yet.  Eggers explains the material very clearly and is always open to answer questions from students.  Quizes and tests are exactly like the homework problems.
Eggers is a fantastic teacher. He explains things clearly, and tries to make the material interesting. Also, unlike other math professors, English is his first language....

Very approachable during office hours and soooo nice and helpful. Makes sure his students know the material. Makes nice little jokes to lighten the atmosphere and keep lectures fun. Do all your homework for quizzes and you will be fine.
He's hilarious, keeps your attention because he is always making jokes! a great professor !
he's awesome. funny, and a native english speaker. (which i find rare in math professors) tests are fair. it looks like a lot of the problems in the book, but sometimes he throws a twist.

Eggers is the man, this guy is really funny.  He does a pretty good job explaining the material, Calc isn't my thing.  His tests are hard, they are not really from the homework and they require really good understanding of the material.  Take him if you get the chance.

Eggers can teach somewhat, but he moves really quickly and if no one asks questions when they are confused he just keeps going. To do well in this class I did all the HW problems and studied the book  really hard. Those who have a problems with independent studying might not like him.

Eggers tries really hard to make math interesting and fun so he throws in a couple of jokes every now and then. Tests are difficult if you don't understand the concepts. Quizzes are straight from the hwk.

Hes probally the best Math teacher UCSD has to offer. Hes very clear and helpful and wants to make sure you get the material. Hes tests are representtive of the material with a couple of more challenging problems thrown in to spice things up.
He is by far the best math teacher that I have ever had. The lectures are very helpful and he is really funny.

Eggers is a really nice guy and obviously knows what he's talking about but if you didn't take calc in high school and math isn't your thing, don't miss lectures; he moves pretty fast and its a **** to catch up.

Eggers is FANTASTIC!!!  He's the  best math professor I've ever had.  Not only is he a very witty guy, but he really knows the information and is more than happy to help you out.  He even makes calculus seem easy.  I HIGHLY recommend him.
Really cool Professor

He's an awesome teacher! He's funny and interesting, and you'll definately not fall asleep in his class. He also takes the time to know his students and is very approachable in OH. He wrote my recommendation letters as well :) Must TAKE HIM!
Very cool teacher, just a very difficult class.
very clear, clear writing, wonderful professor

he's a pretty good prof. Difficult tests and quizzes, but if you really do your hw thoroughly, you can ace them. Lectures are clear and somewhat helpful, but you're only tested on homework and the book basically, so read up!

Great professor; Really cares if students understand material; The midterms are easy if you do the homework and attend section; The quizzes are graded extremely harshly so make sure you show all of your work; Overall highly recommended course
Eggers is the best math professor in the world!  Pray that you get him...before the class fills up.
i have to say, you don't even have to go to lectures *except for those fridays where there's a quiz*, but i show up anyway cause eggers teaching rocks and because of his weird humor...haha!
Eggers is a great professor. He makes math interesting! I highly recommend him!
makes lectures fun and provides examples to all he teaches. overall a fun class to be in and a fun professor to watch and learn from
No Comments
I hate math and, as a Lit major, was not looking forward to having to take math.  But, I actually enjoy his class.  The TA is a different matter...
Great teacher!! The best I have ever had! And kinda funny and cute too :o)
If you're taking math as a GE, take it with this guy! He's a former UCSD student and knows how to relate to students. He also juggles!

This guy is the best. I thought this class was gonna be hard, but because of him, It was actually pretty simple!  i had him for math20a and 20b too.  he hates creativity on exams- meaning nothing's  gonna surprise you on the test.. meaning YAY! =)
funny professor, actually made math 2% interesting. haha explains concepts relatively well. Not an easy class though, you have to study hard and know your stuff.
nicest math teacher ever....hes really cool...good prof...totally approachable..adjusts curve for his mistakes (which he will admit to making) 5 stars..take him if possible

He is the best Math professor UCSD has!!! Excellent teaching!!! My experience with him was amazing, I continued loving Math because of him!! He has many of the qualities that make an excellent teacher.  He partners up with Prof. Collins
team teaching..he explains things well..he is very organized.  do homework problems for quizzes..and midterms not too difficult.
I took this class over after a pitiful failing of it winter quarter.  Eggers made what I thought impossible, workable again.  He is extremely clear and helpful. Highly recommend!
He's really good at giving lectures and if you don't understand something just go to his office hours, he's really nice.

A very great math professor with some of the most lively facial expressions. Explains the subject very well and is always on schedule. He's open to any questions we may have and takes the time to make sure we understand the material.
He explains everything clearly and I believe he has one of the best TA's working for him. Keep up with the homework and go to discussion and you'll get a good grade.
Eggers is great! I love this professor. I completely agree with everyone else's review of him. Course-wise, it gets a little harder. Taking Calculus BC in high school helps a lot with the 20 series.
He's a good professros, gives clear lectures and notes... and cracks a joke here and there sometimes.  Exams are okay... sometimes there may be tricky parts but not too hard overall.

wonderful lecturer! I liked him so much I took him for 3 consective quarters!. His test are somewhat fair, although there is always room for silly ridiculous errors! His quiz for 20C where exact problems from the optional hw!

GREAT PROFESSOR!  his lectures are helpful, if you don't understand a concept, he'll make sure you understand it.  he has a sense of humor which makes his lectures far from dull and monotone.  do the homework and you'll do great on the quizzes & midterms!
No Comments
Great professor... you gotta speak loud though, hes got some hearing problems... do the hw, and ull do great on the quizes.

Awesome professor. Always makes lectures fun, and helps a lot in understanding the content!  Quizzes are straight from homework - mostly just pray you get a TA that is not a jerk and will take points off at the sight of a pencil smudge.
Nice teacher, very helpful.
eggers made calc lectures as interesting as possible and was always open to questions (even stupid ones). quiz questions came straight out of the homework, exams were a bit tougher.

I LOVE THIS PROFESSOR, took his class for an enitre series, learned a lot, very funny in his own way, lots of examples in lecture to help you understand, exams are straight forward... he's always there for office hours and so are his TA's
Very cool professor. Goes out of his way to answer questions if you have any. Quizzes are taken from hw so they're really easy if you do hw. He's a really nice and laid-back guy.
Eggers is a great Proff. real chill, doesn't get pised at the occasional cell phone ring or other distraction, all around good teacher!
Good good good. He's pretty funny and goes out of his way to help you out. Try to get his class.

His lectures are sometimes a lot of review, and thus boring. He's still a very good prof. Very open to Q&As.His lectures and assignemnts are helpful. Quizzes are based on homework, and don't be discouraged by first midterm, the second one is much easier.

He's a good teacher but he doesn't go into depth unless you ask. However, he is always open to questions. The quizzes are illegedly taken directly from the homework that doesnt get turned in. The tests arent too bad. He's funny for a professor.
Quizzes and tests are very fair because they are just like the homework. He is very nice and accessible.
good guy
Eggers is a really good teacher. He is clearl and eager to hel students, but the class in general is hard if you haven't takent Calculus before. His quizzes and tests are straight from the homework.
No Comments
very nice and teaches very clearly
Eggers provides clear explanations of concepts. For people who have already taken calc in hs before will find this course to be a review. He seems like a really nice and easy going guy.
slow and sometimes boring.  but goes step by step by step!
easy if took calculus b4; explains things very well, but takes ex from bk mostly

His lectures get off topic at times, but his stories and examples are interesting. There's no exams, just online quizzes and projects with an option to do it in a group. The lectures didn't help too much with the projects, but weren't strictly graded. Give yourself ample time for the final project.

As long as you show up even to discussion&watch lectures,you should be fine.Lectures were a bit boring, especially @ 8am, & hard to understand at least for me, but clearer on podcast.The Assignments(3 of them)are fairly simple if you know what you are doing,you can work in a group(I did it alone),but tedious.The quizzes just take your time on them.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Prof. Rossano is very sweet and understanding but his lectures are pretty slow and not the most entertaining. The grading is a bit tough and the projects are pretty detailed (even though the instructions are vague) but you can work in groups for all of them, even the final project, and there is no final exam.

Lectures can be boring and slow, but the professor really cares about his students and often brings in guest lecturers. Midterms/quizzes can be kinda challenging and specific but can be done. Assignments are manageable.

Solid professor. Great lectures and really digs deep to explain the "why" of many ideas. Quizzes/exams are somewhat challenging because they cover smaller details from lectures, although all is still relevant. Group projects highly encouraged but not required.

Class was based around group projects (optional to work by yourself) Rossano is super passionate about what hes teaching. He does have an accent, but its not difficult to understand (as a native English speaker). Overall class isn't diffiuclt. Assigns long research papers as readings but they arent 100% necessary to read

He teaches the material well. Assignments are very straightforward, but can be very time consuming too. You get the opportunity to to do group projects for them if you want, which is helpful. His tests are actually pretty hard compared to the rest of the class, make sure you study well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: In lecture he is a very joyful professor. He goes on a lot abut primates (so expect to see a lot of his research and do assignments based on them). Homework is pretty straightforward. Lectures aren't necessary, but the 1/2 of midterms and final ask tricky/specific questions that can only really be gathered from the audio.

Rossano is a solid professor but I just found the subject which was COGS 13 to be very dry. This class is based on 3 assignments, 1 midterm, 1 final, & 1 final group project. The difficulty of these assignments weren't all too hard, rather time consuming instead.
Hilarious dude and keeps your attention with his Italian accent and way of poking fun at the human condition. Definitely would take again.

I never showed up to the lectures or did the readings and still managed to get an A in the class. There is only one midterm, and the final exam is a group project. There are also a few quizzes (open note, online) and assignments (group), but none of it is difficult at all.

Prof. Rossano is my favorite professor so far at UCSD. He does a GREAT job helping students understand the concepts. He gives chances for extra credit and is very friendly. The few people I have heard complain about him were the ones who never came to lecture, didn't do the reading and still got a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great lecturer

Go to class. It will make quizzes and exams a LOT easier. Weekly readings are a bit overwhelming, especially if you're taking other intensive classes with it. Lots of extra credit opportunities as well, and he cares a lot about students doing well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: sometimes can be boring in lecture but he really cares for students' overall grades. get the textbook it helps a lot cause he follows it really well.

An overall sufficient teacher. Truly wants you to grasp the concepts taught, and pass his class. Offers extra credit, and 6 quizzes or so online. Truly helpful during his office hours. Though his accent is heavy, great teacher, supplement with textbook to fully understand course.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great professor! Takes care of students and a lot of extra credit.
Very straight forward, study the lectures.
Good professor. Easy class. Fun person to learn how to do science with.

Dr Rossano's class was very interesting and straightforward. I definitely learned a lot from his class and he's a really engaging and interesting professor. To do well in the class, you just have to understand the concepts and go through the lecture slides. Reading the textbook is optional since his slides cover everything. Good class and professor

Dr. Rossano is the kind of teacher that you have to supplement with your textbook. His lectures are completely optional (and rightly so), as you can just use online lecture slides and the textbook to breeze through the class. Open book quizzes, one midterm, final, and one 5 page paper (15%) are the grading criteria. Definitely a friendly guy too.

He spent much of the time talking about examples of concepts instead of the concepts themselves. He would then test you on those examples instead of the actual ideas we were theoretically supposed to be learning. He would also talk at length about his own research, especially orangutans. He expected you to regurgitate specific words he'd said.

The lectures are interesting and he does a good job explaining the concepts. But the grading criteria for the tests are unclear. The short answers are supposed to be 1-3 sentences but I was marked down for not explaining something that wasn't mentioned in the question. The times I got 100% on short answers were by writing 6-8 sentences.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Prof. Funny and cares about how he presents his material. Easy to listen to and an overally very enjoyable class.

I really enjoyed professor Fulkerson. He has this fun energy about him and seems to be genuinely interested in teaching the material. 4 Quizzes with the lowest score dropped make up nearly all of your grade. I found the first and last quiz to be the hardest, but overall a very manageable and entertaining class. As a Prof, he is great!

Amazing professor. Very funny and overall likeable guy. This quarter, attendance was taken, but he mentioned he won't be taking it anymore moving forward. 4 quizzes based off weekly readings, drops the lowest one. Quizzes aren't hard at all if you paid attention in class or did the readings. Light studying is probably recommended. 15/10.

His lectures were engaging and grade was based off of quizzes (which he provided study guides for that were very helpful) and attendance. He doesn't podcast lectures. He said every class is going to be different so the grading system and the way the class is set up probably won't be the same next quarter btw ! Overall I enjoyed though!!

Lectures are very engaging; Prof Fulkerson includes funny examples and asides, as well as different media to convey his points. His lectures also include segments of student-led discussions. Quizzes include clear expectations and helpful study guides are provided for every quiz, including the non-cumulative final.

Such a chill professor. Took him for PHIL 137 (Moral Psych) and he's an understandable and funny lecturer. Speaks rather fast and doesn't podcast, but is completely open to answering any questions. Grade based off of 4 quizzes and attendance (gives study guides that are very accurate though). Said he may remove attendance policy in future.

He's a very passionate and funny lecturer, but doesn't record them so you must show up to class to watch. Attendance mandatory, but you get a lot of skips. Grade is based on 4 in class quizzes worth 20% each, with a final exam and attendance making up the rest. You need to do the readings if you want to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Fulkerson's lectures are very entertaining and informative. He explains things in a digestible manner. The concepts are easy to grasp and don't go very in depth. All of the material is given thru the lectures so it is difficult to recover from missing a class. Tests were pretty easy. Would recommend as easy credit for psych majors

Had him for Philosophy of Psychology, great lecturer. The readings could get a bit long and dry at times, but the course content itself is quite interesting. Grade is based on attendance, four quizzes one course content that are graded leniently, and a final paper.

He makes lectures really engaging and entertaining. Definitely makes the confusing topics he teaches easier to understand. He gives many recourses and is super accommodating. He's one of the best professors I've taken at UCSD, you can really tell that he cares.

Moral Psych (phil 137)
Professor Fulkerson is an incredible teacher and thinker. Unlike some teachers who have ultra strict class structures with rigorous timelines to meet certain material thresholds, Dr. Fulkerson takes his time to discuss with the class and engage in real time philosophical thinking. He is also just a nice human being!
What an amazing experience, at a loss for words!

Had him for philosophy of developmental psych. super interesting lectures and the TA was helpful. lots of reading and writing but i feel like the assignments and quizzes are helpful for learning the material and they aren't graded super harshly. he's also very lighthearted and makes lectures engaging.

really great professor :) the material in the class was definitely challenging to understand but fulkerson grades fairly easy and is very accessible outside of class to ensure you understand. He does speak fast which sucks because he doesn't podcast, but he is super willing to answer any questions you have

She was an incredibly passionate prof and loves to talk with students about the movies. She wrote the required textbook, so it aligned well with lectures. ~30mins of lecture, rest of class is the movie, then a short discussion of movie afterwards. 1 attendance quiz after lecture about content at beginning of class, 1 midterm, and 1 final - all MCQ

Once a week, watch a movie, complete a 5 question true/false quiz for participation. One 35 question midterm and final (same question format). Super easy, fulfills Fine Art requirement, highly recommend! Prof tries to host discussions each lecture, I do recommend saying atleast something to break the silence, doesn't have to be remotely profound.

super easy fine arts ge, she lectures for 30 mins and then you watch the movie. 5 question attendance quiz on lectures due at midnight the next night. 35 question midterm and final on canvas open until midnight the next night + optional extra credit paper on a cult film of your choosing. gives extra credit for set evals too. low stress, i recommend
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great person, she is clearly very passionate on the subject and movies she teaches and discusses. Class is super easy, she talks for a few minutes, we watch a movie and discuss afterwards. After each class an easy quiz is required (if missed it won't open back up for you). Class is graded via quiz, final, midterm, all super easy and on canvas.

One of the best professors I've had, and an interesting class. Easiest class, graded by only midterm, final, and attendance quizzes from lecture content. Open book exams, and you can look up the movie if you don't wish to stay during the time. Extra credit paper for a 5% grade boost. Honestly would 100% recommend!

AMAZING! My media/film literacy was kinda bad, so I took this class to grow in that. I wanna take all her classes now, I learned so much. AMAZING film picks. All you have to do is show up once a week and watch the movie. Take some notes during her lectures before & after the film, and you will get 100's on the exams, they are very straightforward

Took 10, 11, 124 with her. Amazing professor and an easygoing class. Same format for all 3 classes. 10 attendance quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 final and 1 extra credit paper. All multiple choice + T/F. As long as you go to lecture, you will get an A. Movies were a great watch, but you def don't need to watch them all. Had a textbook, but not needed.

Easy class. The first 30 minutes is lecture followed by a movie.  If you go to class and pay attention, then you will get an A.  There is a five question take home quiz after each class based on her lecture.  Take home multiple choice mid-term and final based on her lectures.  There is an optional extra credit paper on a movie of your choice.

BEST prof, she is so sweet and so passionate for every movie she plays. during class, she starts w a 30min -1 hr lecture of that week's movie then plays said movie for the rest of class. take home attendance quizzes based on the LECTURE, not movie. take home midterm/final! super easy A class, i highly recommend. such a stress relieving class for me

Super easy class where she discusses the movie for thirty minutes and then plays said movie followed by a short discussion afterwards. Easy attendance quizzes, midterm, and final. Seriously a guaranteed A and a fun/interesting class. Absolutely loved taking this class with her!

Class is very simple. She gives a lecture for roughly half an hour on the film, and you watch the film for the rest of class and have a discussion on it if time permits. She gives a simple five question quiz on canvas after lecture to check for participation. The midterm and final are take-home exams. Professor Fulton was amazing, loved her

She is AMAZING! This is by far one of the best classes and profs I've taken. She lectures for like 30 minutes and the rest you watch a movie. She chose good movies and then to track attendance there was a 5 question canvas quiz (super easy). There was a textbook to read, but skimming would suffice.There is an easy multiple choice midterm and final.

I love Professor Fulton! One of the best professors on campus. SOO passionate about her work and brought so much energy into class. Her love for cult films made me love cult films. Class was just discussion into a movie, but I honestly liked the discussions with her more than the movies. Will def be looking for more of her classes in the future.

She is really passionate about what she teaches. Super awesome. Take her if you can! 30 min of lecture, 1-2 hours of watching a film, then a quiz due the day after. Midterm and final all multiple choice based on lectures and readings.
TDGE11 with Prof Fulton was so fun! Such an easy class for your GEs and you get to watch great films. Prof Fulton is so caring and funny.
Easy and fun class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Fulton is one of the best professors at UCSD. I took her for TDGE 11, and didn't have to go to class after week 1. Both the midterm and final were only. The participation quizzes were online too. If you need to take a class for your fine arts GE, definitely take it with her, it's an easy A+. She responds to emails very fast too.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Fulton is a knowledgeable instructor. You will need to purchase a course reader which has readings that will be assessed in the exams.

Her lectures were engaging and you could see her passion for Cult films. The lecture would entail watching a movie and discussing about it. There would be a 5 question quiz right after lecture. The midterm and final were 35 question quizzes.

Her classes are the best. You just show up she gives the lesson for about 20 mins then watch a movie which most of the time is really interesting and then answers a 5-question quiz due by midnight that day. Literally, the least stressful class I ever encountered at UCSD.

I took this class for my Fine Arts credit, but ended up not having to do much. If you're looking for an easy A, this is definitely a good class. She does 2 weekly quizzes on the lectures, so you should watch those, but the Final/Midterm had questions you could easily look up. Honestly, not a stressful or hard class, but enjoyed it and loved Fulton.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really liked Prof Fulton, her passion is contagious and she manages to make you interested in some of the weirdest movies ever made. The tests are insanely easy and it's clear she just wants us to have fun. I do recommend looking up the triggers in a movie before watching, as some can be disturbing and she doesn't really warn about that.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She cares a lot about this course, but her grading scheme this quarter was strange. A 95% was the minimum for an A, but the main problem was she never gave any sort of guidelines about cutoffs until after grades were posted and it caught many students off guard. You should do well if you try, but hopefully she doesn't do this again in the future

the class, cult films, was interesting. there are few easy themes and definitions that we had to learn about cult films, but mostly she just wanted to facilitate a conversation with the students abt the assigned. for each movie, a six q true/false quiz was given. one true/false midterm and non-cumulative final. the text was helpful too.

Julia Fulton has so far been the best professor that I have taken for theater. She is so kind and understanding. For TDGE 124, Fulton graded us on 6 five-point true/false quizzes for every movie that we saw and we had a 35 question true/false midterm and a 35 question true/false final. Her quiz/exam questions are straight forward! 100% recommend

Her class is a delight. It is a fun class and all you are going to do is watch cult movies and talk about them which is actually really interesting. Since class is online, attendance is required and she will give you a quiz every week related to lecture and a Midterm and Final. no homework besides maybe a little reading. Highly recommend her class!
The best teacher in the game.

Took her Cult Film class as an elective. It reignited my passion for cult movies! Class consists of a short lecture and then movie viewing, with quiz at the end. Quiz is based on the lecture so take very good notes. She brought a special guest from the industry at some point too, which was awesome. Pretty easy A as long as you attend class!
Easy lecture

This class was amazing, and professor Fulton is too. She is so passionate about cult films and she knows so much. Her lectures are really short and then you watch a movie. There is usually a short quiz after the movie for attendance. TAKE THIS CLASS!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Julia is an amazing professor. She is well educated in her subject of film and know exactly what she's talking about in her lectures. She was an amazing professor who helped me see the beauty of film beyond the characters and plot line. I admire her love for film and would take her again in a heart beat. Truly an amazing and caring individual!
Great professor who cares about students succeeding in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's super kind and want's you to do well. The material can feel repetitive and attendance is mandatory but overall the class is pretty easy.

She is incredibly kind, inspirational, and genuinely cares about human rights politics. Her class is very well-structured, and the readings are not only engaging but also truly helpful for understanding the material. I learned a lot and always felt motivated to participate. I would highly recommend her class to anyone interested in these topics!

This professor is the GOAT, she is very kind and truly care about human rights and her students. I would highly recommend taking her class to anyone, even if you are not poli sci. i would argue one of the best professors at ucsd.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Feeley may be the best prof I have ever had. All of the large assignments (Policy Paper, Midterm Essay, Final), I did not hate doing and I felt like we had the freedom to really key in on what was interesting to us, learn, and have a good grade be attainable. Learned so much from this class and getting an A was never in doubt. Take her class.

Unless you are incredibly interested in development, I definitely would not recommend this class. Professor Feeley cares for her students, but oftentimes I found this to be a little passive-aggressive. She claims this class is designed for success but assigns loads of work and vague midterm/final. Probably least favorite class I've taken at UCSD.
Bless her heart, shes a sweet professor but her notes/slides are SO unorganized lol.
Lecture attendance is mandatory (iClicker), weekly Perusalls (kind of a lot), take home midterm essay, policy proposal paper (long but lots of support available), in person final exam

Very knowledgeable about development, as well as a sweet and understanding professor. Weekly reading and annotations (perusall), midterm essay, policy paper, final exam is also an essay. Iclickers were required but the grading is lenient. My TA was pretty decent, but I could see getting a bad TA being a serious problem when it comes to grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I liked professor Feeley because she is nice and very passionate but sometimes the passion clouds her judgment. The readings are all required and GRADED on perussall. Which creates a lot of stress. There is actually quite an amount of essay writing (three essays).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Feeley has a really heavy lecture. It's dragging most of the time. But, if you attend office hours, you will understand more about her materials.

Attendance is mandatory! We had to use clickers and didn't mention that she was going to ask the same question twice which led to a lot of points getting deducted and is worth 10% of your grade.TAs take weeks to grade the assignments and are harsh graders. Her lectures were very boring and repetitive

so the pr may be nice but, depends on who your tA is and mine sucked . i would hear my peers about how easy their TA was as long as they did the work while the rest of us would really work hard and get harsh gardes. the pr needs to talk to them on being the same page as  it's not fair for the students that are working super hard and barely passing.

The BEST professor. She cares about her students and the work she does and it shows. She makes herself and her TA's super accessible so it's very easy to succeed, and you actually learn. Her feedback is super helpful and she's very knowledgeable about what she teaches. Would take her again. Never had a professor this caring and committed before.

Professor Feeley is GREAT! She is passionate about teaching, she's inspiring, patient, caring, approachable and wants all her students to do good in the class. She encourages students to get out of their comfort zone and aim higher. One of my favorite professors at UCSD. Go to her OH! you won't regret it

The subject was a bit boring at times, but she always brought enthusiasm and passion to her lectures. Also, if you need help, ask for it! She is very understanding and will definitely give you accommodations when you need them. The class was a midterm and a final (w study guides) and a writing assignment w multiple steps. Overall, awesome prof!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors at UCSD! She has such an interesting background and is so so so knowledgeable. She really cares about her students and wants to help, I guarantee that you will not regret going to her office hours! This class was great, really gave me perspective on international politics. 10/10
All i can say she's one of the most amazing professors at UCSD.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really dedicated professor, is clearly passionate and good at what she does, very kind to students and extremely approachable. Class material is a bit dense at times, doing well in the class necessitates going to office hours, being familiar with course materials, and putting the work in. Policy brief is intimidating, but isn't that bad at the end.

Very lenient on midterms, paper and final. She gives out the study guide a week before the exam. The 8-10 page policy brief was fun to do because you can do any human rights violation that you cared about. In my opinion, even if you miss two weeks of lecture, you can still get an A. This class was fun and easy af!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: She's a great choice for POLI classes, and gives a good amount of leeway to students. Professor Feeley really cares about the subject matter, and is one of few professors who strays away from teaching ideology as fact.

One of the best professors I've ever had. She genuinely cares about her students and goes out of her way to make herself available to answer any questions and answers them clearly. Her lectures are interesting and I like the way she formats clicker questions. Overall, I would highly recommend taking a course with Prof. Feeley!

Great professor, very sweet and truly interested in learning. Must attend every class due to clicker questions. The research paper was easy because she broke it down into steps. In class midterm and final difficult, heavily based on readings, but if you attend office hours she is more than happy to help you understand. Offers extra credit.

I took Poli 115A and 122 with Prof. Feeley. She is passionate about her work and her students. There is a lot of reading that you need to cover for the midterm and final, but the tests are very straight forward. She also requires a research paper but you can do it on whatever you want as long as you can tie it to the class.

Class had to buy a lot of books that we only had a few chapters to read out of, what a waste of $$. Most reading is on e-reserves. She talks on and on but never gets to the point, reading also never gets to the point. I hate her teaching style, boring. She is a smart lady but her course is goes in circles.

Ridiculously nice is a major understatement. She's genuinely interested in the wellbeing and learning process of all her students and goes WAY out of her way to help. And to top it off, she's absolutely brilliant - after working with her as my thesis advisor, I can confidently say that she knows her facts. HIGHLY recommended!

Feeley wants so badly to please her students- her readings are useless and she talks them over in class, her tests are just IDs and expects us to spit information out at her. I wish this class was more interesting. It was easy, but she could not help my attention. She is a WONDERFUL person, but her teaching style is not for me.

The material for this class can be dense, but she does EVERYTHING she can to help you understand it. She has OH three days a week and is extremely approachable. Yes, she is experimenting with clickers, but as long as you show up to class, you can get every question wrong and still get 100%! Must take for any poli sci major imo

Bad way to run a class. She wants so much to help the most number of students, but this hurts people in the long run. They won't answer some questions unless you post them on TED.I dont want to post on TED, its embarrassing to have your name attached to some questions.  A clicker is required. Everyone just guesses the answers, program doesnt work.

Dr. Feeley truly cares about her students' learning. Her course is really designed to have her students succeed, which is a rare gem at UCSD. Teaches the material well (even though it's a little boring and repetitive sometimes), TESTS EXACTLY ON WHAT SHE TEACHERS, grades fairly, one of the best professors at this school.

Ms. Feeley is impressively helpful and truly cares if students are engaged and understand the material. She does literally everything in her power to make herself accessible and is by all means approchable. Sometimes the material was a little dry and repetitive, but I think it was more the material, not her. I highly recommend her.
Such a great professor, I love her. She is so caring. Will stop anything she is doing to help you out. TAKE HER!
Great, GREAT Professor. Learned everything i know about college level writing from Professor Feeley. Take her class.

Feeley is very caring about her students and she is super sweet. She encourages Class participation. She loves teaching and would love if her students can get a A. The only downside of the class was that it was a seminar, which makes it harder. Part of the Seminar was that we are supposed to write a 20 page essay. Im still working on it
Class consisted of a short answer midterm, final and 10-12 page research paper. Feeeley is really nice and wants her students to learn, she's helpful and friendly, good class.

I really believed it was going to be a boring class, but she was super Helpful, extremely nice, and so informative that in the end I was sad for it to end! ... she will go out of her way to help her students out!

professor is not very approachable/kind. Lectures are long but not insightful. Grading is strict. The class doesn't feel like a safe space for creativity, which makes it hard to stay engaged or take risks with your work. be wary.
Easy, interesting, and fun assignments, easy grading. Lectures kinda bored me/droned on but attendance isn't mandatory.

This class was an intro class, so I understand that the topics weren't very interesting, but Professor Forbes' lectures were dry and boring. She's an engaging speaker, but she often repeats the same topics and takes long to explain simple concepts.

I thought she was super sweet and caring in class. When you participated, she was sweet and it was really great. But when I got my grades for my work back (when it was simple things like drafts and responses), she was really harsh about it, and I didn't like that. The lectures are heavy, and she talks a lot. Great person, too harsh of a grader.

Honestly the best class that I have taken at UCSD. She really cares about the class and tries her best to make sure we pass the class and become better writers. Really knowledgeable and gives honest constructive feedback. Class was something I actually looked forward to as we often had really great discussions.

Lectures drag on and on. Tough grader considering the vagueness of her lectures. Grades rough drafts as if they were polished, finished works. Extremely hard to use her creative writing feedback because her tips are so wordy and generalized. Class discussions are tedious; get ready to have everything you say be rephrased and repeated back to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really great, bright professor. Really fosters an environment of family in the class, and you're never too uncomfortable to speak up. However, you will not know where you stand in the class until you get your final grade, which is so incredibly frustrating. There isn't a clear grading system so you're kind of in the dark.

This class was easy and fun. All texts can be found online, so you don't have to buy anything. There's two assignments, and then the rest is just your final short story (one rough draft, one final draft) that has to be 10-15 pages. Show up daily, participate, and turn your easy work in on time and you'll pass with flying colors. Forbes is fantastic

Forbes is a great teacher, but for this class, your grade really only depends on your TA. Your TA will grade EVERYTHING, so do what they want. There was A LOT of reading, with bi-weekly in-class essays, but they're only worth 5 pts and they're relatively easy. Do the reading, go/participate in section, do the extra credit and you'll pass easily.

Very energetic, smart, approachable teacher. Her lectures are engaging and she makes things fun and interesting. However, she is a tedious grader and getting an A is impossible because of that. Attendance is important and the book is for the first few weeks of lecture. It was a fun and easy class, just a lot of busy work and hard grading.

Though her passion and knowledge are apparent, she is not a very organized instructor. She seemed to either show up late or started lecture late because she forgot her notes or had technical difficulties at least 25% of the time. Overall, it's not a bad class to take for GE since it's low maintenance but I couldn't take her seriously.

A writing class based on the Globalization of Hip-Hop... This class was bit of a stretch, but the professor was very nice and knowledgable. However, like every cat class, grades depend on your TA. So hope for a good TA... AND be aware that you are rapping in a self-created music video for the final project, which is a group project.
WOW. Her class was intense. You wil do fine if you read ALL the material and get help from TAs. GOOOOOOOOD LUCK!

Rise and Globalization of Hip Hop: This class was really interesting because I learned a lot of hip hop's history. Forbe's lectures may be boring to a lot of students, but I liked coming to lecture and listening to some old rap music. You make your own rap video for your Final, as well as just two east essays over the quarter. Take this!

Take this class! Her lectures are extremely interesting. I looked forward to the hour and twenty minute lectures. She's funny, approachable, and her quizzes are very, very fair. Just do the reading and pay attention in lecture, which really isn't very hard. TAKE IT.
She is very nice, approachable, but extremely nit-picky when it comes to grading. Very hard grader.
She's a snazzy dresser. The class can feel routine to the point of redundancy, especially with class discussion. Also, class rarely started on time.

Excellent Prof!!! Explains everything important in class... readings were fairly useful... but the discussions in class are kinda pointless. She is a tough grader, but you can get by with a B if you try.
She is a good teacher and knows what she is talking about. She grades pretty tough when it comes to writing assignment but will give extra credit and reward hard work at the end.

Very nice lady, very helpful and approachable, the class was interesting, some people might be turned off by the busy work (critical responses and group work), but I liked it because it was easy points. Only complaint I would have is that she seems to have public speaking/lecturing problems (lots of um's), gets kind of annoying.
