Professor Shotwell is average. He knows that this class is extremely hard, and he tries his best to simplify the topics for his students. But ultimately, he doesn't really know how to teach. He doesn't go into details in lectures, he doesn't really go over the i-clicker questions. Assigns quite a bit of homework. Overall, he is just okay.

Does not know how to teach physics. He is very bad at explaining already complicated concepts and methods of solving problems in physics. He forgets that we are not all physics geniuses which leads him to gloss over important content with no explanation. Most of the content has to be learned outside of lecture or you wont understand anything.

Shotwell is very knowledgeable on Physics but this is probably his set back because he seems to think we are all massive physics nerds too. His class is extremely hard and you won't survive unless you basically teach the material to yourself outside of lecture. He likes to over complicate everything just because its fun for him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 1 point for trying, another point for not being too mean. Contents are hard, so I can not blame professor Shotwell for his lecture quality. The average for each quiz is really low and there is no curve so far. Quizzes are hard in a weird way. Have done 5 quizzes and 1 more final to go. Attendance mandatory through iclicker. No extra credit.

Has reading quizzes and pre-lecture videos that were pretty helpful in preparing for lectures. His lectures focused way too much on clicker questions rather than the actual content. Learning is done mostly outside of class. His exams are very difficult with no curve.
Has very difficult to understand lectures, a lot of book focused so get unclear really fast, not the best person if you want to understand and use it in classes future

Amazing professor and super smart, don't miss any lectures b/c you'll have to explain most of the content for the oral quizzes(i think it's a shotwell thing). The pset corrections is hard, but very useful for a physics/STEM major. He sometimes drops hilarious jokes unintentionally lol. Lectures are very fun and engaging.
Read the textbook! I learned more from it for the homework assignments than from the actual prof.
Shotwell is a good professor! His grading structure is fair, almost too nice. More than half his grade is just homework and correcting it, and his exam was 24 hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Weekly homework and lecture quizzes for each lecture. I felt like I learned a lot in the class because he focuses on students mastering the concepts. Would definitely take the class again.

Shotty is the GOAT. The format of the class actually made me want to learn. There are so many office hours and opportunities for questions. One of the few professors who actually cares about his students. I will miss this class.

KING! I am so glad Shotwell was my professor this quarter. He does the reverse classroom thing with lectures to watch before (optional) problem solving sessions which I actually went to EVERY TIME. He is a good teacher for sure and funny! No midterms, but I genuinely still feel like I learned just as much as my other physics classes.

Weekly homework assignments and corrections during online fall 20 format. No midterms. Super nice professor and easy to understand. Definitely was not as much work as 2A or 2B and I feel like I learned at least as much, if not more. Also, the class itself was pretty fun if you like physics. I definitely would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Such a great prof! Super patient and it seems like he actually cares about his students. Yeah it's a hard class, it's physics, but prof shotwell makes is manageable and provides examples that are actually relevant. Highly recommend! Don't miss out. Take his class!!

Ah shotty. What a guy. Really knows how to lead a good class. Notice that I say lead; this man really understands that learning will come from him but also from our own work, and he structures his class to capitalize on this. Also, he gives points out just enough that its easy to get a good grade if you work hard and learn. Long live brian.

Had for 2 upper division courses. Can be on the tough side, but it's clear that he does it because he wants to make sure you are really ready to keep studying physics. Doesn't shy away from expressing disappointment when the class obviously doesn't do the reading, but it's only because he really cares about your education.
Lecture's just going over problem set and you can just complete by yourself. Homework is a random choice by yourself from a bunch of problems.

He was the first physics teacher I take at ucsd, and i really enjoyed his class. While he made lots of jokes with students, he also conveyed class materials sufficiently and thoroughly. The video and reading assignments before classes really helped me doing iclicker questions. Strongly Recommend his class

Shotwell might be my favorite professor at UCSD. He is funny, entertaining, very helpful lectures, and he provides everything you need to do well in his class. Mandatory reading assignments and iClickers but they aren't hard. Definitely do the review problems he suggests. His exams are not bad at all if you just do what he assigns. Great guy.

Lectures are mandatory via iClickers. Reading assignment due online for every lecture. Grade relies on exams as well as attendance and reading. UCSD-specific textbook required but very well written. Frequently shows demos and asks questions to keep class engaged. Cool but committed. Very passionate about academic integrity.

Brian Shotwell is a great physics professor. His lectures are clear, he goes over the important parts of what we're learning and does a ton of example problems in class. You need to do the reading assignments to be prepared for lecture. Clicker questions, hw and attendance pad your grade. Do the problems in the book to study for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Shotwell is not that bad, and I would like to take his class again. HW and attendance are easy points to get for your grade. He gave u abt 30 textbook problems weekly for practice and not be graded. If u do the problem and spend time to learn, u will be fine on the tests. 1st midterm is really easy, 2nd and 3rd are hard, final is doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Not completely awful as most are saying, but he definitely has major flaws. I will admit I agree with him about relying on the book, but he could be a lot better at helping us understand concepts before throwing a bunch of difficult clicker questions at us, especially since lectures are mandatory. Avoid if ur not serious about physics.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Cons: homework is not representative of the tests, attitude comes off as condescending multiple times, lectures mainly goes over practice problems, no review of concepts in class Pros: Lectures themselves are not bad as he does explain problems well sometimes, fair grading scale Don't think he is as bad as people say, but needs to fix issues
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: genuinely think he has the potential to be a good prof, but the way he treated his students took a steep dive as people started doing badly on the 2nd/3rd midterm & clicker qs. idk if he's going through it or smth but it doesn't him the right to berate us constantly. the exams were not at all representative of the lectures and (nonmandatory) hw.

He is easily the worst professor I have ever had. Physics has never been a problem for me in 2A and 2B but this class was an exception. The tests were not Representative of the the lectures and homework at all. The tests seemed like they were written in another language because the questions were barely comprehensible. DONT TAKE HIM PLEASE

For the average physics student, such as myself, this class is absolute hell. Unless you are an absolute God at physics and it comes to you without much struggle, by all means, take Shotwell. If, however, this is not the case for you, you are in for one hell of a ride. Hoping the curve is generous, unlike his horribly written exams/lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really speaks volumes when a professors rating goes from a 4 to a 2.8 over the course of a quarter. Stay away from him.
What he expects vs what he gives during lecture is really skewed. Shame he was the only Phys prof. this quarter.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Shotwell is a creative and awesome professor. Pros: Focuses on practice problems, makes lectures interesting, more action-orientated vs theory for his physics lectures. Cons: The exams are more difficult than the homework assigned. To succeed you need to grasps content more than what is said in lecture. I recommend him to any student.

This dude took the little appreciation I had from 2B and steamrolled it like that one anime. Despite being mandatory lectures will do little to facilitate your learning in preparation for tests and Shotwell gets a kick out of spending half of lecture scolding us for not understanding clicker questions. Stay away unless physics is 2nd nature to you.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you generally struggle with physics, don't bother taking Shotwell. What is gone over in lecture and what he puts on exams is so disconnected. He gives a bunch of clicker questions without a decent lecture because he relies on us reading the book. Mad respect to anyone who actually is doing well because wow this class is ridiculous.

agree wit6h most of the comments here. he is definitely not a good teacher, although he maybe a good teacher that help a lot of students who really want to study deeper. don't choose him if you are not
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: his exams are totally different with all the questions during the lectures and the hw questions. he made really strange and vague questions on the exams that you usually don't understand what is he talking about. HIGHLY DON'T RECOMMEND HIM AS ANY COUSE PROFESSOR.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: You can't learn anything from him, just a F.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I would never take his classes anymore. this is the worst class in my whole life. He didn't respect students and his projected final grades based on your midterms make me feel so offensive. maybe this is because he thought the students didn't respect him because the iclicker questions usually didn't get a good correct rate. he is awful
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Shotwell is one of the worst professors I have ever had at UCSD. He berates students in class regularly, and the tests are in no way representative of the homework or material went over in class. He is not a good choice for any physics class and I would most definitely not recommend him for any class at all.

He's PHYS series ain't made for those who want easy As or basically good grades. His definition of "easy" is not the same as yours! Prepare to work hard and actually do your readings, cuz probably won't give good curves. He actually gets angry if you don't work hard enough. Respect him a lot, but definitely go with someone else for PHYS 2 series.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are disconnected from the homework. Spends 2-3 minutes each lecture berating our class. Responds fast on Piazza for specific questions, but he basically tells the people behind to get good.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Book problems and lecture problems are really easy. The exam problems are really difficult. Make sure you can grasp the easy stuff before attempting his practice exams because if you can't do the easy stuff, the exam will be rough. Very concept heavy. Overall, not a terrible professor but I personally wouldn't take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Honestly, he's unresponsible. He ask u to read all of the material before the class and if u choose incorrect answer he will say u guys don't do the prelecture questions so we will not continue our lecture. why I need u if I already know everything? Also, he post 72 questions a week. and even u do all of them, u still can't have a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Just simply fantastic teacher and person. Wow just wow. I did not think I would be blessed by such a gracious creature in this lifetime.
read book is much more useful than him. Do lots of questions without useful lecture

Prof. Shotwell is just amazing, he is one of the best phys professors in UCSD. Lectures are very useful and there are also a lot of clicker questions. Also mandatory discussions. Before each lecture there are reading questions due but all are pretty easy. The exams are not easy but are fair, if you really pay effort you can get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Generous Professor... if you understand the concepts.

I loved Professor Shotwell. I was really dreading Physics 2B but he made the class doable and the concepts relatively easy to understand. He is very accessible outside of class and genuinely loves teaching. Do the reading and homework problems and ask questions when you need to and you will do well in the class. Definitely recommend him!
Clear lectures. He really wants you to learn and get a good grade. The quizzes are hard but reasonable. Make sure you do the homework problems.

This class is pretty hard, but it makes you to study, which is actually good for me. He is a friendly guy, and is really patient outside the class. If you have any question, post it on Piazza and he will reply you in a short time. There will be a huge curve at the end of the class. I highly recommend him.

Physics 2B is overall a very difficult class. He goes really fast and will gloss over very important topics that will be important for you to understand later. LEARN THE CHAPTER BEFORE. The quizzes are pretty rough however he's very approachable in office hours. It all depends on your TA and my TA was not the best and only confused me even more.

Shotwell is an awesome professor. He does an amazing job at explaining the material but that is no excuse at skipping the reading. His exams are very straight forward and there is nothing on there that you haven't seen before. Attendance is not mandatory but you should go and learn.

A really nice professor and probably one of my favorite professors that I have taken.  His exams and the labs are a little tough but if you ask for assistance he is readily available to help you. His class layout is very simple and easy to follow. A genuinely caring professor who just wants to see you succeed.

Physics 2B, in general, is a hard class, no matter the professor.  His quizzes, midterm, and final were tough. However, there was a HUGE, GENEROUS curve at the end that saved most of the class from failing.

He's a good lecturer although I found Phys 2B rather difficult to understand and conceptualize. Phys 2B is harder to understand than 2A(mechanics) because it's harder to visualize. His curve is really generous and he's a really nice guy.

He was a wonderful lecturer who drew everything out on the board versus having power points like other physics professors. The course was really tough, however. Also I must admit I may or may not have gotten distracted by how attractive Brian is...

He is really nice and clear in lecture. Although he is a new professor, he tried to give more examples in class as he can. Weekly quizzes are a large part of the final grade but they are not so tough. No graded hw.

He definitely knows the course material very well. He is very responsive in class and through emails (even outside class). He just needs more confidence in himself. I think the course itself is hard. Like most new professors,  he just want to make the quizzes at least a little bit challenging.

He def puts the "hot" in Shotwell. I got so distracted by his good looks that I failed every quiz so far. Well actually, it was because his quizzes are really hard. I wish he would put up solutions to quizzes because I still don't know what I did wrong. He really wants students to learn physics but honestly we just want A's.

Shotwell is young and handsome. He's pretty new to teaching and makes awkward jokes. I find them hilarious because of the awkwardness. He explains things pretty well. I wish he produced lecture slides but that isn't too big a deal. I think after a couple more quarters of teaching physics he'll be really good at it.

He was my professor for physics 2b during the summer. He really wants you to learn the material. He doesn't skip the difficult material like other professors. He makes you learn Gauss's law in great detail.  Do the hw, attend discussions and ask many questions and you will be ok. The curve is huge too

tbh tim brady still haunts me bc i struggled with exams (every question was like an essay). but overall he was a really good lecturer and his chuckles made me giggle whenever i would rewatch the podcasts. he says attendance is mandatory but never took attendance so everyone mainly skipped.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I did really well on the first midterm and slacked off for the others, which I shouldn't have done. He makes it clear what he's testing on, but sometimes the wording on the tests seems tricky. Easiest psych class I've taken, just don't underestimate the studying, and you'll do just fine.
Professor Brady gives amazing lectures. So entertaining and so easy at conveying hard concepts.

Prof Brady is really nice, and is accommodating if you can't take an exam or assignment for certain reasons and will offer extensions. His lectures are not mandatory but you definitely need to watch the podcast to know what's going on. The only reason why I wouldn't take him again is because his exams are really hard and questions are very long
Professor Brady paid off my debt and saved me from a burning building

Best professor I've ever had. His lectures are so so so entertaining and he is really good at explaining very complex concepts. The tests were very predictable and he always emphasized in his lectures exactly what was on the exams. Graded mostly by three exams, but there are easy quizzes and online experiments for another exams worth of points.

Most kind and caring professor I've ever had the privilege of having at UCSD. Everything about his class is formulated perfectly to be extremely engaging and interesting. He gives off total dad energy, and you just know that this man is the most wonderful father to his two daughters. Genuine 10/10 class with extremely fair exams.

This professor is the epitome of giggles and sunshine. He sees light in everything. He laughs at least 500 times a lecture. Super easy exams if you're into psyc content. 10/10 Reccomend. Grade is based on weekly(ish) quizzes, short experiments, and 3 exams. Super simple class

Nice guy with really great teaching methods. The slides are really informative and, in my opinion, super interesting. 3 Exams were pretty easy, weekly quizzes were very easy, and the weekly experiments are SUPER easy and fun! I definitely recommend this class. Easy A, cool topic, nice professor

Professor Brady's class was amazing every day with so many cool examples of what our mind does and how it tricks us. Tests are challenging because they make you apply the concept to new experiments or situations, but were fair.

Really loved this class, you can tell Brady cares about what he is teaching. Lectures are easy to follow and he gives lots of examples for things that will be on exams. Make sure to attend lecture or watch podcasts for sure. Exams are difficult but not impossible if you study!

Professor Brady is an amazing inspiring lecturer with so much passion for cognitive psychology that it makes me want to be a cognitive psychologist. The class has all sorts of mind blowing examples every day and he's very clear about what's on the test. The exams make you apply the concepts and predict new experiments so be ready for that.

Tim is the best professor I have ever had. For the first time, I truly loved going to school. Every lecture had fun experiments. I truly feel like I learned. I barely had to study because I ACTUALLY retained the info. Professor, if you're reading this, you're an inspiration & your students & daughters are so lucky to have a role model like you.
Love Professor Brady! His lectures are always so interesting and engaging. 10/10 would recommend his class

Tim is a great professor! So funny and you can tell he really loves what he teaches. I went in with little interest and ended up loving the course! Lots of fun in-class "experiments". Tests can seem intimidating, but if you study and take notes according to the outline at the beginning of lecture you should do well. Great course, great prof!

Best professor I've ever had! Lectures are always interesting and he does a bunch of demos that help a bunch. Exam questions are worded to help you recall as much as possible from what was discussed during lectures, and you can tell that he genuinely wants his students to succeed. Super accessible through OH and responds to emails very quickly too.
Amazing class, really interesting how our minds trick us all the time
Class was a pleasure.

My favorite professor at UCSD. Brady gives dad energy, explains concepts really well, I took this class winter quarter and I actually still remember concepts from it now and use them in my daily life. I thought cog psyc was going to be boring but it was literally the best.

had him for psyc105 and 174. grading is mostly based on 2 midterms and final but he has quizzes that can help your grade a lot, and 2% EC for sona studies. clear lectures, connects and explains concepts well and relates it to real (and sometimes interactive!) experiments. super caring and helpful during OHs and replies to emails relatively quickly.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Taken Prof Brady for 105 and 174. Grades are test based and gives you cushion with participation quizzes (straight forward weekly online quizzes). Brady's lectures are interactive with the research and examples helping connect the cognitive ideas. (cheat code: when taking his tests read with his voice in your head - the answer sounds most like him)
Brady is funny and the class is really interesting. It focuses a lot on new research.

I really enjoyed this class. Prof Brady did a great job at teaching concepts, super interesting material. 2 midterms + final. Classes are podcasted and attendance is not mandatory. Weekly ted talks + videos to watch (short pass/fail summary) and participate in a weekly short experiment (10 min max). Sona extra credit. Great class, really recommend!

Nice lecturer, makes hard concepts very easy and entertaining to learn. Uses many real life examples when teaching abstract concepts. Grades are mostly based on 3 exams (kinda test-heavy), but as long as you really learn and go to lecture / watch the recording (which is very entertaining to watch), you will do fine (no need to memorize definitions!

Professor Brady was an amazing professor! I loved all of his lectures and found them all really entertaining. He makes learning fun and provides a lot of interesting examples to help you learn better.

Dr. Brady is an amazing professor. He cares about his students and he's really nice and funny. The tests are based on the lecture and there's a lot of material on the lectures, but he gives good examples to help you remember the concepts. Just study the lecture notes thoroughly and you'll be good :) overall great guy with good vibes.
grades are based on 3 exams-- 2 in class midterms and a final-- and easy weekly hw. tests are a lil hard but just study the lectures and you'll be chilling. he's great though, def recommend

Not a good teacher. Hes a researcher that teaches 1 class a in winter term. lectures are long and dont cover all tested materials. he gives very specific examples that are not useful. The TAs even say how bad he is. he told his students get 100% or drop the class.

His lectures are amazing. (Gives off dorky dad vibes) He genuinely cares about students.  He handwrote a valentines card for everyone in the class aww (there is over 200 people in our class).  There is barely any workload.  There is no required textbook, and there is one short experiment and video summary due every Friday.

Professor Brady's lectures are interactive and keep you on your toes, and the content itself is very interesting. What disappoints me is the disproportionate grading criteria. Exams are worth 80% of your grade, he doesn't drop any. I was on the verge of failing the class and all he said was "either get 100% on all the exams or drop the class". Sad.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Useless lecture.

I absolutely loved Brady.  He is very charismatic which makes lectures engaging.  He genuinely cares about how his students do in the class & tries to make it as fair & easy for us as possible while still enriching us with the material.  The grade is from 2 midterms (non-cum) 1 cumulative final & 5/6 easy quizzes.  Wish I took him for more courses

Easily one of my favorite professors in the psych department! He's so kind and generous and his lectures are engaging and fascinating! He's very passionate and an amazing teacher, 10/10 would take again!

Great professor! Pretty easy class. I Never studied and received an A-. I believe if I had put more effort I could have received an A or A+ but this quarter was tough for me. For PSYC 105, the grading is hella easy. 60% exams (4 but one is dropped/optional) and 40% for small summaries/experiments. Lectures are really fun to attend and not boring.

He had really great lectures on Zoom, and a lot of our grades were very easy, just completing online experiments and writing a few sentences about some interesting short videos. Exams were fair and open book.

Highly recommend! His online lecture style is super creative and engaging, and he's great at communicating the material to students.

Homeworks are quick, easy, and engaging. Just doing a quick experiment online or watching some videos and writing a brief summary each week, and it's only graded by completion.

super kind!! he's incredibly passionate about the subject and his course layout was super flexible - we could drop our lowest exam. He responds quickly to emails and is very friendly and warm, 100% would take again!

He's definitely one the top professors within my list of best professors. The way he explains concepts in the lectures just radiates passion (I don't even know how that happens tbh) and even the difficult concepts are easily understandable within a lecture if not in the second part. I'm sure the contents are not easy but he explains really well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Such a knowledgable and amazing professor! He is really bubbly and explains class material very well. I loved his class layout a lot. If I could take this class again I would do it in a heart beat. I learned so many things about attention. I could easily apply what I learned in his class to the real world.

One of the best professors I have had. Was very lenient and understanding and let us drop on of our exams. He made the class really interesting and fun which kept me easily engaged with the content. He was able to connect many of his concepts to real life situations and made everything easily understandable. I would definitely recommend taking him.
best professor i've had at UCSD

class was pretty easy, drops lowest exam so i didnt have to take the final. lectrues are funny and engaging, stands up in front of slides on zoom, explains stuff very well. tests mostly from lectures.

Prof Brady made this class really interesting and fun. With online learning, it can get boring and tiring, especially for lecture heavy classes but the way he went through lecture slides made it quite easy to understand the material. 3 non-cumulative exams and 1 final. Lowest score out of those are is dropped. Easy assignments for non exam weeks.

he made online learning SO fun with his weatherman-style zoom presentations. tests are straightforward and fair, grading is easy (drops lowest exam). overall AMAZING prof. and cool that such a respected researcher teaches
Professor Brady is THE MAN. I would highly recommend taking his class. Tests are extremely fair, and his lectures are interesting.

Not sure why he is getting hate on the previous reviews. He is a super entertaining professor that is always enthusiastic about the subject. He is always willing to take questions during lecture. 2 midterms, 5 easy online labs, and a final. His questions really test your understanding on the concepts since they are very dense. Easy B class

Dang Some of the previous reviews are pretty harsh I think he's a great lecturer The subject may be boring for some, but you can tell he tries to incorporate class participation with his slides. The course involved easy computer surveys, 2 midterms, & a final. His exams are really dense. They are really going to test you on concepts. He's great
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a great professor! He seems very passionate about the subject, which keeps his lectures interesting and worth coming to. I took this class while taking PSYC 144 - Memory and Amnesia and they both overlap in many areas! So i highly recommend taking them at the same time, its great for studying.
It's kind of ironic that a guy who graduated from Harvard and M.I.T could be such a terrible teacher. puts everyone to sleep, Don't bother asking questions he's not going to take them.

He lectures well. Although his exams are incredibly dense. Each question is nearly a paragraph, and each choice is a large sentence. Exams require a substantial amount of time to simply read through and set up for those who have experience in the field - not students learning the context of Cognitive Psych. theory. If you do poorly 1st exam, drop.
Does not like to take questions in class. The dude is not really that good of a teacher.

Really passionate professor who does a great job trying to make class fun and interactive. There is a little bit of homework and in class quizzes. Exams were surprisingly hard considering how easy the quizzes were. Overall, an easy-ish class and a great professor

A very geeky humorous guy. Podcast lectures. Uses CourseKey. 7 easy quizzes and drops lowest scores. Notes are uploaded after class and lecture can be incredibly dense at times. The tests are fair but the answer choices are incredibly confusing and worded weirdly. That was my downfall. Seems to be a thing with others in the class as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He is very nice. The class is fun. it is Easy A- but you have to study for that.
He videocasted for this quarter, and either showing up to lecture or watching the videocasts was more than sufficient for exams. Just don't procrastinate
This professor is such a dad - as in the dorky dad humor. I highly recommend! He makes lectures fun. Also, class is optional since he podcasts. Though, his midterms can be difficult.

Professor Brady is a solid professor that really knows how to illustrate and elaborate on the many concepts of visual cognition. I'm not too sure though on the difficulty of this class being an "easy A" because I personally felt that the midterms were very difficult and somewhat over complicated. If you're looking for an easy A please avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: My favorite professor at UCSD. Very passionate about visual cognition so he makes his lecture very interesting!

He is very passionate about the materials, gives very interesting lectures, and the reading and videos required are actually fun and informative. The lectures has many fun activities, you actually want to go to lectures. Would absolutely take him again

Awesome guy, youll never fall asleep in class. He is very passionate about visual cognition and lively during lecutre. The material isn't difficult but it requires you to complete readings or videos before class. Quizzes and attendance is recorded on CourseKey, so you will have to purchase that for $20. Would absoultely take him again.

Brady is the best! His class is as straightforward as it gets- he never tries to trick you and actually cares if students enjoy his class. His lectures are dope because he includes a lot of cool examples/videos/demonstrations. He's also funny and dorky, you can't help but like him! Nice guy, good class, easy A- what's not to love?
Very reasonable workload/grading scheme, straightforward lectures + fair tests. Beware that post-midterm 2 material gets significantly harder so make sure to really study up before the final!!

Amazing Professor. Very active on piazza and hosts occasional office hours. You can tell that he wants you to succeed and cares for his students. Fair midterms, difficult final. Very generous curve. To succeed in this class, doing his practice finals, homework plus office hours and questions on piazza is good enough to pass exams. Highly recommend
Very nice, professor! Homeworks and midterms were very fair, but I felt that the final was much harder than the midterms. He is a good lecturer and is very responsive outside of class hours

Good Professor and very nice guy! His textbook is my favorite part as it isn't very mathematically savvy compared to other textbooks. Hard Final. Fair Midterms. I'd recommend really studying practice tests the most as most points lost come from missed proof steps, not correct answer. A lot of professor gate-keep exam info, he wants you to do well.

He was very good at explaining things, and grading wasn't harsh on missed structural points. Though there were some issues with explanations in a couple of lectures that had to be remote, it didn't hurt for the final too much (not that the final was easy - it had a 75-80% average).

An amazing professor!! He gave amazing lectures and explained everything well, although the course itself is challenging, especially after midterm 2. It is a reasoning math class, so you kinda need to write a short paragraph proof for each question, but the grading is very lenient. Overall, an amazing quarter with him, a very nice professor.

Literally the best professor I've ever had for math! Gave out review lecture notes and past midterms/finals before every exam. Although class may be very hard, just make sure to ask a lot of questions!!! After mid-term 2 is when this class got super difficult, and he started to pick up the pace dramatically, so be wary of that.

We can get practice midterm and final before test and we have cheat sheet. Homework and Exam grade reasonable. But professor Office hours are popular, you might see a small lecture on office hour before tests.

Chefs kiss, he really set the bar high on my expectations for math professor at UCSD. His lectures are amazing, his office hours are spectacular. He really cares about his students; always checking to see if people have questions. He makes sure you are equipped with everything you need to succeed in his class. I cannot recommend him enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great lecturer and explains concepts clearly. First half of the course was excellent but the end felt rushed with less depth. Midterms were fair but the final was much harder than the practice final and didn't match what we prepared for. Good professor overall, just expect a tough final.

Love him! His lectures are podcasted, he's super easy to understand, and the tests were relatively easy as long as you did the homework. Attendance is not required for lectures or discussions. As long as you take your time doing the homework and understanding it (roughly 15-20 problems per week), then you will do well on exams.
One of the best math professors I have had for calc! Very fair exams!

I really enjoyed having professor Buzaglo for calc 2. His lectures are great and detailed which made the class easy to understand and comprehend. His handwriting is also really clear which is always a plus with math professors. He is very caring and wants his students to succeed, he definitely made calc 2 easy and enjoyable even.

Honestly, he is the best math professor at ucsd for lower division classes. I am glad that I had the chance to take his class because I could not expect any math classes to get better than this. Very accessible during office hours, and he wants students to succeed. I do thank him from the bottom of my heart because he made calc 2 enjoyable.

By far the best professor for lower division math at ucsd. I am so happy that I have waitlisted for him and actually had the chance to take his class. Do keep in touch with Prof. Lucas because he will do absolutely everything to make you succeed in the class. He cares about his students a lot. GOAT!

One of the best Calculus professors I've taken at UCSD. His lectures are easy to follow and he does not rush through content. The exams were fair and followed the topics we covered in class. I highly recommend his class.
Very large curve, explains material very very well. By far the best prof that UCSD has seen for lower math classes. Always answers questions, and cares about his students.

I think this was his first quarter teaching. He's young so he seemed kinda confused at first. He's chill tho and is clear on his lectures. Only downside is he lectures w/ the blackboard which can make it hard to see. Provides lots of practice exams for midterms/final. Final got messed up but not his fault bc it was written by the math department.

Lucas is the best math professor at UCSD. His lectures are extremely clear and he provides tons of practice exams. His exams are  fair and he cares a lot about his students. I truly learn a lot from his lectures and I would take another class from him if I could. Trust me, if you have the option to take Lucas, take him, you won't regret it.

Very fair exams, helpful practice exams, great lecturer. I feel like I learned a lot from his class, and it was very manageable! I highly recommend this professor, and I definitely would take him again!
i would take any math class with this guy
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Usually struggle with math but he explains the concept well and way that is easy to follow. Whenever a concept is introduced / it uses a concept that we should have learned prior to this class or earlier the course, he would give a quick “Recall: “ and quickly explain how to do it. Many math prof wouldn't do this, but he goes over it effectively.

Buzaglo cares for his students a lot. He offers extra office hours during the week of the midterm/final and a review lecture before the exams. Everything that will be covered on the exam is explicitly stated, thus the exams are very fair. He is one of the best 10b professors.

By far the BEST professor in this school. Clear handwriting, amazing lectures, and always willing to answer questions during and outside class. Truly cares about his students and does his best to make the grading fair. Office hours are super helpful too. As someone who had not taken calc 1 in two years, he def facilitated my learning for calc 2.

Gave very straightforward lectures and homework and exams were very fair. Final was a lot harder which caught some of us by surprise. Only con was that we weren't allowed cheat sheets but it's understandable considering most questions are solvable with formulas. He was also very nice and answered any questions on piazza.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He shamelessly gave the common exam to his SI so they can make a practice exam similar to the real one for students in his class. His action was discovered and the exam was changed  to something harder for everyone. To compensate, he gave students got plenty of partial credits while students from other classes had low score due to a harder exam.

The best math professor at UCSD hands down. He is very caring and wants to make sure every student succeeds in his course. His review lectures before every exam were very helpful, and he advocated for students when our final got leaked by opposing rewriting the exam since the rewrite contained info that hadn't been covered extensively.

Great professor. I think it was his first year teaching the course but his teaching style made the content easy to comprehend. Though the course is quite test heavy, he uploads multiple practice exams to help prepare you for the actual ones. He tries his best to ensure that everyone can perform well through his generous grading system.

Fantastic professor! His lectures were clear and he provided plenty of examples to follow along. HW was hard but it was decided by the course organizer, not Buzaglo. Too bad the final was swapped to a harder one, but he gave us maximum leniency and plenty of partial credits. I did bad in the final but still got like a B+. Strongly recommended.
There was a grading error on canvas and he corrected it within an hour with a thorough explanation. The best 10b professor by far!
Very generous curve on the exam. GOATED prof. You have to take his class if you care about your GPA!!!

Professor Buzaglo is one of the best teachers at the math department. He has perfect command of the materials and presents them in a crystal clear manner. Too bad he doesn't have control over the homework but he has been going above and beyond to help his students. Too bad he got roped into all the bad politics at the math department.

My favorite math professor at UCSD! Clearly explained topics and review days and materials were always very helpful for the midterms and final exam. You can tell he truly wants all of his students to do well and will make sure you get the grade you deserve. Take Buzaglo if you have the chance, he's the best!!

His lectures were pretty good and easy to understand. Only cons imo were that he would write on the chalkboard which was kinda hard to see sometimes and that homework was sort of unreasonable at times but I don't think it's his fault since I'm pretty sure the department chair assigns what will be on the hw.

Very clear and concise with his lectures. Albeit a little too fast, he is able to teach everything we need for the homework/midterms and records lectures to refer back to later on. Also very approachable and gives useful clarifications for confusing concepts. Any issues I had in this class is more towards the department rather than the professor.

Lucas is an extremely good professor. He communicates his ideas clearly and makes sure that students aren't confused. His office hours are beneficial as he'll ensure you'll come out more confident than ever. His homework and exams are extremely fair and representative of the material taught in the lecture. Don't miss your chance to take him!

Very patient with students and provide great guidance for how to prepare for the exam. His office hours are always packed with students eager to learn from his wisdom. He's really a rare gem among the bath profs at UCSD.
So GOATed that people who had different professors came to his sessions and used his resources to better understand the material.
Goat prof!!! He alone carries the teaching staff and every student in 10B

Clear lecturer and super understanding! Even though he's a new professor at UCSD, I would totally recommend him. He makes his lectures super clear and concise and always provides helpful feedback on midterms and homework.

He's pretty chill and easy to understand in lecture, and always makes sure everyone has a general understanding of the material. He is pretty accommodating to students. His review lectures and practice exams are pretty helpful for the actual tests. I recommend.
He's the best prof for 10B. Too bad other profs are jealous of him and try to sabotage him. My thoughts and prayers to Professor Buzaglo!!!
Probably one of the most enjoyable math courses I've taken. Buzaglo made the content digestible and he really cares about our success. He made Math 10B somehow easier than Math 10A.

His lectures are very easy to follow. He explains things very well, and is always open to questions. His office hours are very helpful! He is very caring towards his students and always makes a genuine effort to help us understand the content. I would 100% recommend taking him for Math 10B!
practice exams were very similar to actual exams

I went into Math 10B really worried about my performance and how I would absorb material, but Prof Buzaglo made it really digestible. He has clear and easy to follow lectures, and is helpful during office hours. Also responds quickly to piazza posts, overall would definitely recommend!

Buzaglo made 10B much easier than I thought it would be! He is always very active when it comes to answering student's questions/ making sure we understand the material. He did his best to make sure we knew exactly what to study for midterms/final(rip). Lectures can move a little fast but what can u do. Highly recommend!!
a very good lecturer and very helpful, he truly wants you to pass and do well. goes over problems with you in office hours and answers any questions you have
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best math prof ever! I learn a lot from him. He gives plenty of practice problems and the exam that's exactly the same as the practice. I was able to get good scores following his practice. Too bad the math department swapped out the final exam without his consent, but he's fighting for us to get a good grade. Goat prof!

He's a great professor! His lectures are easily digestible. I enjoyed his way of teaching, it's simple. He's also very reachable outside of class. He answers very fast to piazza and emails. He also provided a lot of practice for exams which helped me a lot. A great professor!

Truly exceptional! He provides detailed notes, podcasts, and study guide. His practice exams are always spot on. Just follow his practice exams and you're guaranteed to do great on the real exam. Strongly recommended!!!

I definitely recommend tasking Professor Buzaglo. New professor, but definitely made it easy to learn and his lecture notes are goated. He provided practice exams before midterms and finals to ensure students had enough practice material. Midterms closely resembled the practice exams, and he promptly answered questions on Piazza. 10/10 overall.

A little awkward but his lectures were very clear and informational. The homework wasn't bad as long as you attended lecture and did the homework. His practice exams and exam guides made the midterms much easier to study for and do.

Lucas is definitely the best math professor I've ever had a class with. Lectures are very helpful and gives us the opportunity to ask questions. Lots of resources for exam prep are provided, although the question in the homework are harder than the exams.
Best prof for 10B this quarter. He gives practice exams that look just like the real ones. His notes are very organized and easy to follow.

Extremely great Professor, makes material simple and easy to understand. Uses whiteboards not a projector, when presenting notes. Always accessible outside of class, a kind and caring Professor in general. Would most definitely recommend a class with him.

Class itself takes a lot of effort to do well. Burg is very nice and will help you a lot if he sees you put in effort. Disorganized Canvas but not impossible to understand. Use all the resources to study for tests; you have to put in a lot of effort for the tests. Working with partner for lab themselves.

Made lectures engaging/interesting. Personally, I found studying from the discussion slides helpful for the exams. Grading scheme was fair and equally dependent on exams (which had a nice curve) and writing assignments. Took class over the summer and found workload very reasonable.

Whoever said this class was easy on here lied, so many different topics some barely even discussed in labs. There was no in person lectures so that doesn't help. Variety of topics you need to be able to actually know how to apply yourself to solve them rather than memorize. He was all over the place with when assignments were due also.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Basically 4 lab reports additionally the reviews make sure not to state how disorganized he is with all the information and data. Tests on content barley taught and not done in actual lab like gene transcription and random stuff. Literally mentioned a lab notebook check 2 nights before it was due including data we didnt even learn to calculate.

Burg was by far one of the best here at UCSD, his efforts to make you succeed in the course are huge. He is kind, funny, and so attentive during lab and has a very clear outline of what he expects of you on quiz's and exams. Def would recommend.
Seriously the best professor ever, he made this class very fun and was very clear about how he was going to test you and what he would test you on. He is wonderful and kind

The class is interesting but a bit content heavy. Lots of repetition to make sure the point gets across. Reports are part of the class but he gives enough time to write them. He's funny and genuinely tries to make things as easy to understands as he possibly can. Definitely recommend him to everyone who wants a bio class.

The lab appears long but its more waiting than anything. The lab is straight forward and he makes it clear as to what will be done. I would take another class with him if possible, and the extra credit is crazy. Very caring professor and I have nothing but good things to say about him !!
Oh man. Mr.Burg, you are probably the most memorable professor ive ever had. Love this dude

One of the most caring and funniest professors ive taken at UCSD. Extremely passionate in what he teaches. Slides are unorganized and they can be very overwhelming but most people succeeded by just paying attention to everything he wrote on the board. Exams are very straight forward and do not try to trick you. Def recommend everyone to take Burg!!
The class was very straightforward, he basically tells you what questions he's going to ask before the test

Burg is a very passionate, engaging professor who cares a lot about the subject, his students, and the greater world of academia. A little disorganized, but he emphasizes what you need to know. Would recommend going to OHs, if you go regularly he'll provide feedback and grade them (instead of reader/TA). Tests are reasonable if you put in the work.

Best prof i have taken. Wasnt easy, but got an A. He is a little picky on tests but given the tests to written assignment ratio, I believe he makes it fair AND engaging for students. So funny. Watch lectures, pay most attention to the blackboard, but also make sure to listen to catch minor details.

The kind of professor who is easy to over-rate. He's a really nice and personable guy who clearly knows a lot about the topic, I just wouldn't say he's good at teaching. Get ready for a lot of content and some confusion in lecture. Overall I would still recommend taking this course for the interesting content and Professor Burg's unique philosophy.
Disorganized lectures and terrible terrible TA

Highly recommend going to lectures in person if you can, he makes every class fun to go to, even if the content can be a bit dense. Grade is split evenly between papers and tests, which are curved too!. Really sad that him and other unit 18s aren't going to be teaching as much with budget cuts. If this course is offered PLEASE TAKE IT!

Burg has been one of my favorite professors ever , he is passionate about what he teaches and really does want to see his students succeed. His humor and enthusiasm during lectures makes them fun and enjoyable to watch. It is a tough class of course but as long as you study what he writes on the board you'll be good! Take him if you can!!!
Professor Burg is great! Took him for both BIMM134 and BIBC103 and he's super funny and knowledgeable. Class is not hard if you put in the effort and take advantage of professor/TAs.

I loved Professor Burg! The lectures were long but lively especially for 8am. Everything he tests on he writes on the board. I bombed the first final due to illness but the 3 papers cushioned my grade thankfully. He gives extra credit. He really helped me understand the intricate mechanisms of cancer. Take cell bio and physio before this class.
Amazing professor with so much passion. He is so sweet and wants you to actually learn. You have to put in a little work and memorization but not a crazy amount.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. He teaches thoroughly and the lectures are helpful. It is so funny when he needs "to take a drink of vitamin water" when he gets passionate about the content in lecture. Nice, caring, great teacher, I recommend. There are a few papers to write that are dense, but the rubric is very clear. There are also 2 exams in person.

Very clear on expectations in labs, papers, and exams. Great TAs, made labs very fun. One quiz, one midterm, one final, 3 lab reports--each worth more than the previous but gives great feedback and very open to helping. Would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at UCSD-- he actually cares about getting to know his students! Very clear on what he expects from his students and what we need to do to succeed in his class. Always willing to give extra help and shows that he wants his students to do well.

Professor Burg makes the class super engaging with his great sense of humor. While the lectures can be dense, attending pays off - he gives clear test previews. For study prep, Unstuck ai and the practice exams were lifesavers. Definitely take this class if you can!

Mike is a great guy with very clear guidelines for what he is testing for. However, his presentations and worksheets are pretty unorganized and even the final needed to be corrected while taking the test. Like many labs, a good TA matters and luckily Hannah was great. Overall, a good professor with some disorganized aspects
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Absolute GOAT of a teacher. Cared so much about students' success and was super passionate about cancer so he taught a lot of extra material to prepare you for his UD class. One midterm one final, throws lots of extra credit, phenomenal TAs, and he's very passionate about teaching. I would take him 10 times over if I could

Very entertaining, and informative lectures! pay EXTRA attention to everything he writes down on the whiteboard. Exams are content-heavy but very fair! Offers lots of extra credit opportunities if you aren't the best test-taker(1 midterm 1 final). OH's very helpful. Cares about his students and tries to make the class fun. Discussions on Zoom.

He's the best professor I've had at UCSD. He's super caring, funny, passionate, just everything you'd want in a professor. Tests have a lot of material, but are super easy if you just study what he tells you to.

Great professor, I learned a lot. Cancer biology requires a lot of memorization, but I found it manageable. The TA Juliana carried! She made possibly the best discussion slides I've ever seen. Although she graduated, she started posting on youtube (Shrewd Science).
Goat.

Although I'm not a Biology major, Professor Burg made the course enjoyable. He is a very funny person which makes the lecture very entertaining. However, his lectures are very material heavy. Would have him as a professor if I had to take another Bio course.

Professor Burg is amazing! His lectures are extremely understandable. His exams are exactly like the practice exam and the slides. I just memorized the concepts and practice exams and got good grades each time. Few homework. His TAs were extremely helpful! Gave us cookies for the final and candy for Halloween. Took him because I hate bio!
Prof. Burg is the best professor at UCSD theres really nothing else to say about him he is just great! Definitely take him if you can!

professor burg is so slay tbh. please go to lectures it's not that hard. he's super engaging and cracks awesome jokes. also, you can stay after class to ask clarifying questions which is important for tests. he tells you what's gonna be on the tests but still study. I'm not even a bio major and I LOVED this class. please take it if you can.

Professor Burg is an amazing biology professor. I learned so much in his class and he is so passionate about people understanding their options when confronted with cancer. He makes the class engaging and the exams aren't too hard and are very reflective of the course content. 100% recommend!

He is very human, funny, and obviously cares a lot about what he teaches. He was very transparent with what we could expect to see on assignments and exams. The way he presents material in lecture can sometimes be confusing/disorganized, but he makes up for it by extensively reviewing important content. I would 100% take another class with him.
Burg is amazing and super funny! If you have the opportunity to take his courses please take them!
Professor Burg is an amazing teacher and always makes the lectures fun and exciting!
Very easy class and lectures are clear. Tests are almost 100% based on what is covered in lectures.
Professor Burg is amazing! He made his class very interesting and is super caring. Be aware though, this class includes A LOT of information.

Burg was a fine professor. His handwriting is not good and he insists on writing on the worst chalkboard. Unless you want to sit in the front every single lecture, you will probably not be able to see very well. He also goes over things in a unique way that I'm not a fan of; however, I can see why people would like it. He's funny though.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I personally liked professor burg, but I would not take him if you are looking for an easy A. Going to lectures and sitting in the front is helpful because he writes everything on the board but his handwriting is all over the place. He prepares you pretty good for the tests because he always specifically says what's gonna be on it.

Prof Burg's passion for biology (esp. the kidney haha) is absolutely contagious. The exams are tough with a high curve. We had three long writing assignments, midterm, and final. A lot of things needed to 'memorize', or as he says, just learn. He is great at zooming out and connecting material. Spirited, funny. One of my fav Prof's.

Professor Burg is an amazing professor, and definitely one of my favorites at UCSD. His knowledge and passion for the topic of cancer is fascinating which makes the class enjoyable. Exams are straightforward and based a lot on what he writes on the board during lectures although attendance to lecture and section is not mandatory. Took for GE

I love professor Burg! As a non-STEM major, this course was not that difficult. Attendance is not mandatory although the exams are based on what he writes on the board. We had 2 research papers due, but not a lot of homework. Overall, he was a very funny guy, made the class interesting, and was easily understandable for anyone. Would take it again!

Excellent professor. You can tell that he definitely loves teaching biology, from the way he speaks with such enthusiasm. Burg is straightforward with the expectations for assignments, he will throw out a couple of fun facts but is clear about what will be on the exams. Took his class as part of a G.E requirement and loved it.

His lectures are awesome because he constantly updates the curriculum with the newest discoveries. He shares real world applications to the things we learn and makes things really interesting to learn. He emphasizes building tools to use for problem-solving in biological systems in general. He's also really funny.

The lectures were extremely unorganized and hard to understand. The midterm was okay but the final was terrible. Don't even get me started on the writing assignments, which had the most unclear grading criteria ever. If you go to your TA's OH, you can do well on those though. He is kind though, gave extensions and curved on the exams.

Professor Burg is a kind professor. Make sure you put work into his class and think critically about his exams and you'll do well. He also has a very nice curve!  Study his slides and what he writes on the board.

This is the third time I've taken a course with Dr. Burg. Although his lectures are a bit unorganized, study everything he writes on the board as those are guaranteed materials for his exams. His exams are fair, and the final is non-cumulative. There are a couple of writing assignments, but nothing too challenging. Attend office hours!

Professor Burg genuinely loved to teach molecular bio! He definitely has his own teaching style which can be confusing since he likes to write points on the board and goes out of order on lecture slides but if you review slides before class it'll be easier. Tests are hard but he wanted a majority of students to pass so gave a very generous curve.

He states that whatever he writes on the board will be on the final yet the entire final was a mess. The final is worth almost half of your grade. He gave 25 points ec however that will NOT save your GPA. Honestly he had the worst and most confusing lecture style I have ever witnessed. If you do take him make sure he's your last report.

Overall he is a great person but the material that he tests us on is just not what you expect before going to the test. He will challenge your brain way too harder than you think. If you have other option definitely go with that, but keep this professor as last resort.
He has been my favorite professor from my first year at ucsd. He is so passionate and makes the class very fun!

Dr. Burg teaches ok, but he is very hard to reach outside the class. Two research papers were required for the course, and they were graded based on everyone's performance. Tough grading on research paper, the TA graded me paper gave nonsense comments, and Dr. Burg refused to read my paper to double check because he said he believed his TA.
The class is def difficult but I really liked it. Burg is a really enthusiastic prof, but just fyi he sucks at responding to emails. His exams are really dense but also no surprises

He is really really enthusiastic when it comes to anything about cancer. Homeworks are boring. Tests are relatively easy. The final was all multiple choice, and the two midterms had some essay questions. The exams are just based on what he talks about in class, not the slides. So, go to class if you want to do well :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Burg is a perfect man. I took his cancer biology class to fulfill my general education. I didn't actually do well on tests because I am bad at biology, so I took his course as a PNP option. He cares for students a lot and always answer questions, and he is really enthusiastic of what he teaches.

BILD 32**Burg is funny & a good teacher. Go to class! What he covers in class is exactly what is on his tests. Grade is only dependent on 2 midterms, 1 final, and about 5 assignments, and your lowest test or assignment grade will not get dropped. The assignments r long so give urself time to complete them & the tests require a lot of memorization

Prof. Burg is a good professor and he cares about cancer A LOT, which is amazing. But theres a myth that this class is a relatively easy bio class, which is not true AT ALL. This class is harder than metabolic biochem, genetics, and molecular biology COMBINED. Theres only 1 midterm and 1 final. If you mess one up, you could never bounce back GL!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class material itself (BILD 1 and BILD 2) aren't hard, but you definitely still need to pay attention and watch lectures to get an A in the class. He doesn't do traditional powerpoint lectures but instead writes everything out on a board so you need to follow along to understand because just looking at the board will make no sense.

Second time taking a course with Professor Burg. Not as engaging as before since the course is completely remote. The content is comprehensible. A few writing assignments that easily doable but be aware of the readings. Exams are fair and are straightforward from Burg's lectures. This is class is manageable to earn an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great professor! You can tell he is really passionate about the subject which I appreciate. The class is not too difficult, but you'll also need to make sure you understand what he goes over in lecture. Overall, a really nice guy!

He was ight. Good guy and all, but the class is straight memorization off lectures. Some of the questions on his tests were Ph.D level. Overall, not that difficult, very little homework, and fairly easy to grab an A or a B in the class. The lectures are the only annoying part since so much info is crammed into them. I'd recommend taking him, though

What can I say about this class? Couple assignments that aren't graded harshly, a curved midterm, and a final. The entire course is straight memorization, you either know it or you don't - simple as that. Overall, easy workload, and would take Burg again if he's offered for my upcoming classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: You can really tell just how passionate Burg is about oncology. His class includes knowing the detailed molecular pathways/causes of cancer. If you can understand the mechanisms, you're golden. One curved midterm, a few easy assignments, extra credit, and the final were the components of our grade. I'd take this class again in a heartbeat.

Highly recommend Burg! His lectures have a lot of info. (esp. for summer session), but he's clear on what he wants us to know. Tests are fair and represent the material. Plenty of EC and assignments that are pretty much guaranteed pts. Discussion sections are useful to understand the content. One of the best professors I've taken so far!

Here's what you need to pass: MEMORIZE and UNDERSTAND the cancer stuff. This molecular bio class revolves around cancer. His tests are easy if you memorize stuff. I took this class online during COVID-19. He gives you OPTIONAL homework problems, as well as fun assignments like writing papers. He's a great guy. He doesn't make you learn extra stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I've taken him for BILD 2 and he was/ is very entertaining and is VERY clear with what you need to know for the exams. He goes over concepts and topics repeatedly in lecture and it's very helpful to have it all laid out for you. A very caring professor that wants you to learn, as well as enjoy biology.

prof burg is amazinggg. He's super chill and you can tell he enjoys teaching this course a lot cuz he LITERALLY gets excited about the material haha. You will need to study realy hard cuz he covers a lot in class (well, summer ses), but he's super straight-forward with the exam questions and you'll learn so much. Recommended!!

His class had no clickers and he didn't podcast at the time, but he basically gives you what you need to know for the exams. He is very straightforward and tells you what you need to know for the exam. Very funny and actually cares about his students!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took Burg for BIMM 100 my second time around and he actually breaks down what we're talking about instead of assuming we know. Don't expect to learn if you just watch his podcasts because you wont be able to follow if you're not there. Overall great guy and taking his BIMM 134 Cancer class because of how passionate he is about this subject.

Had him for BIMM101, decided to take him for a lecture-focused course and although he is a bit all over the place, section helps a ton to summarize the important points. Do his study guides for exams that he posts, they reflect exactly what he'll ask on exams. I would trust his study guides > review sessions, but the reviews are still good help!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I think BIMM 100 is molecular biology, but he makes it more cancer and disease class. He is really a great guy that been said if U don't have strong information about molecular biology, I don't really recommend him for you because he involved 60-70% just about cancer & diseases, but if you like to learn about cancer I definitely recommend him for U
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: Great guy and fair professor. His version of bild 1 focuses on cancer more than others, which made it much more interesting. He is super passionate about what he lectures on and creates easy/fair tests. I got a B, but it was really just because I never went to class and had limited bio experience. If you go to 5 discussions you get extra credit too

He is the worst professor I have ever taken at UCSD. He is super disorganized and he does not know his material at all. All the students are confused in the lab. He leaves all the explanation to the TA and the TA does not explain anything. I am so upset about this class. Please do not listen to the good rate he has.

Professor Burg is one of the best professors I have ever had. His midterm and final are super fair. As long as you go to lecture and take notes, you will be completely fine for the exams. He does not take attendance but writes mainly on the board so attendance is recommended. He gives like 2/3 assignments but they are super interesting and easy.

Professor Burg is one of the best professor that Ive ever had. His lectures are both interesting and informative. You can definitely learn a lot from the lectures and will enjoy the process of learning. Almost every question from the tests comes from the lectures. He is so nice about the grades that students from 90-98 can all get an A.

Grades based on total points so exams not weighted. Extra credit for >80% cape and attending 5 discussions. Really entertaining and funny so the lectures did not feel dreadful at all. Tells you everything you need to know for exams in class & provides practice problems which most were actually on the exam or very similar! Podcasted+no txtbk needed

Absolutely Amazing! Mike is amazing, passionate and has a great sense of humor. His tests are straightforward. He doesn't throw curveballs. His finals are not cumulative and he gives you assignments that are only going to help your grade. Lecture attendance is not mandatory and you get extra credit to attend discussions. Definitely recommended!

Burg is a great and funny professor! The class is really easy as long as you attend class or listen to his podcast because everything he says or writes will be on the test. The test isn't too hard if you put some effort to study. He assigns writing assignments that are time-consuming and little tedious but they aren't bad. Highly recommend him.

I really like this professor, he really cares about his students and his lectures, especially towards the end of quarter are interesting. If you want to succeed in his midterms and finals, get ready to read all of his assigned his readings and pay attention in class or rewatch the podcasts. There are easy writing assignments but tedious.

Burg was one of the easiest teachers. He is very passionate about teaching, but also podcasts so you don't have to attend class. Tests are like the practice test he gives and the questions are very straight forward. Everything you need to know is in the articles he assigns and his lectures, nothing else. Would 10/10 recommend

Burg cares about his students -- comes around during the lab period to facilitate conversations about our experiments to help us think about the theoretics behind the lab protocol. Super approachable professor, and extra credit CAPE opp (do it). Lab protocol is super easy, be prepared to run thru your experiments in detail so you don't have to redo

Burg is such a fun dude, he really cares about what he teaches and keeps it interesting. all text were noncumulative and discussions were not mandatory but get extra credit for attendance. I had a great TA and it really helped me out. he doesn't do +/-
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this class during the summer. Lecture is not mandatory but I would recommend attending because he tells you everything you need to know for the exam. He also makes great drawings/schemes on the board that help you understand the material. 1 midterm and 1 final - mostly MC and 2 short responses. Lots of extracredit. Also, he is funny!

A great professor who is extremely passionate about what he teaches! He is constantly looking up information on breakthroughs in bio and keeps his material up to date. His lectures are interesting as he writes stuff on the chalk board that will be on the test. He offers a good amount of extra credit too and doesn't fail to make the class laugh.
He does podcats, but he usually draws on the board which are hard to see through the podcast. He was a really good and solid professor and his tests are extremely fair. Would recommend.

Mike is actually such a cool dude. He tells you the ups and downs of the course from the beginning. I got a B+ but only because I didn't go to lecture since Week 3. But I definitely recommend going to lecture and review sessions!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is very funny, he always cant stop laughs at the jokes he made by himself, which is very funny to me and I feel funny is how he makes himself funny.A great teacher with newest materials and frontier research, it worths for you to take him

Love this dude! Class is content heavy but tells you whats important for tests. Podcasted but attendance is encouraged bc it helps grasp the subject. Lectures are interesting and he's passionate about it. He brought cookies to the final lecture! Offers EC if you go to discussion too. Def take him if he's teaching a class you need!

Genuinely cares about student success. Great review sessions, video podcasts, no required textbooks. He tells you what you need to know and what is just fun information. He is the only professor that doesn't put me to sleep. I mostly watched his podcasts and still managed a B+ with minimal studying.
Hilarious teacher. Provides practice tests that are similar to actual. Exams aren't too difficult. Podcasts. No clickers. Not much homework. Will be taking him for as many bio classes as possible.

Professor Burg has been hands down one of the best teachers I've had at UCSD. His class moves quickly(esp. after midterm 2) but he podcasts & his enthusiasm for the subject makes class enjoyable. He actually teaches you about the material so you learn about it, not just memorize it. I'm a bio major but have never enjoyed any BILD class before his.

Burg is one of the best professors I've had here at UCSD. He's really enthusiastic about what he teaches and it really reflects as his lectures are super entertaining. The material is challenging and there is memorizing, but it is definitely possible to do well in his class. Take Burg for every bio class if possible! He's great!!!

Mike is such a great professor! This class was very enjoyable with interesting lectures, easy to follow diagrams and great explanations. He gives great practice tests and reviews before the midterms! The tests were similar to practice exam and lecture examples. Super funny professor and I highly recommend taking him!!!

I loved taking Mike's class! He simplified difficult concepts using plenty of practice and figures (great if you're a visual learner). He helps you understand the material rather than just memorize it. Tells you whats on exam so pay attention in lecture! EC + cool video assignments. I had so much fun with this class, thanks to his teaching style!
Honestly, Mike Burg was one of the most fantastic teachers i've ever had on campus, and has inspired me to like biology even more.

Mike is insanely awesome. I enjoyed every minute of his lectures. His tests are very easy as long as you write down whats on the board. Go to his office hours and hell help you on every aspect youre confused on. His teaching style is different and makes you think in a different way which is what is so fascinating about his lectures.

Easy A if you understand what he says in lecture and writes on the chalkboard. I love his enthusiasm bc it made it easier to pay attention. No hw except a 5 page easy paper on a disease. also, HIS FINAL ISNT CUMULATIVE

You can tell he's extremely passionate about what he teaches. He's really funny and chill, always looked forward to going to his class! He also doesn't require a textbook and you don't really have to go through the powerpoint slides, just pay attention in class & go over podcasts to do well! Really fair grader and the final wasn't cumulative.

Dr. Burg is a great professor and down-to-earth guy and I would recommend taking him! This course has been my favorite class I've taken and has made me truly enjoy bio. He can be all over the place when teaching, but he breaks up the material very clearly and makes lecture fun! There are no podcasts and 3 exams, lots of USEFUL EC, and no curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Awesome professor, awesome guy! He really really (really) cares about his students and gives every opportunity to do well in his class.
