Lectures are a bit confusing, but if you go over your notes and review the lecture slides, he explains concepts very well. Tests are very fair and are an accurate representation of what was learned in class.

Very enthusiastic about what he teaches. No textbook needed/ no podcasts, so you need to go to his lectures. Everything he writes on the board/ discusses will be on the test. He usually reviews the last lecture before to know the most important topics. Always smiling/wants people participating. Would love to take his class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Burg has a great sense of humor and a passion for all things biology. You will learn how to design your own experiments and investigate different hypotheses. Note of caution: TA's can vary in quality. Make sure that you ask your TA for their SPECIFIC grading criteria, otherwise you may be disappointed with how your lab reports are graded.

The greatest perspective of Professor Burg is that he has a really nice curve. 90% is a solid A, not even a minus. But for his lab classes, he has a few undergrad TAs who are not so proficient in teaching lab techniques and their communication skills need improvements. Also, be careful that scrupulous details are required in lab reports.

Very great lecturer. Lectures are entertaining and present the materials quite well. Exams are fair. BIBC 103 has two really long papers that need quite a lot of time to finish. BICD 134 has a lot of material that needed to be memorized but the final is not cumulative. Will bump up your grades if you are at borderline, ex: 89  A. Don't give (-)s.

Out of all the teachers I had at UCSD, this professor is by far the best I have had. If youre a visual learner and learn by looking at the board, I recommend him. He kept my attention with his enthusiasm for this subject. You learn about the cell (something I find so boring), and he taught it in a way that kept me interested.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: The class goes through a lot of content so especially if you haven't taken AP Bio make sure to review material after every class. The professor's grading is very fair and tests aren't too hard. He even has a generous curve. Towards the end of the quarter there's a research paper to hand in about a disease of your choice. I enjoyed the class overall

MICHAEL BURG IS AMAZING! I am planning all my classes just so I can take him again! He is such a great professor! By far, the best professor at UCSD. He makes everyone else look terrible in comparison! He is engaging, intellectual, thought-provoking, fair, and respectable! I love everything about this professor. He really cares and will help you!

Straightforward tests. Whatever he covers during class is fair game for the test. Doesn't require textbook, which was nice. I haven't taken bio since freshman yr of high school, and managed to get an A. Other than tests, the written assignment wasn't too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He's very understanding of our situation as students- none of the tests were cumulative, and the course material was geared toward what he wanted us to get out of the class and apply to the rest of our lives. Lectures were kept interesting through his humor, and while he loves conspiracies, he also loves biology. I felt I learned a lot.

Amazing professor! He is very funny and focuses on topics that are actually interesting and useful! His lectures were interesting and very engaging because of his easy-going attitude and great sense of humor. They also ended early most of the time. He tells you EXACTLY what you need to know for tests during lectures, so make sure you attend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: No need to buy textbooks. Materials are provided online and super ample for studying all the contents covered in the exams. He is humorous on the lecture and worked very hard as he persisted giving lectures even when some problems happened to his voice. I give him a thumb up. Good choice for GE requirement. A is super easy.

Enthusiastic teacher, but unfortunately the grade in this class is based upon a student's performance in three areas: taking exams (critical thinking problems on the material are the norm), essay writing, and going to lecture/discussion. I wish it would have been modeled better, with some problem sets to defray the insane impact of the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Topics covered are engaging and prevalent; we went over the Human Genome Project, stem cell research, and cancer topics. Mike had the ability to keep the class engaged with a sense of humor. Overall easy class; just going to lecture should be more than enough to get an A. He doesn't give minus grades and the final was not cumulative.

I love his humor, and his voice is audible and catching. Also, he is so good at explaining and, especially, at simplifying; he is not afraid to use the colloquialism.  The first two chapters consist quite a few videos, and the tests have the most basic questions that check if you had watched. I learn that way, but I also heard complaints about that

The easiest bio class I ever took in my life.  Great teacher who teachers very well and lets you know what exactly you need to know for the test.  He uploads "practice tests" online that you can take and they are basically the exact same questions as the actual tests.  He shows a lot of videos in class and often lets the class out 30 minutes early.
Doesn't overwhelms you if you aren't a Biomajor

This is a difficult course but he does a great job explaining everything and keeping the material interesting. He has research experience in cancer, and it is his passion, so you'll learn a lot about it. There were 2 midterms, a minigrant 4 pg paper, and the final. Going to discussion is highly recommend to do well in the class. Overall great prof

Mike is probably my favorite professor here so far. He kept 8AM lectures entertaining and was very straightforward about what he wants you to get out of the course. Going to class is essential because he only tests on material from lecture, no books necessary. Overall great guy and I'd love to take him again.

Dr. Burg is an excellent professor and a really kind man. He is highly intelligent and expects a great deal out of his students. His 8 am lectures are entertaining...I have never skipped his class and if you do skip class, you probably wont pass because he tends to go over everything that will be on the test during class. Would take again!!!!!!!!!!

He's a funny and easy teacher. In lecture, he writes down everything you need to know for the test on the board with diagrams and example problems. He is very nice and willing to answer questions. I recommend him!
Dr. Michael Burg is great! I attended ALL of his 8 am classes and I live off campus!!! Great lecturer! Two thumbs up!

its me again. So Prof burg teaches us upper division material and tells us we should take BIMM 100 next quarter. LET ME JUST ENLIGHTEN YOU, THAT BIMM 100 HAS PREREQUISITES WHOSE PREREQUISITES ARE BILD 1. THIS MAN IS VERY VERY VERY NICE. EXTREMELY NICE THAT THIS ALL JUST DOES NOT MAKE SENSE. HE IS EXTREMELY INTELLIGENT AND FUNNY THO SO ITS CHILL!!!

Prof. Burg is a great professor. His exams are tough but if you study for them you should do well as he covers all the material he puts in his exams and is more than happy to go over whatever material you don't understand. Nice man, good professor, highly recommend him.

I did all the reading for this class, (which you should not do- it's irrelevant!), went to all the lectures, and his office hours, and I still got a C!  He lectures WAY too fast, so I couldn't really absorb the material.  He also doesn't use a textbook, which sucks.
Challenging exams but generous curving.  He is very nice.
Drop before it's late. Hard tests not enough time. Stupid curve. Test is based on the stuff that was not covered in class. Nice guy though

Took him last quarter. He talks really fast and it's hard to keep up with him but he is always entertaining. Read the book and GO to the review. I got an A with the curve even though I skipped a few classes, never looked at the handouts, and never went to discussion.

I really enjoyed this class. His lectures were very clear and to the point. However, his exams are a different story. His exams are time-based which means he'll throw a ton of easy/medium difficulty questions at you in a given time limit. If you are not good under pressure, then this professor is not for you. I actually found it challenging and fun

Definitely one of the easier BILD 2 professors. He lectures fast and zooms through concepts, so you have to be paying attention. 0% of the material is from the textbook, but 100% of the material is from his lecture slides/handouts. Which is fine, because he provides study guides for you anyway.

I really liked this professor! He is passionate about biology, esp the kidney. People complain that he is a tough prof, but if you read over his lecture slides and do the study questions, you'll be set! Plus he doesn't give any -'s! Plus he adds around 8-10 pts (midterms atleast) to your raw score=curve which is great too. TAs were helpful too.

I cannot believe people think his BILD 2 class is difficult. The tests are so straight forward and the curve is VERY generous. He averages the exams and makes that a B-. All you have to do are know his lecture notes and study guides really well and it would be pretty hard not to get an A with a 9 or 12 point curve added to each exam.

I really like Burg. He is very enthusiastic and makes you want to come to class! He makes me actually want to learn about biology and he shows fun videos. I would definitely take him again. I just wish he would make his tests easier, but if you really understand the handouts he gives you, you'd be set because he specifically tells you what to know

I don't understand some of these comments...I took his genetics class last quarter and it was pretty easy, especially if you study. He also gave 15 points of extra credit for basically nothing, and he gives +s, but not -s, which is very helpful. Also, I was able to finish every one of his tests early.

Prof Burg has interesting lectures, he's very enthusiastic, and provides a lot of helpful hand-outs.  But it sucks that he doesn't use the textbook at all, because I never know what to do for hw.  Last quarter I read every chapter in Campbell & Reece and got an A.  I'm still reading every chapter, but this quarter, I'll be lucky to get a B-.

I took BICD 100 with this guy, and now I'm taking BILD 2 with him. The key here is to be FULLY PREPARED when taking his midterms. They take a lot of time, yes, but if you have a grasp on the material, then you shouldn't spend several minutes on one problem. He provides study guides and does an excellent review session where he goes over everything.

Believe me, i've taken several genetics class before but Burg's exams are just plain RIDICULOUS!!! I barely had enough time to read all the questions, yet alone answer them all! This guy needs to go back teaching community college.

he's a nice guy but not worth taking... his exams are very long and very difficult.. he teaches bild2 at the level of mamm. physiology... how do i know? HE USES THE MAM PHYS BOOK as a basis for his lectures. his tests cover more than his lectures do. he talks &flips through slides way too fast... bild shouldnt be this hard...

Take this professor as a last resort.  His midterms are unrepresentative of his lectures mainly because he gets so excited that he can't cover all the material.  They're long and difficult, so you have to memorize his notes inside out.  He talks too fast and uses too many diagrams so its hard to take notes by hand OR computer.

ok i was struggling quite a bit in this class but not because he's a bad teacher or his tests are unreasonable, I just totally underestimated this class. it's a lot of work, a lot of memorization. His tests are long and you need to do ALL the math hw prob in order to retain the material

Professor Burg has been one of my favorite professors thus far. He is very kind, and extraordinarily helpful (he helped me on a Saturday once for 4 extra hours). The class was very interesting, and he was very clear. Tests are hard to get used to, though. Content is average, but it is incredibly time-limited!! Work ALL THE RECOMMENDED CH. PROBLEMS!

He does give you all you info you need to know in the class andis friendly, but he had timed tests. If you can't complete the tests within the required time...try harder. I'm someone who needs a  lot of time to go over the questions carefully, if I'm rushed, then I panic haha. I didn't do well in the class, but I could have tried harder.

2 Midterms + 1 Final, offered 15 pt of EC. The 2 midterms were incredibly long, but doable if you attend lecture and study his study questions/handouts/ppt thoroughly. On the flip side, his final was all MC, short, and generally easy. Good professor, hard to keep up with what he's lecturing about though.

don't complain about failing if you didnt attend his lectures. he tells you exactly what you to know. this is an easy class, and if you cant pull off genetics with a good teacher like prof burg then you shouldnt be majoring in bio

The previous poster must be failing the class. The handouts are clearly on webct. He posts literally the course on webct for that matter. He is a really nice guy, gives pretty tough tests that require you to know alot, and know it well. Exams are pretty much regurgitation of processes.

His tests are terrible with a good amount of typos and bad wording. He says at the beginning that class is optional and that he will post everything online but then he gives out a bunch of handouts and shows a movie without including any of them online. Don't waste your time with him.

"Dont judge a book by its cover," He looks nice, but thats a "HELL" no. Sure his a smart guy, but he doesn't like teaching, infact his not even good at it. Give him a lab at ucsd, and hire a prof who wants to TEACH! uhggg

I don't know what to make of this guy exactly... First exam was easy and long, 2nd exam was shorter but had a bunch of reject calculations that no TA nor himself ever mentioned when reviewing. He is a very nice guy, though and means well. He could at LEAST curve the average a little higher than just a 78%...So far, 40F's,70 D's, 110 C's as a result
you will not have enough time to finish your test. Do not rely on curve. you think you learned everything but once you see the test...
No Comments

Participate 1x a week. 1 excused absence per quarter. 20% participation 20% attendance. Go to class and pay attention and you'll get an A. There's like maybe 1 chapter of reading per week which takes like 20 minutes if u actually read it (you should), 5 quizzes total. make sure to read instructions carefully on assignments for full credit!

Participate 1x a week. 1 excused absence per quarter. 20% participation 20% attendance. Go to class and pay attention and you'll get an A. There's like maybe 1 chapter of reading per week which takes like 20 minutes if u actually read it (you should), 5 quizzes total. make sure to read instructions carefully on assignments for full credit.

Easy class and great professor. Assignments are light if you follow directions. 5 quizzes sprinkled throughout the quarter, all quizzing on the book. You get assigned into a group and work with them throughout the quarter so make sure you sit by cool people.

Very interactive, participation is extra credit, lots of hands on examples, weekly kahoots, attendance before and after class. Exams are very application based, a little difficult. Weekly problem sets as homework. The professor is super funny and sweet. Love this class
Attendance and participation is mandatory but his lectures are very interesting and he makes accommodations for students who are shy

I've taken MGT16 and MGT 181 from him, and he's good at what he does. You can tell he wants to teach and challenge students. MGT181 was more math-heavy but it's not too bad, he does teach concepts quick though. For MGT16, it's a much easier class. Assignments for either class aren't difficult but participation does matter to him! So show up!

Professor Buchanan knows how to teach his students! You learn the content outside of class through his prerecorded lectures and do practice problems in class. This system really helped me with the tests, and his class was honestly super fun. Attendance is mandatory, but you can also earn extra credit on your tests if you participate.

Mandatory attendance. He does a flipped classroom so all you do in class are examples and kahoots. This is a hard subject but not impossible. I wish I kept up and didn't cram learn it all before exams, I could've done a lot better but I still came out with a B- studying 2-3 days before exams. HW due before every class, not bad tho.

The class was manageable, but the teaching style felt condescending and overly technical at times. I also didn't like that we couldn't review our exact homework or exam questions, which made it harder to learn from mistakes. The TAs offer similar problems, but not the originals. I'd recommend taking someone else if possible.

Attendance is mandatory and you must participate (raise your hand at least once a week). You get one unexcused absence. Assignments and reading take a bit but are easy. Weekly quizzes that aren't bad if you read the book & attend class. If you put the work in it is fairly easy to get an A.

Participation and attendance is 40% of the grade, but he makes getting participation extremely easy and it shouldn't be a problem for most people. He is fair and the content is very interesting. The assignments are all pretty easy, as well as the quizzes, and the final is only a reflection.

This is definitely not an easy topic but Buchanan tries his best to not only have his students succeed but understand the material too. Your grade really depends on his exams, but he does curve when the average is low and offers lots of resources!

Bi-weekly quizzes that you must read AND understand the book for. Simple and straightforward assignments. I looked forward to his class and the content was really interesting. Participation is really important and it might seem intimidating to speak but he is very encouraging. Loved the coffee chat opportunities!

Mandatory attendance and participation. Weekly reading. Quizzes are at the end of the class and he goes over test answers right before the quiz, he looks for specific terms and words on the test but if you hit on those points it should be a breeze. Barely any studying done, just show up to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Heavy participation and attendance that bothers me a lot. You have to answer questions or have reflections almost each class to get full participation credits. But the content is interesting though, he's a good lecturer and easy to get in touch with. Quiz not hard but you do need to read the book and understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: took this in fall24. amazing and engaging lectures and the assigned book reading is super interesting as well. it is very quiz heavy, so if you get one question completely wrong, you'll probably end up with a C on it. i alsodidn't enjoy the mandatory participation because it's clear he shows favoritism towards certain students

Participation and attendance is mandatory, however you will look forward to going as the class is very interesting. Guidelines for assignments and quizzes are strict, but if followed you will easily earn an A in the course. Also, Professor Buchanan is so easy to talk to outside of class and gives great advice!

3 exams with cheat sheets. V easy class overall make sure to pay attention in lecture esp to the example problems. lots of EC. write cheat sheets for the exam & it will be an easy A. he's a strict guy but nice just has expectations of how to act in the classroom. anybody who thinks he's mean is overreacting tbh. very nice guy to talk to one-on-one

He is an AMAZING professor, probably my favorite one at UCSD. He is such a good lecturer and his class is so interesting. I would take his class again and again! Attendance is mandatory and you do need to participate.

Professor Buchanan rules! Had him for my first MGT class at UCSD and he was so fun and caring. I usually hate attending lectures, but his were actually engaging. If you attend class you'll pass no problem. He's also super fun to debate with but also makes sure he doesn't upset you and wants to know we're all just here to learn. Great dude!

Campbell >>> Buchanan. Makes you go through so many useless hurdles when doing work; ex: participation is graded, some homework is turned in as a 5 minute video of you speaking, only 1 excused absence allowed, if you're late by 1 minute it's counted as an absence.

Took this class pass/no pass as an "easy"  class, very much regret the prof I chose.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Buchanan is one of my favorite professors at UCSD. His lectures are very engaging and he facilitates an environment based on critical thinking. Whether you have had experience in ethics in the professional world or not, you are sure to come out of this class with a new, insightful view of the world that we are living in.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Definitely my favorite professor so far. The material is very interesting and the professor makes the class engaging. If you keep up with the reading and participate in class, its an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Probably one of the best professor's I've had at UCSD. His lectures are very engaging and meaningful. Class participation is required but it is easy and he makes it a point to pick on everyone who raises their hand. Quiz's can be hard if you don't study or pay attention but as long as you do the work, you will pass. Highly recommend this class.
Test heavy and grading tough. I will not take it anymore.

Great teaching style and class structure, participation in class is for extra credit (not mandatory) and the questions are always easy, it just feels like a fun game show. He mixes in real financial advice, like how to invest in index funds and is really funny. I look forward to class, material simple and exams straightforward. 3 MC Midterms

I took MGT 181 with Professor and Buchanan and had the best time ever in that class. Lectures were engaging and the real-life examples really helped in understanding the course material. He really cares about students succeeding in the class and at investing. Overall 10/10

Hello! If you're an incoming student debating whether to take Professor Buchanan's class, do it. He's one of the best professors I've had. The class is engaging, with real-world examples that clarify concepts. Tests are straightforward—pay attention, participate, and you'll do great. Professor Buchanan truly cares about students' success!

Prof. Buchanas is just a dude that worked in finance and knows a lot, so he is happy to teach it now. Very traditional, which I don't personally mind, but he doesn't allow phones and wants everyone to participate. Attendance is not mandatory, but you get extra credit for attending and more extra credit for talking.

If you're not into public speaking during lectures, your grade might take a hit. There are lots of tests, and they're pretty intense. Honestly, I didn't feel like I learned much in this class—just felt stressed and nervous about the lectures. If you really need MGT 16 for some reason but want easy A, I'd recommend going with a different professor.

I took had professor Buchanon in the Spring of 24 for his MGT 181 course. He offers a great deal of insight outside of the course material itself and have found his teachings far more applicable than other courses in the MGT/Economics realm. Also boasts quite the sense of humor and was more than accomodating throughout the quarter.

Professor Buchanan is by far one of my favorite professors in UCSD. He seems intimidating at first, but as time passes you realize he's actually a really chill guy. He made finance concepts easy and fun to learn, this was definitely one of my favorite classes I've taken. He also gives lots of extra credit so make sure you participate in class!

Super chill class and prof. Quizzes every other week (no midterms or final) fully based on lecture or the book, easy as long you read the chapters (I got 100s on every single one and read them the night before). Attendance and participation are super important, but the TAs will mess up and not give points then refuse to fix it. Overall easy tho

Great professor. Can come off as strict but he prepares his students effectively for the professional world. He truly cares about his students and is accessible outside of lecture. The quizzes can have difficult questions that have not been covered in lecture, if you study, have a good crib sheet, should be fine. Most useful class I've taken.

He attributes his bad reviews to the fact that those students got a bad grade. I am expecting an A but still believe that he is rude and condescending for no reason. He honestly picks and chooses with his "raise your hand once" rule, calling on some students many times but then rudely saying to others not to speak again if they already have.

Professor Buchanan is a mediocre professor that cares a lot about his own pride. He has a bias for certain students and treats people he doesn't like very poorly. Attendance policy is also extreme, avoid taking this class if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: You know it's bad when people are in class crying after taking the quizzes.The quizzes are very difficult, even with reviewing the slides and doing the practice problems. Expect to spend 6+/hrs a week studying. Very stressful class and its a shame that a professor with such great explanations has such unnecessarily difficult quizzes.

MGT 16 with Professor Buchanan was quite easy, however, just be prepared to read a lot. No midterm or actual "final," but multiple quizzes throughout the quarter based on lectures and readings. Participation is about 20% of your grade so be prepared for that. Regardless, Professor Buchanan was a great professor and his lectures was thorough.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Loved the class and prof!! Attendance and participation heavy- definitely read the text. However, it's an easy read and the class discussions are very engaging. He does reflections so you can plan what you want to say and TAs are understanding with grading. One attendance pass, keyboard device for quizzes, and your perspective is going to expand
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Buchanan has amazing lectures and gives students many opportunities to participate and engage in the conversation at hand. He is strict in the way that you can not be late to class or else you will be marked absent. However he is a very understandable professor, as long as the circumstances are reasonable.

Do not take this class if you are afraid to raise your hand or speak. This class teaches you confidence, as in business it really is important to share your ideas when necessary. Buchanan is blunt, but it's what makes him a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: overall good teacher, beware of readings for the quizzes those will definitely pop up. participation is absolutely mandatary and as long as you dont do anything too obvious that isn't a part of class in your laptop you should be fine. The class was an easy A and the teacher was enjoyable to listen to
no

Seriously, this was one of the easiest classes I've taken. As long as you pay attention during lectures and actively participate, you're set. Attendance and participation count a lot for your grade, so show up on time and get involved. The quizzes are straightforward, and you can get by with just a brief review of the chapters. Overall, Great Prof!

Amazing professor! Get ready for attending every single class and read, then you will get an straight A! Easy homeworks and amazing lectures, the case studies are always interesting. No midterm, just several quizes. Just take his class!

Great professor and makes lectures interesting and enjoyable. Attendance and participation are mandatory and a big part of the grade so as long as you show up to class you should be good. There are readings once or twice a week but they are usually no longer than 10 pages. Overall great professor and really enjoyed his class.

It is participation and attendance required but as long as you participated its an easy A. No midterm and final only weekly quizzes as long as you read you're good. And lectures are fun and easy going

Professor Buchanan's lectures were always interesting and made the mandatory attendance not so bad. He was super cool to talk to as well, and cares for his students. p.s. make sure to not use phones in class and definitely read the readings because quizzes are heavy in that material!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: No final, instead did biweekly quizzes. However, the quizzes could be quite challenging because they were only 20 minutes. Attendance is very much mandatory and he has assigned seating based on where you sit on the first day. Homework and textbook reading is due for every class. No much extra credit and no curve.

Definitely take this class. it is easy if you try. He is very stubborn and strict, but you just have to ignore that. the class itself and the way he teaches is super easy. He explains things super well. Attendance is mandatory but you dont have to participate like in the past, just show up. theres also a calculator you have to buy.

Sit in the front of the class! Mandatory attendance is a problem sometimes, but make an impression and talk to him about it (TA's likely get your grade wrong). Knowledgeable and interesting lectures. Really cool prof outside of class, but comes off as strict. Read textbook definitions and practice problems and you'll be good on quizzes. EZ hw.

Very straight forward class. Gives you all the materials to get a good grade. Make sure to attend lectures and read the slides. Grades are based on Quizzes, Homeworks and attendance. Quizzes and Homeworks are representative of everything seen. 10/10 would love to have another class with him.

Buchanan comes off as very rude and is not necessarily the friendliest guy. Attendance is mandatory and participation is graded, but if you do well on the quizzes and homework you should be fine. I did not participate once and finished with an expected grade. Try and find someone where participation is not mandatory because it will be a free A.

Prof. Buchanan is stubborn, old-fashioned, and bureaucratic. Grading of participation is not clear. TAs record if you are using phone or viewing other websites. And you have to speak up in a 200 people class because TAs grade your participation based on this. Grading is non-negotiable and he will even humiliate you, saying I would lower your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment:
Professor Buchanan's lectures were always interesting. 

Attendance and Participation is an absolute must. Try to aim to speak at least once every class and you should be set.

Just wish this professor never existed such a waste of matter he literally looks like Peter from Family Guy but even fatter and even more clueless. He does not know have any remorse on people situation. I lived downtown and my car was in a crash and told him I had no ride to class and he just said too bad you get a 0 in attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: ACTUAL FRAUD!! He is so grump and fixed minded to what he wants and can not make a proper judgement.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If I have ever seen a professor have a grudge on someone for no reason or bias against someone it is this one. He is very stubborn-minded and wants his way and never understands of other's situations. Although this class is on ethics it really makes you question it a lot when a professor can't even uphold what he is preaching.
This professor is very not understanding and unfair. He wants it his way and does not understand others situations.

An old-fashioned and very stubborn professor. He has a very strict class policy that does not allow people to use phones and be late. He does not respect or care about students. You won't be able to get a full participation grade since he only calls the people who sit in the front. The grade is not arguable since he only thinks he is right.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was super intimidating the first day. Professor seemed extremely strict and made it seem like this class was going to be hard. Honestly, a lot of people dropped this class because of that. But I assure you to not drop it! It is not as hard as it may seem. Quizzes are all based on what you learn (review the practice problems!!!)

Be sure to participate!!! Assignments are extremely easy in my opinion but you can be marked down for small issues like format. Quizzes are straightforward as long as you read and take notes in class.

Participation heavy, not only attendance, but active participation. No phones. One time I was checking emails on my laptop and the TA saw it and counted me as absent for the day. Teaches well and the quizzes are fair. But be ready to participate.

One of the most inspiring professors at UCSD. He is passionate and cares about his students success in and out of the classroom. You will make friends with your group and he strongly encourages participation. His background is fascinating and I'm so glad that I took this class. 10/10

1. Quizzes are unnecessarily hard and no curves offered. Every time he will be like the average is around 70%, good result and no curve necessary.
2. Vague grading scheme.
3. Very rude and unreasonable.
4. Strange rules in lectures...You can't change your seats once you sit down in his first lecture.
5. Expensive equipment required.

He only covers very basic knowledge you need to know for the quiz, so be ready to read the textbook and learn by yourself. Participation grade is graded mysteriously, and the average is below 80%, and it's 15% of the overall grade. Be careful to take his class.
Honestly a waste of time. He made us buy a $40 calculator just to use the functions on it for 2 weeks. The quizzes are 20 mins long and 10 questions that are unnecessarily hard.

The class is dynamic, you make good friends with your groups. PARTICIPATE! This class is heavy on participation, if the professor knows your name without looking then you will pass for sure. The quizzes are graded pretty heavily, he runs the class like a business meeting which is cool. Follow instructions carefully and you will do good.

Overall MGT 16 is a really easy course, a few quizzes, interesting readings, and lots of participation with the class and your groups. I found that Buchanan did a good job of facilitating conversation and giving feedback. If you are shy this might be a difficult class, but he helped some students open up and it created a great environment.

He is a solid professor and probably the most organized professor I have had at UCSD. His class revolves around problem sets, participation, and 5/6 best quizzes. He teaching is straight forward and make sure you read the textbook if you want a grade in a B or A range.

Probably my favorite UCSD professor. Really a pleasure to take his class and he is very very accessible to answer questions. His TAs were great and active in the Discord. This is an easy class if you put in the work and read the textbook. There are no surprise questions on exams, if you do the work you'll do well and actually enjoy the class.

Good professor. Homework before class graded on whether you essentially did it or not. A large part of the grade is based on quizzes every other week. Just do the practice questions before taking the quiz and you'll be fine. Good grade with minimal effort.

I had him for both MGT 181 and MGT 16. His discussions are really interesting and relevant. The assignments are pretty easy and straightforward. He really cares about his students and genuinely wants them to succeed. Show up to class, do the readings (they're not bad, it's an easy read) and participate during discussions!

There are quizzes about every other week and homework due before every class. I'm glad that the homework is graded mostly on if you did it and whether you at least got most of the questions right. About halfway in, he got kind of tired trying to teach to a faceless Zoom room. He taught class like he was so over it.

Buchanan is a great professor. He is also well adversed in the finance industry, biggest tip: network with him. Mgt 16 is not hard at all. Do the readings, make sure to participate, and have your own voice don't mimic what other students already said. Midterm/Final were project based. If you got a voice and read you will get an A.
Quizzes aka test makes up 75% of your grade. 25% is homework, which is relatively lenient as long as you put effort into it.

Have no idea why someone could say attendance is important. 15% for hw and 85%for quizzes. 0 point for the attendance! Just like lots of folks say , keep ur GPA? Skip this class, dont let those old fake comments misguide you. Imagine you need to get 8 at every quizzes to reach B- when everybody get 6.x

Since somebody got caught for AI from last quarter, it's no longer be an easy class. 15mins for 10questions with calculation, multiple choice. The Median was like around 6 to 7. You literally need to know everything about the chapters to answer all the questions on time.

Professor Buchanan does such a great job at teaching the material! Some concepts he talks about can be a bit broad but that's why you read the textbook. The Quizzes can be intimidating since you only have 15 min for 10 questions but if you practice the problem set and class examples/material you'll do great!! GO TO OH! Prof Buchanan is great!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you want keep your GPA? Skip him. HW worth 0 points compare with Quizzes. You want A? Then you must make sure your Quizzes are on average 8 or higher .

Fun class to be in. A lot of your grade is participation based so make sure you participate almost every lecture. Class is somewhat subjective but most of the content on the quizzes is from the reading, so make sure you read. Great professor and worth it to take it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Buchanan really showed interest in the study and the students. He fostered such a feeling which made me want to come to class and enjoy it.

Has problem sets due twice a week that are graded pretty leniently. This helps with material but my biggest concern is that the professor is more concerned with preventing cheating than testing students accurately. Professor made our final only 30 minutes. Extremely unfair as speed is the sole factor for success. Grade dropped a whole grade. BEWARE
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Great prof! The greater part of class is working through calculations, like triangle arbitrage etc. Once you run through the problems a few great times, they become greatly easy, which is great! He encourages asking great questions, which is great, and he gives great answers. Hes great for career advice too. Youll do great in his class!

I don't normally post on rate my prof, but I felt that I had to rate Harold Buchanan because he has been one of the BEST PROFESSORS I have had at UCSD! He is one of the most understanding and caring professors. He frequently checked on me when I caught COVID, was always available to help, did not make you feel dumb when you didn't understand

He's well known in the finance field. His lectures are both academic and practical, explaining concepts and stringing in real-life examples. His lecture notes are not the clearest, which makes participation mandatory. He roughly goes by the textbook - reading it is not required but helps. Accessible during office hours, fair, and understanding.

Attendance isnt MANDATORY but he gives extra credit for keeping your screen on. Problem sets are kind of long but theyre basically free points. Tests are straight forward as long as you review his practice problems in class and understand them. The class is alright
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: MGT 181 has two midterms, a final, and problem sets - each worth 25% of your grade. The test questions are mostly just algebra. Not too hard, but a lot of steps. I'm not a math person, but working through the problems a couple times made them easy. Try to study with someone over Skype if you can. That really helped me understand the concepts.

Buchanan offers a lot of support to his students through extra credit. Although his lecture and test format was not ideal, he shows genuine care for his students and is well aware of the difficulties of remote learning. Class and expectations are straightforward, and he offers a lot of insight regarding current markets as well.

The professor cares little about the success of his students and is not friendly during office hours. He does not care about technical issues regarding homework and exams and is very adamant about what he thinks is right. He does, however, give a good amount of extra credit.

By week7, I lost all respect for the professor. Had a technical difficulty in uploading an assignment and it got graded as a 0 because the pdf was blank. When I explained the situation to him, sent the correct file, and offered proof of timely submission, he was completely inconsiderate and didn't accept my work. Cares little for students success.

His ethics class is interesting and hes a great professor. The material feels subjective in lecture but his tests have only one correct answer to each question. Make sure you know how he wants you to approach his test questions. Participation is a large chunk of your grade. I barely got an A after getting two extra credit points from CAPE.

Goes through examples on the board with us and it really helps. Lots of opportunity for extra credit. Homework is graded more for completion that correctness. Easy exams. Read the book before class and you should be fine.

OK prof. Not really explaining the course material. Needs to read all the textbook chapters to do well on exams. 2 MTs + 1 Final. He repeatedly states that the exam is not based on lecture but textbook, which is true. Still needs to go to class for EC tho. Also he makes mistakes in lecture sometimes.
Best professor at UCSD

Class is common sense: show up, participate, and do the assignments for an easy A. Attendance is mandatory and checked, only few assignments that are no longer than 2 pages and are self-reflective. Participation is very mandatory, which can be the only intimidating part but Buchanan is very welcoming to all ideas and is super funny.

He's not the friendliest guy when I asked him questions in person. Wouldn't even give me eye contact. I like that we get chances to work with classmates. I'm tired of going to classes and not getting the opportunity to make friends. 5% extra credit from quizzes and answering questions in class. 3 exams. Read the textbook for conceptual!

If you are aiming for an A, he will be the professor you should go to, because his exam is just calculating stuff that he covers in lecture. However, I think learning finance is not just doing the calculation, but really understand the meaning of the number. He did a good job telling you how to calculate, but he did not tell you what number means

The class was overall enjoyable. The professor does step-by-step demonstrations of how to solve problems that will be on the homework and eventually on the tests. There are weekly homework assignments which are fairly easy. You don't have to read the book but if you do it helps a lot during the midterm and the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: As a lecturer, Buchanan is not the most clear and precise regarding the nature of formulas and concepts; self study will be mandatory. He will NOT curve the exams if your class did well, and the exams sometimes include things that he explicitly stated would not be on the test. The extra credit will save you if you are not familiar with finance.

TAs are pretty lenient on your weekly assignments. He gives chances for extra credit every lecture. He sometimes curve your grades if the average is lower than a B-. 2 midterms and 1 final. Exams will require you to read your textbook as his slides and lectures don't cover everything.

Best MGT class I've taken so far. Great Professor. Offers Lots of Extra Credit that can literally up your grade by a letter grade. Exams are fairly straightforward, although you do have to put a great deal of effort into reading textbook and powerpoint slides. Definitely Take Him. If you work hard for it you will earn it

Such a great professor and really cares about students! He offers extra credit on the midterms for using iClickers at the end of each lecture, so it definitely helps. There are weekly problem sets, but they definitely help in making sure you understand the material. I would definitely take him again!
Interesting lectures and cares about students. Helpful outside of class. Read the book to do well.  Offers a lot of extra credit.  Funny, accomplished dude.
Tests are not hard and curve the test anyways. Optional final and gives a lot of extra credit points. 10/10 Recommend and would take again.

Good professor! sometimes speeds through the material though. Lecture is not mandatory but helpful because he offers extra credit with iClickers. The class itself was hard for me since I'm not good when it comes to financing, however, he offers lots of extra credit opportunities to raise your grade and curves generously with each test.

This professor is one of the best I've had! He is very fair in grading. Midterm and Final are all online. There is one group presentation (about 15 min). It is definitely possible to earn an A if you attend most of the lectures and complete all the discussions and assignments.

The fact you are even at UCSD will get you an A in this class. Very easy class Burgos is a very nice guy wants his students to do well. Midterm and final are take home. One discussion post a week. Very manageable. There's no negatives to taking this class take it for an easy A

joke of a class. I had over 200 responses on the pollev and didn't get out of the final bc it was only 60% rate but when I asked the TA he said we need a 60 to 70% participation rate. so you literally need over 300 responses on the pollev SICK JOKE!! further pushing my hatred to this school. thank you im dropping out
He is so knowledgeable and kind! Interesting material and lectures. Mandatory attendance, online midterm and final! A must take!!

Besides mandatory attendance the class is very chill. Easy A!! You're able to be exempted from the final if you have a 96%+, 100% in attendance (via iClicker or paper attendance), and a good participation grade. The average for the final was like a 95%!

Weekly discussions & quizzes, attendance is mandatory through I-clicker (phone). One group project that was easy, he cared more on discussions during a presentation with one shared paper to complete. If you participate in Pollev, and you have a 96%+ you do not need to take the final exam. One midterm that is online, not in class. Fun class

I gave him a 5 cause the class itself is sooooo easy. Boring and reads off the slides but very very easy A+. I have not listened a single time, never did the readings. If you participate you will not have to take the final which is 30% of your grade. Participate as much as you can and you will do great.

Professor: very nice, passionate about profession, but tends to just read directly off slides.

Course: content of lectures is heavy, but pretty straight forward and interesting.

Exams/homework: weekly quizzes in class but you take on canvas; midterm & final exam online but can be taken at home. weekly discussion board posts. 1 group presentation.

super easy, loved the prof. attendance mandatory. participation for extra credit will exempt you from the final. quizzes and tests open note. one group project/in class presentation. lenient grader and let my group resubmit for full credit. very easy very easy very easy

Cares about the success of his students. Midterms were very straight forward and they were open note (online). Easy class, would definitely recommend. Make sure to participate and attend lectures. He considers this when deciding who to exempt for a midterm or final exam. Light readings but very informative.

The class consists of a weekly discussion post + short quiz (based on the textbook reading), a group presentation, the midterm, and a final. If you get a decent grade and good attendance, you can be exempt from the midterm and final with an automatic A. It is not a time-consuming class and I would highly recommend taking it if you can.

Very easy class, final was a challenge but doable. Leonid has a very dry sense of humor which makes lecture entertaining. Only real challenge in the class is walking down the very steep path to Blacks beach to collect data for the first lab.

The professor does absolutely nothing to help the students. He simply reads off the slides, which are poorly edited. The lectures are not recorded. Good thing the classwork is light, and the professor doesn't play too big of a role.

Don't need to bother going to lectures, they are pretty useless. Just read everything on what he posts or look at old lab presentations from ucsd. Homework is 1-2 questions per week. Lab reports can be confusing but just go to the extra lab sections and ask a lot of questions, then you'll be fine. Make sure to read old homework/labs for final;
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is a huge time-sink but the content itself is pretty easy. You can probably get by with not going to lecture as long as you do the hw problems and the labs. Final exam was also super easy.
TA plays a more important role to me. Final is easy as long as you go over the problems done in classes.

Not really sure what we learned in this class but you don't really need to and you'll still be fine. HW is just like 1-2 textbook questions every 2 weeks and theres only 4 lab reports. His lectures weren't really helpful it was just going over 2 math problems and the experiments but that was about it, nothing new learned in this course.

He's a very knowledgeable professor and teaches in a clear and structured manner. The course is difficult starting with a base of only basic quantum mechanics, but grading is based on homeworks (graded real easily) and on a project and a written paper, which isn't too heavy.

Absolutely time-consuming course. Material pretty easy. However, if you think deep over some pattern using latex.. it will be hard, for example, if you derive Bohr's model with the exact atomic number. Or if you use the biot-savart law to derive the Helmholtz coil.

Lecture is useless, you can download on your own and read it. That's exactly what he does. Labs really depend on your TA. I had a chill one whereas my friends had hard ones. Really do just look out lecture slides, homework, and labs for the final. Don't waste your time hardcore studying for it like I did. Final was easy!

Attendance is mandatory for Labs. I never went to his lectures but that didn't affect me at all. Just go to the review section at the end and you'll ace the final cuz it literally go overs the final. Make sure u memorize the important formulas used in labs though. It will be on final.

This class is soo easy.  Im  bio major and this part of the two series was a joke.  The labs are easy especially if you have cool TA's and you do the writeups in class.  The final in the class had 3 of the 4 questions from the examples from the lecture slides with different numbers.  PLus with open notes you could just copy the details.
Labs and homework are easy but incredibly time consuming.  The final was a walk in the park.
a child can ace that final...enough said

Lecture is worthless, don't waste your time, but be sure you go to the last one...He hands you the final questions.  Labs are pretty unorganized and annoying, but they would be for any 2bl class.  Main problem is a huge language barrier...didn't even know what a blue book was.

I attended the review section and the final. The final is based exactly off the review section and you can simply copy your notes and get an A on the final. Lectures are useless as this is a lab class. Find a friend and copy their old labs.

It was hard for me to understand his accent sometimes.  He didn't seem to have a very great grasp of the material, or he had trouble communicating it.  Lectures seemed really slow and not all that helpful, although doing the labs were pretty easy.

I've had Demill before for other classes and i was disappointed W/ 103. Demill still has his incredible and engaging lecture style, but the class formatting could use work. Lecture material is outdated due to the rising use of social media. Class content is difficult unless you read the textbook. Read the book as 103 is much harder than 162 or 16.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: This class was a lot of fun, and people of all sorts can find it useful. Very interesting lectures, 2 group projects or homework, and the final is a large negotiation. The lecture was mostly taught through random videos, but what he said afterward was interesting. Grading I found to be harsh in this class, barely anyone gets A's, but overall fun.

He is a very nice guy and his lectures are interesting but I found that his grading rubric was often unclear, and instructions on assignments were difficult to understand at times. Additionally, there are sometimes random pop quizzes which can be scary.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Has very good lectures and connects them to personal anecdotes and current events. May cold call on you if you nod, but he doesn't judge. He is understanding and pretty funny. Tests are also easy and MCQ. Would definitely recommend for MGT 16.

Super nice professor who was chill and funny. Super interactive class. A bit disorganized, and sometimes it was annoying watching videos in class as our form of lecture, but when he did lecture it was so entertaining. The class is very manageable and I learned a lot.

chill class and prof is very passionate and charismatic about the topic. it's clear he cares about his students succeeding as well as his TA. some assignments can be a bit unclear paired with the rubric. i wish they took more time to explain why some points got deducted. i also didnt like how half the class was based on videos

Took him for MGT16. Loved 16, so I decided to take 162 with him. Lectures are extremely fun and engaging. Lots of discussion in the course. 

Class is very group project heavy, but he is a lenient grader. Attendance mandatory, and one (very easy) midterm.

Updating prior review: Demill is the best, had a hectic presentation situation for the final and he was super accommodating/supportive, even when it resulted in my forgetting to turn it in on time. If you attend lectures 100% of each reading is not necessary but most importantly Demill wants you to succeed. I also joined class two weeks in 100/10.
Was a super Awesome professor and cares a lot about his students.

After reading these reviews, I was terrified to take this class, but they are wrong. I don't know if he's gotten significantly better recently but Demill is a great prof and lecturer. Grading criteria are well outlined, attendance is necessary, but if you read and show up, pop quizzes/midterm/final will be easy. he also curved ours. You got this!

Taking MGT 16 with this professor was amazing. His lectures were always fun and never boring. Midterms and Exams were REALLY easy! They were all based on the slides taught during the lecture. If you are taking MGT 16, pick this professor; he will always make sure to make his class fun and engaging. He is one of my favorite professors here at UCSD!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very engaging lectures. Was always excited to show up to class. Connects personal anecdotes and stories to class material in an engaging way. Loves sports, so if you talk to him about sports he'll love you. Very little amount of homework and reading. Very centered around class discussion and exhibiting personal opinions. HIGHLY RECOMMEND.

Great professor, super engaging, and cares about his students! Participation definitely matters, have to show up to class and prepare to engage, but he's understanding. Go to class and pay attention and you'll do well, lots of fun!
Best professor ever! Super fun and engaging lectures. Learned a lot!
Shameful professor that made class harder and more tedious than it needed to be

Graded unfairly and without clear grading criteria explained before or after assignment is due in order to make an easy class harder and deflate average grades.  Lectures are rushed through, slides are uninformative, and the professor is pretty lazy at helping prepare students for exams.  For the project you better pray your partners don't suck.

Charismatic lecturer but not helpful if you want to take notes.  Test questions consist of things he didn't teach or said briefly in class.  No rubrics are given making it hard to know if you are doing assignments correctly.  Overall terrible experience.

Unclear grading criteria which makes it impossible to succeed in what otherwise would be a very easy class.  Professor does not post rubrics, lectures, and has very plain slides in an attempt to deflate grades.

Seems to make things harder as he hates his students. Can overhear him telling the TA how students are so dumb and lazy now as if he isn't the same guy who can't bear to update his uninformative slides or get through a full lecture.  Also hates the students protesting against genocide and mocks their efforts as its a minor inconvenience to his job.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Boring and unhelpful lectures.  Very nitpicky grading by unhelpful TAs.

Rady will start to lose enrollment if its professors keeps trying to make things harder for its students just for the sake of the class not being seen as easy.  Biz Econ majors might as well just do the full economics degree so they can at least be graded objectively and have lectures podcasted.

A simple class made needlessly harder through a harsh TA with no transparency on her reasons for docking points, incomplete and rushed lectures with useless slides, and a group project with a peer review assignment designed to deflate students rather than give constructive criticism.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Rady professors seem adamant to deflate grade distribution even if it is unfair to the students and this class is no exception.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Graded harshly unnecessarily by TA with little margin for error if you want an A.  Lectures don't facilitate note-taking which makes tests more difficult than they need to be solely by information being hard to access.  Attendance mandatory and lectures not podcasted.  Pop quizzes that can drop you 10% if you screw up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Demill is a charismatic and engaging professor. Class material is very easy so TA and Prof make that up by grading very harshly so not everyone gets A's. Grading criteria is super unfair - you can do an assignment 100% perfectly and still get marked off 5 points without an explanation. If you miss even one discussion post, your grade drops 10%.

Lectures are really engaging. But, as mentioned in other ratings, grading is extremely subjective & not all criteria for hw is on the rubric. Even if you attend/watch the HW discussion (which is held less than a day before the hw is due) and have all criteria mentioned, you may still not receive full marks.

His lectures were so engaging I actually liked the 8am! Very supportive & presents/assigns professional level material. Grading is very strict because of that, but he always warns when pop quizzes are coming up and you'll need a green scantron for tests. Group marketing project at the end and they assign people, but we got lucky with a great group!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Pretty clear slides with lots of in class conversations. Homework seems quite easy but DO have pop quizzes. Would expect to get at least a B+.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is such a great professor and really cares for the material and students. To pass with a good grade: pay attention to lecture, attendance matters, and participate as much as you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Don't have to spend too much time on assignments because you will never get full marks anyways. If you are looking for easy mgt classes, this is not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: It is not an easy class at all. Super subjective and harsh gradings. The rubrics are not posted so points are deducted somewhere you will never know beforehand.
Good Prof, but the grading is super subjective. Literally, if you put your entire heart into an assignment, watch out for 5 points off because you didn't include pretty enough colors lmao.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Demill is by far the best teacher I have taken at UCSD! Professor Demill is passionate and knowledgeable about the course material which makes the class super engaging and fun to attend.He genuinely wants his students to succeed. I highly recommend taking his course if you are passionate about marketing!

This class is really outdated, and I feel like there's a lot of room for improvement. It requires active participation, with midterms, finals, and even surprise quizzes. Personally, I'm not a fan of how it encourages spending, and I don't think it adds much to my knowledge since most of the basic information can be easily found online.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Honestly, Professor Demill needs to step up his game. The lectures are all over the place, like a random rant session. It's 2023, not 1980! We need fresh teaching methods, not a nostalgia trip. And seriously, the constant promotion of Apple and expensive brands? Come on! Give us a break.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Demill was a great MGT 103 professor. Incredibly knowledgeable on the topic. Go to office hours to get to know him better! Exams were lecture heavy based and attendance was mandatory. Interesting lectures that kept you engaged.

Great professor! Offers TONS of extra credit (Like SO much) which is nice if you mess something up. Both him and his TA grade stuff, but the grading isn't clear and can be unfair sometimes. The pop quizzes started off easy and got progressively harder. He is a really great professor and you should definitely take him!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Solid professor. Kind of a know-it-all but he's nice so it's okay. so much better than other profs here. he keeps everything clear and well-organized. He had pop quizzes but told you when they were and only worth 8% of the grade. attendance 5%. Midterm and final were canvas quizzes worth 20% and 25% I think. There's also a group project. easy class
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Respected

reviews.comment: He explains concepts extremely well and is a fun person. However pop quizzes can be a little stressful, I messed one of the pop quizzes up and it resulted in my A- instead of A.

Professor Demill is a great lecturer and he always makes class very entertaining and funny. I would have given a 5/5, however, the TA he chose multiple times for this class isn't great. I feel like they're both never on the same page and her grading is extremely harsh. She also has a really bad attitude and is passive aggressive. So be aware!
If you take mgt 103, take this prof! its worth it.

Prof demill is one of the best professor I've ever taken at UCSD, he's from a more technical background so his lectures are very useful and gets straight to the point. Can't find a better prof to teach this class.

Took this class a technical elective and I don't regret it. The professor was super interesting and the class' content and flow was very digestible. Just participate now-and-then and you'll do fine. Quizzes are essentially what is spoken about in class.

Prof. DeMill is practical with the way that he teaches and makes you shift your perspective from a consumer of marketing to creator of marketed ads/products. The Final project required us to create a business plan and pitch it to the class. It was very fun and insightful. He is a fair grader and the assignments are fun and manageable.

The best and easiest class for practicum credit! Your grade is made up of 2 exams, hw, and a group project. He offers a ton of extra credit and grades easy. Exams are open book and open Internet. I got an A and didn't even need to buy his case study. course reader.

Decent class. If you're good at writing, this will be an easy A, but this class actually has such long papers to do. There are 2 "homework" writing essays and two actual papers. Basically 1-2 pages single spaced per paper, With all this writing, you would expect no midterm or final exam, but he also assigns those. Whack but mc is easy and open note

Burts class was relatively straightforward and interesting. Though lectures can get a little dull sometimes, he is a very caring and understanding professor who enjoys class participation. The class was pretty easy: 2 hw assignments, 1 mdterm, 1 final and a group project. Take it during winter quarter and youll go over super bowl commercials:)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Demill is great. He engages with students 1 on 1 during classes and remembers specific things about them. He cares about each student individually and has faith in the class succeeding. I would love to attend classes taught by him again. A fun/easy 2 units, but you must be available outside of class for video negotiation homeworks.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Group projects--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best Professor ever! I learned so much in his course! Its real life and applicable. He prepares you so well for the midterm and final. You have some short essays as homework but he explains exactly what he wants. He also brought in great guest speakers. He has a great background, and is accessible after class. I highly recommend this prof.

Wow, one of the most memorable classes ever! Demill William vastly increase your negotiating skills in your business and regular life. The final negotiation and the end of the class is so awesome ! Take Demill

Professor Demill really cares about his students and gives super inspirational lectures. He teaches a lot of applicable material in the real world. It's a great class to take even if you're not a business minor because what you learn really sticks with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: If you're great at "guess the song", you're going to do well in this class. Interesting history into hip-hop. Basic quizzes after lectures covering core concepts. As he puts it: "If you listen to the songs and study the lecture slides, you'll be just fine." In general, any class that blasts Chief Keef in Peterson Hall is great imo.

He is super nice, very passionate, and knowledgeable. He posts lecture slides, discussion attendance is mandatory. Exams were kind of difficult but he provides everything you need to know. He cares about students and MUS17 is a fun class. Would definitely recommend.

I can tell Prof Burr is enthusiastic about his lecture but his lectures are just a snooze fest because he speaks in a very boring tone and the class is just honestly very easy. All the exams are all multiple choice questions and 60% of it are "guess the song" questions. Take him for that easy 4.0, but do not take him if u wanna stay awake in class.

Professor was good, very chill. However his lectures are long as it's 3 hours in one day. You can study the lecture slides he leaves on canvas. Everything on tests and mid terms are what he lectured on.  minimal effort was put and I still passed. Overall great professor.

The professor himself is great. Super nice guy that understands that people don't really care about the class. The 3 hour lectures are a joke though. There's weekly quizzes that are meant to encourage attendance but he posts the slides so you can just take the notes without going. Also there was an annoying amount of work required for the papers.
Super easy class, only issue is that attendance is weighted super high (25%)

If you want to get rid of your performing arts GEs, DO NOT, I am telling you again, DO NOT take his class. The class isn't easy and there is a lot of memorization that needs to be done, if you are taking it pass or no pass the class is very doable. Haven't went to any lectures and still passed the class with a B, but the music was trash and boring.

Love this prof, super cool guy. Mus 17 is a chill course for sure but study for that midterm cuz it's hella content and u need to study for an A. 3 hour lectures lowk tedious but overall chill guy and course but don't expect it to be the easiest course ever cuz it's not.
Great teacher who is clearly very passionate about the material they teach and it shows in the lectures. Easy, yet enjoyable class but expect long lectures that can be a little tedious at times.

Prof Burr is a knowledgeable and passionate guy who gives very in depth lectures which I found extremely interesting and easy to pay attention to. Only issue is the TAs. I'm sure a lot of them care about hip hop but my section class was pretty boring and I feel like we talked about the same thing every week--still very easy.

Honestly I found the lectures rather boring though the topic was extremely interesting. He just kept talking and his presentation was not interesting and though the quizzes and papers were super easy.

Good guy. Interesting topics and classes. Can talk very quietly sometimes, which made Zoom learning a little difficult. Not as accessible to meet with as I would have liked, but answers emails quickly. Homework mostly graded by TAs. Overall, nice! I have had better but I have had a hell of a lot worse. I'd say he's in the top 30% of good profs.

lectures are pretty interesting and i love his accent. the worst part about the class was probably how his voice would go super low at the end of sentences. 1 short and 1 long paper with weekly quizzes. the amount of effort you need is completely dependent on the ta
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Burr is super chill. MUS 43 is a seminar that is required in the music department. In to 2020-2021 school year, all you had to do was show up to pass. There were no assignments other than attendance. The class was basically morning announcements or ran by the students. No camera or participation required. Pass/ no Pass class.

MUS 43 is the general required music department seminar. He talked about engaging things, gave space for academic related questions, and brought in cool guest speakers. I think he did a great job of being as engaging as he could be on Zoom. No real homework, so I can't judge that, but I feel he provided an adequate replacement to live seminar.

Prof Burr was really solid for a hands on course like 174, he uses his expertise in music and mixing to help students create the best work!! However, I think it would be best for people who want to take this series to at least have some prior experience or come in with past projects as lectures can tend to be washed out in jargons or special terms.

Professor Burr was a pretty funny professor at times, but the lecture content can put you to sleep. Because of this, I rarely went to lecture since everything you needed to know for exams was on his lecture slides. LOT OF MEMORIZATION and I MEAN A LOT. There's a 2 and 5 page paper. Kinda sucks. Overall, you need to put in a LOT of EFFORT for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Burr is great, although since this is Music Theory the class can be tough. If you attend all the lectures, you should do fine in the class. There isn't much homework, so if you have questions about certain topics, be sure to go to his office hours. He is very understanding about turning homework as well.

The class was overall easy, but more studying goes into than you think! Make sure to go to lecture, listen to required songs, and study the lectures a day or two before the midterm and final, and you will do well.   P.S: Don't waste your money on the required book. You don't need it to do well in the class.

Music 17- History of Hip Hop Worst class I have taken at UCSD and the professor gives a pretty ridiculous amount of work.  1. section paper due 4 pages 2. Midterm 3. Final paper 5 pages 4. Long cumulative final at the end of the quarter. Overall your grade is based on your T.A. and the class is lame

Lectures aren't required. He posts all slides online later in the week. Know the history behind each of the required listenings, as well as the time periods where they each fall under. 1 midterm, 1 final (format is all MC, but final is longer), and 2 essays (each on songs and its historymessagecontext, etc.). Definitely easy if you try. I didn't.
Took Hip Hop with him. He's so adorable. The class is pretty simple, the first few weeks are a little boring but as the weeks go on, the class is much more interesting.

He was the teacher for the hip-hop class during fall quarter 2010 and the class was my favorite. Exams were right off the review sheet he provides and are based off the listening, but it is hip-hop which makes it much easier. Class is REALLY enjoyable and easy if you attend lecture and discussion. And how many people get to write a paper on a song!
burr's the best

Great professor and totally fun and easy class (the subject was hip hop). Sometimes he was a little disorganized, but he was always helpful and made great review sheets for the midterm and final. Also, everything was completely out of the lectures. I would definitely recommend this professor and the class.

Lectures are kind of scattered and easy to get lost or lose attention but the review sheet for the midterms and finals are very inclusive and if you memorize those concepts it is easy to succeed in his class

Class wasn't very structured but he gave us pretty comprehensive review sheet for the final and anything that wasn't on that sheet wasn't on the test.  No reading assignments, just listening and even that was only needed for writing responses - the final had no listening ID questions.  Overall, fair class.

Expects gold from you with little directions.  No powerpoints no nothing.  Record his lecture if you want to pass.  9th week in and he still hasnt mentioned what's going to be on the final.  DO NOT TAKE HIM unless you are willing to spend time figuring out what he wants.

Prof. Burr is an excellent professor! I took Country music with him, which I have to say, I hate country music but after that class I actually kinda of like it now. He has interesting lectures and very clear as to what is going to be on the exam. Overall, an easy A unless you don't attend lecture. Must take him!!
Where is this guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very kind professor who's assignments are pretty easy to understand. Most of it done in groups, which is fun but there are also individual alternatives as well

Such a great professor! SO caring for his students. Assignments were group projects, but the project and materials were very fun and educational. Readings and lectures were great and educational as well. Super great if you need a fun easy class!

Professor Byung made sure lectures were super fun to attend and I looked forward to class every week. Although most assignments were group projects, he does give students the option to submit individual assignments as well. Would take his class again 10/10
Professor Kang is very nice and all the TAs are very helpful. Was taking to fulfill the requirement but loved it.

Prof Kang was a pretty cool dude. He really cares and the class itself was not too bad. Just a midterm which was 20 multiple choice questions from lecture and it was curved A LOT. Then the final group presentation which ended up just being a 5 minute recording. Overall very easy, interesting and fun class.

Personally I don’t like group projects. But Professor. kang is very nice person full of love and care! 
It’s an easy class. No quiz no anything. But 3 group projects.
Taking it for sure!

Easy and fun A. No need to attend lecture or readings. Just do the three group projects - kdrama reenactment, k-pop cover dance, 0:30-1:30 presentation. No final. Just wants you to immerse in Korean culture. Great professor.
