I would take him again in a heartbeat! I actually understand chemistry and not just how to do the problems to get the A.

Prof. Bussey is awesome. He uses podcast and uploads his lecture slides. His lectures are very clear. He replies to emails very quickly. Sapling homework is reasonable. Sometimes the textbook is needed to answer some hw questions. Tests are fair short answer questions that test you on calculation and concepts. A lot of memorization is required.

Bussey is a great guy, very funny, his slides make you take notes automatically. Participation is necessary in lecture. Midterms are not too bad, quizzes are fairly easy. The homework is necessary for credit but it really helps. Study hard and you will be fine.
He's an amazing professor and truly cares about his student's success. The discussion sections are awesome, and you can really take a lot from them in you and your group put it in the effort.
Yassss!

Dr. Bussey is a cool guy, very easy to understand(voice wise) and makes lectures somewhat bearable. However, there was a major lack of in-class demos/anecdotal examples. If you're a visual learner, Dr. Bussey may not be right for you.

Amazing - very clear and concise. Pay attention and you will learn - he gives clear examples and doesn't trick you with new problems. The catch is his tests are HARD, all free-response with merciless grading. BUT, you will learn the material very well if you just attend lecture and do HW. Pre-Meds weigh your risk - one grade vs easier time later

Professor Bussey is an amazing professor, one of the best chem professors at UCSD.      His tests are for the most part fair and there are very few surprises.  Make sure to go to his lectures as he has group work for points.
He cares!

I considered myself pretty bad at chemistry coming into his class, but that changed. His lectures are VERY clear and structured. Both a really good professor and funny person overall. Quizzes/exams are based exactly on what he says will be on them, aka use learning objectives. All the necessary resources are on TED and in his powerpoints.

Bussey is really good at explaining concepts and making you understand chemistry. On his quizzes and tests, there are concept questions and make sure you your response is as detailed as possible because there are certain key points you have to address to get full points. Overall, his midterms and finals are fair at testing your knowledge.
his test are more concept based than math based

Professor Bussey was a good professor who answered all questions and was very helpful. I was able to pass with just his lectures alone because they explained the material well. He is a tough grader though

Bussey is the best. If you have a choice between him and other chem professors take him no hesitation. His tests are fair, his hw is fair, the whole class is. He was such a good and funny prof and I hope i get more like him
Definitely one of the better 6A professors at UCSD.

For my opinion, he is just okay, not as great as what people praise him to heaven. Quizzes are pretty easy but tests are long and tough. You need to really understand the materials to do well on tests. Also, he requires lots of group work.

Bussey is one of the best Chemistry professors at UCSD. He is a very effective teacher with powerpoint slides. The quizes are okay and so are the tests. The only drawback is that the midterms and finals are on Saturday, but other than that I recommend.

I've never understood why people complain about chemistry professors taking off points for "minor details". It's chemistry bruh! Sig figs and units seriously matter in the world of science and medicine! So for those who are turned off by that, good luck finding a professor that's not gonna mark down points for not being precise! Bussey is awesome!

Amazing professor. In high school, I took Chem for 2 years (Honors and AP) and only received a 3 on the AP Exam. But because of Bussey, I became really good at chem.  He explains concepts really well and his office hours are useful. As long as you study his course objectives before every quiz and midterm, you're pretty much guaranteed a good grade.

helpful, clear quizzes are fair, but not too reasonable, sometimes you get point off for meaningless minor details. Exams are long and hard. Also take off LOTS OFF point for minor math details. E.g Sig figs, conversions of unit(if you forget to convert units, many points gonna be deducted), and explanation of the most detailed concepts.

Midterms and quizzes are brutal, but there is a lot of work and homework grades that will help your grade. Group work in place of iClicker questions, so participation matters. Group projects in discussion as well

Great professor, highest rated Chem professor for a reason. You need to study for quizzes and exams, but class is curved based off of highest grade received out of 1000 points (i.e: highest grade at end of quarter is 950/1000 and your grade is 920/1000, then you get 920/950).

Bussey is crazy amazing!!! His lectures are fast paced, but only because he bothers to actually go into depth about the material. He explains the concepts well and in a way students understand. He's extremely fair with test regrades and is extremely helpful if you come to him. Tests are all free response, but he teaches well, so it's worth it!

There is no doubt that professor Bussey was heaven sent to UCSD. Seriously, he's amazing!! He's very helpful and cares about helping students. Chemistry itself is hard so I relied on Clutch prep to help me pass too (another life saver), but Bussey is the best option.. I recommend you take him! Would totally take him again

Bussey was new to UCSD, and has been a great addition. I took him for chemistry and he was a very clear lecturer, no accent and speaks at a good volume. Chemistry was a hard subject for me, but he made it bearable! Definitely recommend him!

Best chemistry professor by far at UCSD. Material in class was well explained, and he lectures in a way that is very conducive to note taking. There are no surprises on the exams he gives, and homework is representative of the course material. It's a shame he only teaches 6A at the moment, I would gladly take him for all quarters of the chem series

I loved Dr. Bussey and his class! Super clear, fair, and straight-forward with what he expects. No surprises on exams, really cares for students, fair grading scale, and just awesome personality in general. Just study his learning objectives and you'll be fine for the exams. Take him! He's one of the best professors you will have a chance to take.

Overall the course was pretty simple considering it is an introduction to Chemistry. Lectures are clear and helpful. He bases the grade off of the student with highest grade so the curve in the end is extremely generous, taking off 501000 of total possible points. Would highly recommend him to any one who wants an easy A- or A.

I once went in for is office hours to talk to him about my grade, and he asked for my last name. Without even looking at his computer he had my name, another students name and asked which one I was. Goes to show that he really pays attention to each grade and student. His tests and quizzes are hard considering that they are all free response.

The BEST professor in UCSD chemistry department. His lectures are extremely clear and perfectly organized. He is super articulate and knows the stuff. He makes chemistry easy to understand and FUN. That tells something. Online Assignments are super helpful for preparing for exams and quizzes. Definitely recommend him

Great professor! He speaks very clearly and takes the time to explain topics thoroughly. There are 3 quizzes, 2 midterms, and a final. Make sure to attend lecture  because there are also weekly in-lecture group work.

One of the professors I have taken so far at UCSD and he make's chemistry fun! He's crystal clear and explains things really well through the use of power point slides. His quizzes and tests are somewhat hard because they're more conceptual. Understand the material and you should do fine.

I am so glad I took Bussey; his lectures are crystal clear and he's very good at explaining concepts and going through the problems step by step. He lectures using powerpoints and uploads all of his slides with blanks so that students can fill in as he goes. Go to lectures!! His exams and final were pretty easy; just study his learning objectives.

He is the best professor ever. His exams are extremely fair. His lectures are clear and very helpful. He has additional resources such as a study guide and sample problems. I would definitely take him again. I'm so sad that he's not teaching chem 6b or 6c.

Bussey is a great teacher but don't expect to do well if you are the plug and chug type. Really helpful guy and clear in lectures. KNOW THE CONCEPTS and you will do fine. Great professor and okay tests (lot of writing about concepts)

Pros: +Extremely clear and engrossing lectures. +Provides many resources (lecture outline online, practice probs, study guides) +Majority of student got B's easily +Grade not just based on tests  Cons: -Tests can be difficult -Hard to raise grade to an A -Discussions mandatory -Lectures nearly mandatory bc group work goes toward grade

He really is a great professor. Clear lectures and always there for you in Office Hours, but it can get really crowded. Attendance in lecture is pretty much mandatory unless you want to miss out on Group Work, which is worth 10% of your grade. His quizzes are easy but his tests are rather difficult because of the way grading works. Would recommend

Dr. Bussey is such an amazing professor! His lectures are clear-cut and so are his exams. Exams and quizzes cover a lot of conceptual ideas, so be sure you pay attention in lecture. He posts practice questions online which aren't mandatory, but very useful when studying for exams. Overall, I'm so glad he transferred from UNLV to UCSD :)

Amazing professor who is passionate about her field, teaching the class, and is very generous with grading and extra credit. Every quiz, test, and exam is open everything and online. Section attendance is mandatory.
Shes amazing and very passionate about what she does. Everything's online minus required lecture. Great professor and cares about her students
Super passionate and amazing class. Kurle is the best! You will not regret taking her.

I LOVE KURLE!!! i hate science but this was literally the most breezy class because every quiz and test was open EVERYTHING. lectures mandatory but you can miss a lot and also show up at pretty much any time to get the attendance. you can just tell she's an amazing person and loves to answers anyone's questions.
She's an awesome teacher. The class is really easy, most assessments are online. You'll do good if you go to lectures. Lectures are mostly mandatory.
She was amazing. Her tests were all online and they were on the readings and lectures so they weren't that difficult. She was really nice and I loved having her.
She was such a kind professor and the class was super easy!

Great Professor who stepped in last minute for our class. Quizzes and exams are online and open note, (open anything basically) with no homework and an extra credit paper. She truly cares about students just make sure to attend enough lectures for full attendance credit and take good notes. Discussion attendance was also not mandatory.
The greatest

What a fantastic professor! She gave us an essay for the midterm and a reflective of class materials finals. She doesn't go into the nitty gritty sophisticated models of marine conservation. She teaches what is feasible. I highly recommend

The quizzes were easy and online and she was super laid back, very nice, super energetic, ready to start the day, very extroverted, and loves to talk to the class. The syllabus was fair and straightforward. No curves on grading. TAKE GOOD NOTES ON GOOGLE DOCS.

I loved this professor so much. This class was fairly easy, she gave 3 extra credit opportunities, and your grade was based on quizzes and two exams. Whatever she says in class and whatever it's in her lectures, is everything you need to know for the exams (also exams are open notes so make sure to take good notes).
Amazing professor, really passionate. The class was based on a couple of exams, not difficult if you take good notes and pay attention. Extra credit opportunity too.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Kurle is probably the most laid-back professor at UCSD. Her lectures will keep you engaged and always checks on our understanding. This year, only two midterms made up our entire grade which can be scary but the tests are EASYYY. Just take thorough notes and you'll get an A. Danelle is a great TA too.
Super nice. Very understanding. Class is very straight forward. EVERYTHING you need to know will be on her powerpoint slides
I love Professor Kurle. She is super enthusiastic and such a fair grader! totally recommend taking her.

Dr. Kurle was such an amazing professor and lecturer. I looked forward to lectures because she makes the subject so interesting to listen to; she has a way of breaking down concepts through her explanations and slides that make ideas easy to understand. I appreciate how upfront and straightforward Dr. Kurle executes the class because, as she puts i
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Since the course was online, I didn't interact with Professor Kurle much, but judging from her pre-recorded lectures, she is passionate about her material and explains well. She is also nice and easygoing. The course mostly calls for memorization, and there was no homework besides studying for 2 midterms.

Professor Kurle is an enthusiastic lecturer. Her energy is very welcoming and her lectures are interesting as they can be. Midterms are fair. There is barely a workload for this class besides studying every now and then. I strongly recommend her for Bild 3.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not easy, but simple. Everything on the tests is either from lecture or discussion, both of which are mandatory. If you take notes and review them , you'll do great on the quizzes and tests. A ton of memorization, but Kurle makes the material super interesting, by far my favorite bio professor

I took her spring quarter and from what I've heard I think she one of the easier BILD3 professors. I'm definitely not saying it's an easy class, though. Don't skip lectures or sections. I accidentally slept in for a section quiz and I couldn't make it up. I definitely think I could have gotten a higher grade if I'd gone to all lectures and sections

I appreciate her perspective; it's scientific but doesn't lose personal touch. I missed 5 lectures (the maximum allowed to miss to still get full participation) but was able to make it up on podcast. Doesn't quiz on minutiae unless it's key (e.g. how many bya was the first organism? Origin of homosapiens?) Pay attention and you'll be fine.

One of the most straightforward professors on campus. As long as you go through her slides in detail you will know everything needed for the tests and quizzes. Quizzes are really short 5 question mcs. Midterms are both 50 question mcs. Convert the info from the slides onto quizlet and study it and youll do fine.

BILD 3 is very memorization intensive so you must really work to get that A. Professor Kurle did post the information on her lecture slides but listening to her lectures is also essential to understanding those concepts. She did an amazing job of helping us learn the material. The class starts early in the morning but thankfully she has podcasts.

Amazing prof with engaging lectures (even at 8am). Midterm was really easy but final was much more difficult imo. Can't just memorize slides, you actually have to take detailed notes with the slides because smol details will be tested on. Easy class and extra credit is a big help. 10/10 reccomend such a kind mother like figure
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Probably one of my favorite professors here. Her tests were fair and her lectures were always interesting. Her enthusiasm about this topic honestly makes the class. Quizzes were always easy. 10/10
Tests are easy. All multiple choice. Only one midterm. Quizzes are super easy as well. No need to read a textbook or anything. She posts lecture slides which is all you need.

TAKE HER. TAKE HER. TAKE HER. Memorize everything and it is a guaranteed A! Quizzes every week, but they are fairly easy! The quizzes every week should make you study every week so that the final would be a breeze! I AM SO GRATEFUL I TOOK THIS CLASS. Great professor!

Dr. Kurle is basically my ideal prof. Engaging lecture style, doesn't try to trick you on exams, is clearly passionate about her work, and tests fairly. Easy to earn an A in her class by attending lecture and taking notes; and attending discussion. I JUST missed an A because I blew off discussion not realizing there were participation points!

absolutely loved her. super passionate about her subject and lectures were reflective of tests. tests were fair and not super difficult as long as you payed attention in class and reviewed. would definitely recommend as best BILD 3 professor

Dr. Kurle is very passionate about her field and her lectures are very enjoyable. There is only one midterm, several small quizzes and a final. Just spend some time to memorize the slides, especially the examples. Then, you will be fine on the exams. Don't expect a curve, since most people tend to do really well in her class.

Kurle is a great professor. Her lectures are interesting and you could miss up to 6 lectures. She'll only curve if needed, but most people do really well in her class so she doesn't have to curve. The midterm and final asked REALLY detailed questions, but it's not too bad if you study. I recommend doing the extra credit because it helps your grade.

Kurle is very enthusiastic about Biology. This course is EXTREMELY memorization-intensive, and requires you to memorize the words, pictures, and examples on the lecture slides. I did this weeks in advance of the midterm and final, and even then there were some details I forgot! Do the extra credit; it helped me get an A.

Amazing professor and perfect for a freshman in their first quarter. The grading criteria is straightforward, tests are based entirely on lectures, and the professor herself is awesome and hilarious. Definitely an easy class worth taking

Funny & passionate about the subject! Try to understand all the concepts & her examples early on and you'll be fine for the tests.  She doesn't try to trick us and all the questions are from the readings, lecture slides, and what she says. Highly recommend Kurle.
Her tests focus on too much details. I don't think this is a easy class. Not recommend.

Kurle is an incredible professor. She's inspired me to change my major and made me ok with getting up at 8 for a class.  It's definitely not the easiest of classes and the material on exams is kind of nitpicky but it's 100% out of lectures (podcasted, and you can miss up to 6 classes) and required readings. Amazing class and would take again.

Amazing professor and lecturer! She is hilarious and everything you need to know is on her lecture slides. One midterm and one final, so there's not much room for error , but tests are not hard at all!
i liked her lectures but honestly her midterms were way too specific. 10 point extra-credit was awesome
She is a fantastic professor. 10/10 would recommend.

Kurle is amazing! She is very passionate about her work and she loves teaching BILD3. It might be weird to adjust to her way of teaching at first, but once you understand, everything will be fine. Go to class and don't fall asleep (which I doubt you will) and you'll pass with an A. Clicker q's and quizzes are easy and she podcasts! Would take again

Dr. Kurle's lecture are very clear-cut. She's great at explaining concepts and takes time to answer questions. She made everything easy to understand. Exams are reflective of lecture material. There is just one midterm and the final.

I also wanted to add 'Hilarious', 'There For You', 'Would Take Again' tags but only 3 tags were allowed. My BILD3 class had 750 students but she definitely seemed to care about all of us doing well, getting good grades and actually understanding/getting interested in the material. She's so enthusiastic. I don't regret taking her AT ALL this 1st yr.

I got A in midterm, but B in final and the overall grade became B. Just feel the exam was too detailed, too many things needed to memorize. If you want to get an A, you need to study a lot. Also, the final grade is based on percentage of students. Not as other teachers, just based on the overall scores you earn. This is the worst thing.
She's the coolest professor ever! I always looked forward to attending her lectures :)

She is a caring woman and you can tell she is a Mom. Mandatory sections, 4 quiz that are easy, 1 midterm 1 final. extra credit assignment. Clicker questions every class for attendance.  Put minimal effort into the class and got an A-  Good if you want to focus on harder classes. AWESOME in lecture. never boring and is passionate about her field

Professor Kurle is just awesome! I was expecting some boring and long history talk since this class is focus on evolutionary study, but it turns out all her lectures are fun and exciting, at least they always make me awake even it's 8 am lectures. Best hit: no txtbooks required! exams are all multiple choices! You got 10 extra credits at the end!

Prof. Kurle (also a Star War fan) is amazing. Her slides are logical, structural and specific. Combining  her slides with podcastlecture, you will be fine. She only has one midterm and one final, so you have to work really hard for both of them and remember everything on the slides. She also gives 10 extra credit points to help boost your grade.

Prof Kurle's class is a little boring, especially for those that are not bio major. Participation matters and there are quizzes on discussions. The only midterm and final  are pretty hard and a lot of  remembering. But the 10-point extra credit is really helpful to make your grades better.
Lectures are ok but kind of boring if ur not bio major. Midterm and exam are pretty hard tho. I studied my butt off for both exams and I got B on both exam.

Prof Kurle's lecture is interesting enough (despite being an 8 A.M class) and the material is very straightforward. She posts the slides online and podcasts the lecture and the textbook is not at all needed. Everything on the testsquizzes are on her lecture slides. Midterm and final (MC) are pretty detailed, but fairly easy if you read her slides.

She is such a sweet person and is a great professor. You can tell that she cares a lot. She has a great speaking ability and is she is incredibly prepared for class. My only complaint is that it is very difficult to take notes in her lectures. She talks fast. I just went to lecture to "soak in" material and had to study on my own. I clicker needed.

She's a very good professor! Open mind, interesting lecture, we'll, she can't be better. Textbook not required. She provides scantrons for students. I clicker needed only! Definitely the best professor I've ever seen.  :)    Discussion session required for credit.
Easiest class I have ever taken at UCSD. Everything you need to know is on her slides, and tests are straightforward and super easy. Definitely take her!

She is by far the best professor I have had at UCSD. You do not need the textbook, all of the material is in her lecture slides. It is helpful to re-listen to podcasts and memorize. If you do this, you will for sure get an A.
Tests are very fair and representative of lecture. She's very engaging and lively as well. Definitely recommended for BILD 3. As long as you go to class & study the slides, you will do well.
DO NOT NEED TO BUY THE BOOK. Everything you need to know is on her slides. Her slides are very clear and full of pictures. She makes topics interesting and gives lots of examples. Shes fair on tests.

She's the best professor I've ever met. She can really catch your attention even from an 8am class. Exams are all multiple choice questions. She's a really really nice person. I highly recommend her course.

She's one of the few professors who can actually hold students' attention for an 8 AM class. Attendance is now mandatory (iClickers) but they're easy points. She's a super nice person as well. Take her.

She is the best professor I ever had. She is engaging, helpful, and a great lecturer. I feel this is one of the few classes I actually learned in. Her tests are kinda hard, but her class is worth taking.

She's an amazing professor. I unfortunately made a mistake when I stopped reading the text book and solely focusing on her lectures. I cannot express enough to read the required readings for the tests. It gives you a greater scope of the class to be able to answer some of her questions.

No textbook required. No mandatory attendance. No homework. One midterm and one final. I attended every lecture and studied slides after class. Got A+ eventually. She's nice and clear and elaborate. Materials are not hard to. Understand for this class but attention IS required.

Got a B on my midterm plus 10pts extra credit but did poorly on my final (got a C-) so my grade came out to be C+ even lower than what I got in my math class. This class didn't feel hard in the beginning because you aren't required to attend the lectures but it's actually hard to get good grade. Final was very detailed, must study(memorize) hard

No lectures required. In order to pass simply watch her podcasts at your leisure in the comfort of your own home and make hundreds of flash cards. You can even utilize TA discussions but are not mandatory. Tests are VERY straightforward and mainly test general knowledge of terms etc.

This class is so boring and dry.  Teaches only from lecture notes, not book required, makes it difficult to retain information. 1 midterm (100points) 1 final (200 points) 1 extra credit (10 points).  Final is cumulative.

Don't buy the book. All of the material u need is in her lectures. It'll be a total waste of money. A lot to memorize but it's not difficult. Just many definitions. One midterm, one final and 10pts extra credit. So don't mess up on the midterm otherwise it's gonna be pretty hard to raise ur grade. Nice lady though

Very very nice professor.  The grade in the class was based solely on a final and a midterm (final weighted twice as much as the midterm) so if you do really bad on the final, you're toast.  But she did give 10 points of EC that raises your midterm grade by a whole letter.  All of the lectures are podcasted so you don't have to go. Didn't use book

This lady is definitely passionate about teaching biology, and it showed during her lectures. Her midterm was fairly easy, but in my opinion, the final was a bit harder, which was probably due to the fact that there was so much material to memorize. All in all, I think she is a great teacher and I highly recommend her.

Focus on lecture material. Work hard for your first mid-term so you don't stress out on the final. Her questions on tests are pretty clear, but sometimes, they're worded to trick you a little. As long as you think conceptually besides mechanically memorizing terms, it'll be enjoyable. Personally, I thought the final was easier than the midterm.

Nice lady. Tests arent that hard, the only problem I find is that there is just a lot u need to know. Dont buy the book, never used it except for one chapter I believe. Main problem I have is that ur grade is only based on one midterm and one final (and 10 points extra credit) so it would be hard to get an A if u got a B or C on the first test

Super easy, gave an extra credit assignment that was worth 10 pts (total 300). Video-podcasted every lecture so you don't have to go. Exams were based on lectures as readings were optional and not mandatory. She was really passionate about teaching her subject and lectures were clear and concise.
Lectures are podcasted so attendance isn't mandatory. Midterm and final are based off lecture so you don't need to purchase the textbook. Interesting and clear lectures.

Sweet lady and is very passionate about the subject. One midterm and final. No hw so ur grade is only based on those two and one extra credit option. Test isn't too tricky, the only thing is that she gives you a lottt of terms to memorize. But it's also all based on her lectures so I would really recommend not waisting ur money on the book.
Shes pretty down to Earth and wants students to do well. Midterms are awesome, sometime you need to focus on details.
Quiet guy but respectable

Great professor, a ton of resources. His lectures were pretty much hybrid (guy prefers zoom, and in-person lectures only happen for group projects and presentation). Pretty engaging and inspirational; be prepared to practice the material a lot!\

Even though people say he's a great professor, I haven't seen him a single time in lecture he always cancels lecture last minute. Haven't seen this dude at all, personally class was not bad but it just wasn't the vibe him not being in the class when 90+ kids shows up to his class. Not very respectful
Greatest Proffesor I have ever had. Didn't see him much but he was great.
I took this class to get my thuganomics degree, and Professor Cena did a great job. However, I often had trouble knowing where he was. The board and chair were great lecturerers as well.

I did get a decent grade but after all these years, it is clear that what you learned is useless in life and work. This prof. made a lot of noise; now her views are clearly obsolete. Official US English and mainstream culture are the sure thing!

Ana is a great professor. She knows a lot and her class is very hard to pass if you do not actually know the subject. She is not hesitant in failing someone who begs and begs but does not know. I like that she is harsh with her grading.

Only class I ever failed!  I aced the other Ethnic Studies classes I took. I respect Zentella as an ethnographer. However, I think she expects too much. The midterm, paper and final are subjective and graded harshly. She pushes hard for students to agree with her beliefs. Though I'm really disappointed with my grade, I did learn a lot in her class.
She is the WORST professor EVER! She is not clear or helpful at all. Don't take this professor unless you REALLY have to!
Her class is challenging and she is tough but if you put enough effort forth it will pay off... disagree with her and you better be ready to back yourself up... You need to work for your grade!!!!
Excellent.
she was a challenge. but i learned sooo much from her. I was extremely proud of myself after her class.

WORST CLASS EVER!! ONLY WAY TO PASS IS TO AGREE WITH HER INSANE BELIEFS...ONLY TRIES TO HARP AND MAKE PEOPLE FEEL GUILTY...I TOOK A W BECAUSE I COULDNT STAND ANOTHER DAY IN HER CLASS....DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS!!!!!!

THE WORST CLASS AND PROFESSOR EVER! Stutters, harps on the same thing all the time, unorganized, unclear, tests on bizarre, random material. Stay away. Take another class, or at least another professor.
Languages at UCSD aren't the easiest, but Frau Wahl did an excellent job at organizing her lectures and making the class as interesting as possible.

I took LIGM1B and Frau Wahl was the best. She had a great sense of humor, tried to have engaging lectures, and did her best to explain grammar concepts in a language all of us hardly understood. I'd gladly take her again for the next quarter.

She is an amazing teacher, especially in regards to introducing the German language to many who have never even tried their hand at learning it. Every class, even when we were doing back-to-back lessons, was super organized and helpful. Herr Wahl is one of a kind, and it really shows.

His class has no recordings or any lecture slides and attendance is mandatory. He has quizzes every class that tests you on whether you are paying attention to the lecture or not. The TA I got was also very inconsistent with the advice given on the essay. Not an easy A, avoid Revelle at all cost...

Good lecturer, funny too. Clear and relaxed expectations of what he expects in terms of writing. He was also easy to approach after lecture. The final wasn't too hard. Essay grades came out a little late and sometimes he got a little off track.

Professor Caldwell was amazing! I was very nervous about the humanities rep of being "difficult", but he made the class very enjoyable. He emphasizes that he does not do coverage, so make sure to do readings before the lecture. Your entire grade is based on your writing, but as long as you follow the provided Hum Format, you will be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: His lectures carried me throughout this class they were funny and so easy to understand plus he gives various interpretations of text. TA was on the harsher side of grading (No A's at all) and was a bit ignorant when students gave their own interpretations or asked for help before/after discussions. DO NOT EXPECT AN A!!!, unless you get a nice TA

Overall, his character was extremely energetic and lectures were somewhat engaging, but a lack of overall organization and sometimes confusing to follow. Only main things were lots of reading, mandatory attendance (quizzes/participation), 2 essays (20%/e) and final 2 informal essays (30%) . Class depends on TA, but overall, I would take him again!

Lectures and discussions were mandatory but I found his lectures engaging. His assigned readings were interesting and not super unreasonable I would say. Grade was made up of 2 essays (20% each), 2 in-section writes, class participation, and the final. The final was incredibly chill as well if you were familiar with the readings and paid attention.

LE: mand, DI: mand,

lectures were usually boring as he but he does convey material clearly. Talks a lot with a "quiz" throughout the lecture which was very easy. Class really just depends on TA and if you get lucky. Caldwell is very passionate about his job but is boring.

Caldwell as a professor isn't bad, but if you have the chance to take Crum or West, you should definitely do that. Caldwell is more stricter then them, even though his teaching might be better and more interesting, if you want a better grade it is much easier to get taking those professors as they let you revise your essays and get 5% back.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Grade is entirely dependent on TA.

Do yourself a favor and do not take him. He might say a few funny things during lecture... but they are so boringgggggg. No slides no nothing. Just him talking about whatever he wants. He's also kinda mean and rude. Definitely was not welcoming when we spoke. 

if its your only choice, oh well. But be ready to be bored and get to class on time!!!

HUM 5 as a class is not great, but Caldwell's lectures made the course so much better. Though his prompts were pretty difficult, I felt that his lectures really prepared me for the readings and explained deeper concepts. He's also hilarious!! 10/10 recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His ego makes this class awful. Mostly talks about himself and sex during lecture, misrepresents the assigned texts, wastes our time with quizzes after every lecture (that's 30 quizzes!). People like him because they think he's funny/class is easy (wasting tuition is your prerogative). He can only act this way bc he's a white man and he knows it.

while Caldwell isn't a bad lecturer, his rules are ridiculous. No slides or podcasts and an in person final. yeah sure he's funny and all, but is that really worth it when there are other hum professors that are also interesting plus they dont try to make your life difficult? Also, his essay prompts were not helpful. hard to make argument from them
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is a great lecturer and his teaching style is entertaining. If you want to learn the material, I would go to him as he would present the stories with his amiable tone. His grading style is in-line with the departments. However, Hum is Hum and your grade depends on your TA.

Funniest professor I've ever had, he rly says whatever he wants and has no filter LOL; made HUM readings seem not so bad and lectures were entertaining all the way until the end. They are mandatory though and he has quizzes after each one (infinite attempts), final was online, done over a whole weekend, and pretty easy material. Great professor!!!

Caldwell is an awesome lecturer! He is super engaging and hilarious, and his grading system for HUM is also pretty fair. The books he chose were also interesting to read. However, be warned that your grade mostly relies on your TA.
Amazing teacher. Humanities classes in general suck, but he made the class less ugly

He's an amazing and interesting lecturer, but he's SUPER inappropriate and can make some uncomfortable comments. Definitely holds your attention, but in lecture, your notes HAVE to be taken on paper. Books are required but only like $60 (BUY ON AMAZON). Not too bad on feedback for essays though, expect to write two and do revisions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took him for HUM 1, and he is honetly a very good professor, his lectures really grab your attention. In terms of quizzes, they are all based on the lectures, and are relatively easy. He does not allow you to take notes on elctronics however, so if you are a apple kid you might struggle with that.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He grades you based off of 3 things: 1) 3"EXAMS" - THEY ARE ESSAYS, 1,000 WORDS MIN. EACH 2)Class Participation 3)Canvas post&replies. No extra credit offered. Grades hard on essays, and even if you show up and participate, he will still give you a B in the class. If you miss class, it WILL MAKE YOUR GRADE GO DOWN A LOT. I would not take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took Caldwell for HUM2 and am now taking him again for HUM5, both during COVID! Hes an amazing lecturer; though he doesnt use slides, his lectures are still easy to follow! Caldwell has also been very accommodating. Essay prompts arent usually very difficult if you have kept up in discussions and somewhat in readings. 100% recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bruh his online lecture is absolutely a fking blast during this particular time. His lecture is the only thing I can actually LISTEN to among all the awful online classes I have to take right now. The best thing rn for me is to take a huge puff, sit back on my couch, and listen to this man talking for hours. The way that he teaches is unique andfun
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I LOVED professor Caldwell. I hated HUM 1 & 2 but he absolutely made my HUM 5 experience awesome. He talks like a normal human being and makes funny jokes during class and relatable examples that make difficult texts wayyyy easier to understand. Literally the best HUM teacher I have ever had I wish I could take him for all the HUM classes. :))
took this during the corona quarter. only complaint would be that he doesn't use slides, which isn't a big deal bc I could pause the videos. But good at explaining material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Best professor ever! Keeps class entertaining and teaches concepts perfectly.

Great philosophical thinker, highly intelligent, competent,  perspective, clarifies, has passion for the subject and gives great detail like an art. Will explain further if you ask. Show up to class and don't be late ever. READ THE BOOKS! Cliffnote and wiki it too for in class discussion or if you don't have time. Yes to E-books. No cells otherwise
Extremely entertaining and smart. He knows his stuff and held the students' attention at all times.  Would definitely take another course from him...and he's pretty darn cute, too.
A great lecturer, really keeps everyone's attention and always ends lecture with a question. He's funny and cute which makes hum more bearable. I really like hum1 because of Caldwell!
Awesome lectures. Class does not facilitate note taking, but listening to lectures is enough. Very hard class though. 3 essays in 3 hour final.

Caldwell rocks. Watching him lecture on Paradise Lost is unforgettable. He must have a man-crush on Milton or something because he was so into the material. He also has a great sense of humor and will talk about a lot of stuff with you in office hours. He is overall one of the best lecturers in hum, or in any class.

Doesn't normally teach HUM 3, but he was so awesome! Lectures were highly entertaining that I never missed class. His humor and deep insight into human nature made the readings become more alive. He also taught us how to think and argue for ourselves. Thus,on top of two essays, final was 3 essay prompts. No regurgitation of facts. Take Caldwell!
I have such a crush on him.    He doesn't suffer fools gladly.
Caldwell is the best professor I've ever had at UCSD.  Hum is boring but he makes it really funny.  If you get a chance to take him you def should!

Caldwell is funny and very interesting. He lets you speak out in class which is different from many hum classes. First HUM class I actually liked going to. Plus, he's a hottie! you can't go wrong. Take him!

Caldwell as a TA is both great and not so great. He's great at explaining the finer points of lectures in an relatable & funny way. But he is a crazy grader. If you're not overconfident in your writing abilities and care a lot about your grade, then don't take him, because it's hit or miss with him; it's hard to figure out what he wants.

Hum is boring. Caldwell makes material accessible and very interesting. Clear and understandable. MOst HUM professors are old and dull, Caldwell young guy so able to relate to us. Seriously take him even if you hate HUM.

He is amazing! Class always went by so fast because he is entertaining. I usually always feel like i am going to fall asleep in hum classes but i never felt tired in his class! He makes LOTS of jokes and gives relates the material to issues that we understand, like dating, relationships, etc. the only bad thing about him is that hes engaged!
Caldwell is hot! Not a bad lecturer either.

He does a good job making relatively dull reading seem interesting in lecture… I actually go (which is saying something). His class is pretty hard, but he is also very approachable if you need any help.
First humanities class that I never fell asleep in.  Caldwell kept the class interesting, very rare among hum professors. He made the material more straightforward and bearable.
I like Caldwell, but his class is tough.  Since he is entertaining and HUM is a requirement anyway, i would recomend him.
best hum prof by far.
awesome teacher.  He explains frustrating material so that they become interesting and understandable.  Class is always entertaining.

Awesome instructor -- one of the absolutely most skillful teachers I have come across -- his class is worth the take, but be prepared to work exceedingly hard. Grading of paper writing is set to a high standard. His agenda is to turn out a person with an ability to think and analyze critically.
Hilarious guy. Really cool professor
most helpful teacher i've had at ucsd.  very funny very smart.  tough grader.
There should be a rating for how nice or mean a teacher is. Sure, using helpfulness clarity and easiness are important..but some teachers are just jerks.

very intimitating. does not hesitate to mock you. calls on you when you look like you're clueless. sarcastic. 15% participation grades. couldn't he accept that some of us aren't as smart as the others?

The best hum teacher I've had yet.  The class was always interesting which was a nice change from the rest of the hum series!!  He gave conceptual examples through personal stories which were entertaining.

Its great to have a professor that actually truly cares about the subject he is teaching and cares that his student learn from it as well.  He's not bad on the eyes either, makes going to class alot easier

It's nice having a prof young enough to relate to the students, but he doesn't have his 'teaching act' together yet.  His paper topics are pretty good, but then again - it's your TA who makes or breaks your grade entirely.  Caldwell's a nice change...
He expects you to do the reading, but he makes the lectures interesting and he's very funny.  He cares a lot about the students if you take the time to go to him.  Plus, he's really good looking.

I took this class my fall quarter as a gpa booster and did not know what to expect, however, this class turned out to be very easy. Midterm and final were based on a short group performance and teacher was very kind and helpful. Just go to class and participate and you should get an A, class was not as bad as some people are making it seem lol

Overall she was a great professor often it was hard because it was an 8 am class but other than that it was a pretty easy A the midterm was a small performance and the final was an outside performance but honestly it was really easy. She shows a lot of passion to ballet and it is seen through the dances. I loved taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She does not know how to teach dance. The class was not beginner friendly and she graded harshly on midterms/finals. The final was outside of class time and not scheduled on webreg. I recommend taking literally any other professor for dance. Class was quiet and miserable.

EASY A, could not recommend this class more. 2 extra credit opportunities were easy, and a lot of this class is based on common sense. Professor Cezo had caring and engaging lectures. Spent max 1 hour on HW each week. Such a good lecturer though with guest speakers often. Got over 100% in this class because it's just that easy! DO TAKE HER!

Easy A. Attendance for lecture/discussions is mandatory, you get 1 missed discussion and I believe 4 missed lectures before it affects your grade. There is easy extra credit. I got over 100% in this class and never spent more than 2 hours working on it out of the classroom. Lecture is boring, you have online discussions, NO TESTS, easy GPA boost
Assigned a lot of homework and promoted students to join student orgs that revolve around environmental activism.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mandatory discussions and lectures that almost put me to sleep. No test or real quizzes with most your grade being participation based. Never put more than 2 hours a week into this class and was still the easiest A I've ever earned. Realistically, you won't learn much but ig a good class if you want a GPA boost. Really nice and caring person though

Her class is insanely easy to the point of being dull. Has meaningless, but time consuming assignments. Lots of group discussion boards. No exam. Definitely do not take if you struggle with organization and multiple assignments. The work is really easy, but you have to be comfortable with multiple deadlines. Easy A if you remember to do the work.

I absolutely loved professor cezo! she is a sweetheart and you can tell she really cares for all of her students. her class is very light and there are no exams. I learned a lot. TAKE HER CLASS you won't regret it!!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was really interesting. We read a couple of books and had to discuss what we found interesting and share it with the class. We watched movies and quizzes weren't really that bad as long as you read and paid attention. The final was a little different since you had to bring 2 guests for a performance you make. Good regional spec for ERC

She is knowledgeable, cares about her students, and is easy going. She IS NOT clear on what she wants for papers, and was extremely controlling over the projects. She kept interrupting student presentations. I stopped doing the readings about 3 weeks into class and still could participate fine. She is very nice though, and an easy grader.
She's extremely helpful and super nice. Her grading policy isn't that tough. I thought I was gonna do horrible in that class, but I did pretty good. Take her!!!

Tere is a very nice teacher and really puts an effort into helping her students become better writers.  If you go to her office hours, she is willing to help you with your essays.  If it weren't for the fact that Muir 40 itself is tedious and seemingly pointless, I would recommend any class she teaches.

Same teacher I had for Muir 40. This time she was a little less clear about what she wanted because I tried to apply what I learned in 40 to this class and it didn't work out well. She's still cool though. Recommended.
Very willing to help. Not a tough grader, but not always clear about what she wants in your papers. A little monotonous but the class is not exactly fun. Recommended overall.

I didn't think I had a chance in this class because the writing is so tedious. She's really cool though. She understands her students and as long as you put forth an effort, you should get at least a B. Definitely take her.

His lectures can get a little off topic. This makes it hard to sit through but remember he's a jazz musician, don't expect too much structure! Haha. When he uses live musical examples, it can be much more helpful.  Ask for help if you missed anything! He's friendly and caring so he'll try to be helpful. Participate, quizzes, final paper, project.
Recommended for those with insomnia and no concern about their grades.
If you wish to loathe music, this is the class to take. I loved music until I met him. Also, he is extremely bias and heavily favors a select few.
I thought he was terrible.  So much for being a provost, can't even teach.  avoid
He is mundane and tests are impossible.  Because of him, I switched out of the music major.  If you want to do well in this class, you have to be the brown-noser in the front row.
Horrible class with horrible teacher.  Very pretentious and condescending.  I would avoid at all condescending cost.  His class makes ochem seem fun.

FANTASTIC! Take whenever possible. Always willing to help students in and out of class; regularly takes students to lunch to get to know them better. That said, if you have no musical background, don't expect to be spoonfed, as many peers did. No class is about that. He will make you learn and see things in a new light. Very worthwhile.
If you have no previous experience with reading music, don't bother with this class. Very unorganized, he spends the first 10 mins of class trying to set up the piano or powerpoint.

Lectures were difficult to keep awake during: the professor mumbles and/or talks softly. Tests were difficult to prepare for and were not structured: the professor is vague about what to study. Professor is knowledgeable but unorganized when presenting information. Don't buy the book, or wait to buy it: I didn't find it useful.

Did not learn anything in this class. My class notes consisted of doodling. Lectures do not hold your attention and it's only interesting when he plays the piano, which is maybe once a month. Besides that, he does not explain the material clearly. I didn't know what I was supposed to know. I relied on my music background to get through this class.

This was a fun elective class.    He plays piano in class, which helps you stay awake in lecture.  Go to class b/c most of his notes are not in the book. He only posts skeletons of his lecture notes and song charts online. Midterms were take home, and you could write an 8 page paper (recommended) instead of taking the final -which was not takehome

This was the worst class I took in college. He made my last class in suck. His lecture style was terrible. His TAs were not helpful at all. Everything was really unorganized and you never knew what was important and what wasn't. I used to like jazz before I took this class. All he ever talked about was being a previous provost.

This professor SUCKED! He made my last class in UCSD rather horrible! He doesnt seem to care about the students and his tests are pretty pointless and soo fricken hard!! Don't take it! He  made me hate jazz!

I loved 127A with Davis, but hated Lytle's teaching style. Lectures were hard to follow for those with absolutely no music background; he was unorganized in the presentation of course material; and he was very dry and boring.

A very funny an intelligent man. His quizzes and final were very fair and his lectures were very helpful an entertaining. The readings weren't bad either. If your a music or non-music major I suggest him, you will be satisfied in every aspect
My favorite Professor. He is funny and witty in his lectures but also very intelligent. A must for music majors or those who need an elective.

This teacher is one of the most helpless teacher in the world. She treat you like a high school student. Worst thing is she won't answer your question in class time. Also, she is very forgetive, she lost your homework and blame on you. Her class is very useless. She just keep reading on textbooks and word document instead of having useful activity.

Worst teacher ever. She treats her students like high school kids and expects too much from our essays, forgetting we are not encylopedias. The reason I progressed this quarter is because I did my best to get at least a 3/6 with her. She acts like she is nice but she isn't. Avoid her

... Her class was easy, but it definitely did not help me pass the Exit Exam. Summer Session (ELWR 1)did more practice essays than before, but I did not pass. The Exit Exam was difficult because of wording...

Class was extremely easy, which didn't prepare youf or the exit exam. She doesn't teach. All she did was go over homework and made us do group works, which doesn't help in INDIVIDUAL writing at all.
